2881.description: This is a fitted trumpet gown featuring a high neckline and long sleeves. The entire dress is heavily embellished with dense linear embroidery, intricate beading, and scattered sequins forming complex swirling patterns. The gown follows a structured silhouette through the bodice and hips before flaring slightly at the hem with a medium sweep train.

2883.description: This is a ball-gown style wedding dress featuring a high neckline and long sleeves. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate lace, embroidery, beading, and sequins from the structured bodice down through the voluminous skirt. The waistline is fitted, transitioning into a full, dramatic skirt that extends into a long train. The illusion neckline and full coverage sleeves provide a classic and regal aesthetic.

2884.description: Floor-length ball gown featuring an all-over botanical leaf and vine embroidered motif across structured, opaque textured fabric. The bodice is tailored with a high mock neckline and fitted long sleeves offering full coverage. A voluminous pleated skirt flares widely from the natural waist, extending outward into a wide circular train that pools evenly on the floor.

2887.description: Floor-length A-line bridal gown featuring an illusion bateau neckline over an opaque sweetheart bodice. The bodice and long sheer sleeves are densely embellished with botanical lace appliques and embroidery that taper down the sleeves and extend slightly past the natural waist. The gathered skirt is constructed from soft, flowing chiffon or georgette, dropping into gentle vertical folds and terminating in a short sweep train.

2892.description: This champagne and gold gown features a fitted trumpet silhouette covered in dense, intricate beadwork, embroidery, and sequin embellishments arranged in ornate scroll and linear patterns. It has long sheer sleeves and an illusion scoop neckline over a sweetheart foundation. A sheer tulle cape-like overlay attaches at the shoulder with a beaded floral applique, extending down into a long train.

2893.description: This fitted trumpet gown features a sheer illusion tulle base covered completely in dense beadwork, crystal embellishments, and pearl strings forming intricate geometric and star-like patterns. The garment has a high scoop illusion neckline with long sleeves and falls into a fitted silhouette that flares gently at the hem with a short train.

2894.description: This champagne and silver trumpet gown features an illusion scoop neckline and sheer long sleeves. The dress is densely encrusted with intricate beading and embroidery in geometric and beaded line patterns extending across the bodice, sleeves, and skirt. The fitted silhouette flares slightly at the hem with a short train.

2895.description: This is a fitted mermaid gown featuring a nude and champagne illusion sheer overlay densely covered in intricate beaded embroidery. The bodice has a sweetheart sweetheart neckline with a sheer illusion high-neck overlay accented by a pearl-beaded collar and long sleeves. Dense beadwork patterns radiate from the waist and cascade vertically down the skirt, which flares subtly at the hem into a short ruffled train.

2896.description: This fitted sheath gown features a nude-toned sheer illusion base heavily covered in dense silver beadwork and embroidery. The neckline is a rounded scoop with an illusion mesh panel above a sweetheart bodice structure. Long sheer sleeves feature a delicate grid pattern of beading, while the bodice and skirt showcase intricate swirling beaded motifs cascading downward.

2897.description: This is a fitted mermaid silhouette gown with an illusion scoop neckline and long sheer sleeves. The entire dress is heavily embellished with intricate geometric and floral-inspired beading, embroidery, and sequins over a nude and champagne colored base fabric. The skirt flares out from the knees into a medium length train with patterned hem details.

2898.description: This is an A-line gown featuring an illusion neckline and long sleeves. The dress is densely covered with intricate beading, embroidery, sequins, and crystal appliques in elaborate geometric and floral patterns, creating a structured corset look on the bodice. The tulle skirt falls with medium volume to the floor in a straight hemline without a train.

2899.description: This champagne and nude gown features an illusion neckline with long sleeves and a sheath silhouette that falls into a short train. Heavy silver beading and intricate embroidery create dense leaf and vine patterns sprawling across the bodice and shoulders, transitioning into cascading vertical linear beading down the skirt. The sheer overlay provides full coverage on the upper chest and arms.

2900.description: This heavily beaded gown features a light blue base fabric with a sheer overlay. It has a fitted silhouette that gently flares at the hem, creating a subtle trumpet shape. The gown showcases an illusion round neckline over a sweetheart bodice, complemented by long, sheer sleeves. Dense silver beading covers the entire garment in intricate vertical and curved patterns, offering full coverage with no visible slits or cut-outs and no distinct train.

2901.description: This is a pale sage green floor-length gown featuring an A-line silhouette. It has a high illusion neckline and long sheer sleeves with heavy beadwork, sequins, and embroidery forming intricate swirling patterns. The bodice is densely embellished with crystal beading and sequins outlining a sweetheart shape beneath the sheer layer, transitioning into flowing tulle on the skirt with trailing embroidered motifs.

2902.description: This black gown features a mermaid silhouette with long sheer sleeves and an illusion scoop neckline. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate silver beadwork and embroidery arranged in swirling, linear patterns that trace the curves of the body. The fitted skirt flares slightly at the hem into a short sweep train with matching beaded patterns. The construction combines a solid black underlayer with sheer mesh fabric along the upper chest and sleeves.

2903.description: This champagne and nude colored a-line gown features an illusion high-neckline with a sweetheart inner bodice and long sheer sleeves. The entire dress is heavily embellished with intricate crystal beading and sequin patterns that cascade down the bodice, sleeves, and skirt in flowing, vine-like lattice lines. The voluminous skirt falls gracefully to the floor with a short sweep train.

2905.description: This grey and silver evening gown features a fitted sheath silhouette covered entirely in dense crystal beading and sequins. The bodice has an illusion high neckline with a sheer yoke above a sweetheart shape, long sleeves with slight shoulder volume, and a flared peplum waistline edged with beaded fringe. The skirt falls straight to the floor with minimal volume and no visible train.

2906.description: This floor-length gown is crafted from slate-grey tulle layered over a fitted interior, featuring a high illusion scoop neckline over a sweetheart-shaped bodice. Full-length sheer sleeves and the bodice are lavishly covered in silver beading, sequins, and corded embroidery arranged in structured geometric and scroll motifs. The embellishment radiates down through the waist and hips, cascading into vertical linear beaded stripes across the gathered A-line skirt, which extends to a floor-sweeping hem with a subtle puddle train.

2907.description: This is a full-length blue sheath gown featuring an illusion scoop neckline and long sheer sleeves. The bodice and skirt are densely covered with intricate silver beaded and embroidered swirls and vertical patterns over a sweetheart-shaped inner lining. The skirt falls straight to the floor with minimal volume and no visible train.

2908.description: This is a floor-length a-line gown in a champagne-nude tone featuring long sheer sleeves and a scoop neckline. The bodice is heavily embellished with intricate geometric and scrollwork bead embroidery, transitioning into vertical beaded lines down the full skirt. The hemline is decorated with dense beaded scroll motifs over a multi-layered tulle fabric. The gown falls with medium volume and has no visible train.

2909.description: This fitted sheath gown is crafted from sheer nude mesh heavily embellished with vertical stripes of beads and sequins. The bodice features an illusion scoop neckline with sweetheart sweetheart-shaped beading underneath forming an intricate butterfly motif. Long sheer mesh sleeves are adorned with curved lines of beading matching the bodice pattern. The skirt flows down in a narrow silhouette, ending in a short pleated hem with a small sweep train.

2910.description: This is a floor-length navy blue mermaid gown featuring an illusion round neckline and long sheer sleeves. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate, geometric silver beading creating art deco-inspired patterns across the bodice, skirt, and sleeves. The skirt flares out from the knee into a medium-length structured organza train with beaded linear accents and a ruffled hem.

2911.description: This fitted trumpet gown features a nude illusion base heavily covered in intricate beaded and embroidered swirling patterns. The neckline is a modest scoop framed by an illusion yoke, accompanied by long sleeves featuring dense linear beadwork. The embellished scroll-like motifs flow down the bodice and skirt, ending in a flared hem with a short beaded train.

2912.description: This champagne-colored mermaid gown features a fitted silhouette that flares slightly at the hem with a short train. The sheer illusion neckline and long sleeves are densely covered in intricate gold and silver beadwork, embroidery, and appliques forming elaborate baroque patterns across the bodice, hips, and skirt. The upper chest includes a delicate pearl-beaded trim along the neckline, and the design incorporates dark accent stones distributed vertically down the front.

2913.description: This is a form-fitting mermaid gown with a nude and champagne illusion mesh overlay, featuring long sleeves and an illusion scoop neckline. The garment is densely covered in intricate beaded and sequin embroidery forming swirling vine-like patterns across the bodice, sleeves, and flared skirt. A prominent starburst beaded applique accents the left hip. The skirt flares out slightly at the hem into a short sweep train.

2914.description: This is a trumpet silhouette gown featuring dense, intricate beadwork and embroidery in symmetrical scroll and filigree patterns across the entire garment. The bodice has an illusion neckline with a sweetheart sweetheart-shaped underlay and sheer long sleeves covered in fine crystal beading. The skirt follows the curves of the hips before flaring outward at the bottom into a short train featuring matching embroidered swirls along the sheer hemline.

2915.description: This ivory mermaid gown features a V-neckline and long sleeves, fully covered in intricate beaded and sequined embroidery arranged in swirling, linear patterns that accentuate the body. The fitted silhouette flows downward into a flared hem with an elaborate, circular train that spreads out on the floor. The dense embellishment covers the entire garment from the shoulders to the edge of the hem.

2916.description: This fitted trumpet gown features an illusion neckline with long sleeves and heavy overall beading in swirling geometric patterns. The beadwork extends densely across the sheer bodice and curves downward along the skirt to a short train. The champagne underlay supports an intricate silver crystal lattice pattern throughout the entire length of the dress.

2917.description: This fitted mermaid gown features a high illusion neckline with a plunging v-neck lining underneath and long sleeves. The entire sheer-overlaid fabric is heavily embellished with dense silver sequins and beading in a swirling, undulating wave pattern. The dress hugs the body closely through the hips before flaring gracefully at the hem into a short sweep train.

2918.description: This fitted trumpet gown features a high illusion neckline and long sleeves, rendered in a champagne and nude tone. The entire garment is densely encrusted with elaborate silver beading, sequins, and embroidery in sweeping, organic line patterns that flow vertically down the fitted silhouette. The gown falls into a moderate flared hem with a medium sweep train trimmed in layered tulle.

2919.description: This trumpet gown features an illusion scoop neckline and long sheer sleeves with intricate beadwork and embroidery covering the entire garment in geometric patterns. The bead density is heavy across the bodice and flares out in radiating lines down the fitted skirt to a short train. The champagne-toned underlayer is visible beneath the heavily embellished sheer overlay.

2923.description: This is a heavily embellished trumpet gown featuring elaborate silver beading, embroidery, and sequins creating intricate damask patterns across the entirety of the garment. It has an illusion high neckline with a sweetheart sweetheart-shaped bodice layer underneath, and long sleeves with subtle volume at the shoulders. The fitted bodice transitions into a flared skirt that falls to a short train on the floor.

2925.description: This is a heavily embellished, floor-length mermaid gown featuring a high neckline with an illusion sheer yoke. The long sleeves and entire fitted silhouette are densely covered in intricate silver and crystal beadwork, sequins, and embroidery in geometric and scrollwork patterns. The dress flares out subtly at the knees into a medium sweep train featuring matching ornate detailing along the hem.

2926.description: This champagne and silver gown features a fitted mermaid silhouette with a high illusion neckline and long sheer sleeves. It is heavily covered with dense beadwork, sequins, and intricate embroidered patterns flowing symmetrically down the bodice, skirt, and sleeves. A removable full overskirt with matching heavy embellishments extends into a long, dramatic train.

2928.description: This champagne and nude trumpet gown features a scoop neckline and long sleeves. The entire silhouette is densely covered in intricate, swirling beaded and sequined embroidery forming an ornate pattern. The skirt falls close to the body before flaring slightly at the hem with tiered sheer tulle layers.

2929.description: This fitted champagne and nude sheath gown features an illusion high neckline with a sweetheart underlayer and long illusion sleeves. The entire dress is heavily embellished with intricate silver beading, crystal embroidery, and symmetrical patterns that run vertically down the silhouette. A voluminous tiered ruffle attachment accented with lace and embroidery sits on the left hip, cascading into a sheer overlay and a medium length train.

2930.description: This is a floor-length trumpet gown featuring an illusion high neckline and long sleeves in a vibrant purple color. The entire dress is heavily embellished with intricate silver and gold beading and sequins arranged in diagonal geometric patterns. A gathered draped panel across the waist is centered with a large crystal floral brooch embellishment. The skirt flows closely to the body before flaring slightly at the hem into a short sweep train.

2931.description: This is a long-sleeved, fitted trumpet gown with a scoop neckline and a short train. The entire garment is densely covered in geometric patterns of sequins, beading, and embroidery over a dark fabric base. The beadwork creates structured vertical and diagonal lines down the bodice and skirt.

2932.description: This fitted sheath gown features a sheer illusion scoop neckline overlaid with a modest scoop bodice, long sheer sleeves, and a floor-length silhouette ending in a short train. The entire dress is heavily embellished with intricate linear patterns of silver and bronze beads, crystals, and sequins. A distinct beaded bow detail with a floral crystal center accentuates the waistline.

2933.description: This fitted sheath gown is rendered in a dusty pink shade with heavy embellishments. The bodice and long sleeves feature dense, geometric beadwork and sequin embroidery in silver and pink tones arranged in vertical and radiating patterns. A large floral applique sits at the hip, anchoring a dramatic gathered overlay of smooth satin fabric that drapes vertically down the skirt. The opposite side of the skirt displays the full beaded and embroidered fabric panel all the way to the floor.

2935.description: This green evening gown features an illusion scoop neckline with long, fitted, heavily sequined and beaded sleeves that have slight gathering at the shoulders. The bodice incorporates directional pleating and draping in an olive-toned fabric, transitioning into a fitted skirt covered entirely in intricate silver and dark beading and sequin patterns arranged in linear and feather-like motifs. The skirt flares slightly at the hem into a short sweep train.

2937.description: This is a full-length, A-line evening gown featuring a dark base heavily dense with sweeping linear patterns of beading, sequins, and embroidery in shades of silver, dark purple, and copper. It has a rounded scoop neckline, long fitted sleeves, and falls gracefully to the floor with a short train. The intricate embellishments swirl across the bodice and cascade down the skirt in organic, curving lines.

2938.description: This is a full-length, fitted navy blue gown with a mermaid silhouette and a long, sweeping train. The dress features a scoop neckline and long, fitted sleeves. Dense beadwork and sequin embellishments cover the entire garment in a sweeping, swirling pattern of silver, pink, and blue lines that curve across the bodice and cascade vertically down the skirt.

2939.description: This burgundy gown features a trumpet silhouette with long sleeves and an illusion neckline. The entire surface is heavily embellished with intricate beading and linear sequin patterns creating a sweeping visual effect. A horizontal beaded belt accentuates the waist above subtle draping on the bodice. The skirt flares gently at the hem into a short train.

2940.description: This champagne-colored fitted sheath gown features heavy vertical crystal and bead embellishments throughout the skirt and sleeves. The bodice combines a sweetheart neckline under sheer illusion fabric with a heavily beaded high collar. Heavy horizontal draping wraps the hips, accented by a floral beaded applique on the left side, flowing down into a floor-length skirt with a short train.

2941.description: This fitted gown features a high neckline and long sleeves, fully covered in intricate geometric beadwork and silver embroidery over a champagne base. An overlay of gathered, pleated chiffon fabric drapes diagonally across the waist, secured by a jewelled embellishment at the hip, and flows into a long, flared train.

2942.description: This champagne and gold fitted trumpet gown features a one-shoulder asymmetrical neckline and long sheer sleeves heavily encrusted with beads and embroidery. The bodice incorporates structured diagonal draping of satin fabric across the chest and waist, accented with a large jeweled applique at the hip from which a long draped chiffon sash extends. The lower skirt and sweep train are covered in dense, intricate linear beading and silver embroidery arranged in geometric patterns. The dress has a column-like fitted silhouette flaring slightly at the hem with a medium train.

2945.description: This is a heavily beaded and embroidered mermaid gown with long sleeves and a scoop neckline. The dress features dense, geometric beadwork and sequins arranged in intricate, sweeping patterns over a champagne-toned fabric. The silhouette is fitted through the bodice, waist, and hips, flaring out at the hem into a medium train with sheer, layered ruffles at the bottom edge.

2946.description: This is a heavily embellished, floor-length mermaid gown featuring dense silver beadwork, sequins, and embroidery over a sheer champagne-toned mesh base. The dress has long sheer sleeves and an illusion scoop neckline with a sweetheart bodice lining visible underneath. The intricate linear and geometric bead pattern runs continuously from the neckline down the fitted silhouette, flaring slightly at the hem into a short sweep train with beaded edging.

2948.description: This is a fitted sheath gown in a champagne or nude tone featuring a scoop neckline and long sleeves. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate silver and tonal beadwork, embroidery, and sequins, complemented by cascading vertical fringe or feather-like embellishments along the hips and skirt. The gown falls closely to the body with minimal volume, trailing into a short hem at the floor.

2949.description: This is a form-fitting trumpet style gown featuring long sheer mesh sleeves and a high illusion neckline. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate beaded and sequined embroidery arranged in geometric and linear patterns over a champagne colored lining. The skirt fits closely through the hips and thighs before flaring out slightly at the hem into a short sweep train.

2950.description: This is a fitted trumpet-silhouette gown in a champagne color, featuring a heavy covering of intricate beading in radiating geometric patterns over an illusion tulle base. The neckline is a high scoop with an illusion yoke and long sheer sleeves. The skirt contours closely to the body and flares subtly at the hem into a short train edged with dimensional pink floral appliques.

2951.description: This fitted mermaid gown features heavy, dense beadwork and sequin embellishments arranged in elaborate, symmetrical geometric and radiating patterns across the entire silhouette. The dress has long sleeves and an illusion scoop neckline with a sheer upper panel. The fabric is fitted closely through the bodice and hips before flaring slightly at the hem into a short, heavily embellished train.

2953.description: This champagne-colored mermaid gown features a fitted silhouette that flares into a long train. The garment has a high neckline and long sleeves, fully covered in dense, swirling linear beading and sequin embroidery forming a feathery or leaf-like pattern. Attached at the shoulders is a floor-length chiffon cape with a draped neckline secured by a decorative crystal brooch.

2954.description: This is a fitted long-sleeved navy blue gown featuring a scoop neckline and an intricate pattern of swirling, vertical rows of sequins and beading covering the entire garment. The shoulders are slightly gathered, and a beaded waistline accentuates the waist before the skirt flares into a modest trumpet silhouette with a short sheer tulle train.

2955.description: This is a form-fitting mermaid gown featuring a black sheer base embellished heavily with swirling linear patterns of burgundy and silver beading and sequins. It has an illusion scoop neckline with long sleeves and a defined crystal-embellished waist belt. The gown falls closely to the body before flaring slightly at the hem into a short sweep train.

2956.description: This black mermaid gown features dense, intricate beading in swirling patterns across the bodice, sleeves, and upper skirt. It has a high scoop neckline and long sleeves. A beaded belt defines the waist. The fitted skirt flares out near the knee with a section of the train covered in dimensional black fabric floral appliques.

2959.description: This black evening gown features a fitted mermaid silhouette with long sleeves and an illusion scoop neckline. The dress is densely embellished with intricate gold and silver beadwork and sequin patterns arranged in sweeping, radiating lines across the bodice and skirt. The skirt flares slightly at the hem into a short sheer tulle train with beaded accents. The structured shoulders add definition to the long-sleeved upper coverage.

2960.description: This black and silver fitted mermaid gown features long sleeves and a scoop neckline. The entire surface is heavily embellished with dense sequins and beading in a swirling pattern, creating an intricate texture. A thin beaded belt is fitted at the natural waistline. The skirt flares out slightly at the hem with an attached sheer black tulle train trailing behind.

2961.description: This is a full-length, fitted mermaid gown featuring a high scoop neckline and long sleeves with subtle shoulder volume. The entire garment is densely covered in dark navy, gold, and bronze sequins forming an intricate, abstract linear pattern. A thin beaded belt accentuates the waist. The hem pools at the floor with a short, layered tulle train.

2963.description: This fitted mermaid gown features an illusion scoop neckline and long sleeves. The dress is densely embellished with intricate silver sequin and bead embroidery arranged in ornate, symmetrical leaf-like patterns over an olive green base. The silhouette hugs the figure closely before flaring out at the hem into a medium-length train adorned with matching beadwork.

2964.description: This is a fitted mermaid gown featuring an illusion neckline and long sleeves. The dress is made of a green base fabric overlaid with sheer tulle and heavily embellished with dense silver beading and embroidery arranged in organic, flowing leaf and vine patterns. The skirt hugs the figure closely through the hips before flaring slightly at the hem into a short sweep train.

2965.description: This lilac gown features a fitted mermaid silhouette with a short train and a sheer illusion scoop neckline. It has long sleeves and is heavily embellished with dense silver beading, sequins, and dimensional leaf or feather-like appliques that cascade down the front. The bodice incorporates sheer tulle overlays with vertical draping across the chest.

2966.description: This is a form-fitting mermaid gown in a lilac tone featuring sheer illusion mesh over a sweetheart bodice neckline with a modest scoop illusion overlay and long sleeves. The dress is heavily embellished from top to bottom with intricate beadwork, sequins, and embroidery in abstract floral and linear swirl motifs. The dense embellishments form sweeping patterns across the bodice, sleeves, and down the skirt. The skirt flows into a medium sweep train featuring matching beaded floral appliquéd motifs scattered along the hemline.

2967.description: This lilac gown features a fitted trumpet silhouette crafted from sheer mesh overlaid with dense metallic beading and sequin embellishments. The bodice and hem display intricate, large-scale patterned appliques in contrasting silver and gold tones, while the skirt body is covered in vertical linear beaded rows. It has long sheer sleeves and an illusion scoop neckline, extending into a short hem-sweeping train at the back.

2968.description: This is a fitted sheath gown in a lilac hue with long sleeves and a scoop neckline. The entire garment is densely covered in vertical rows of silver and purple beading and sequins. A large structured satin bow is attached at the hip with beaded detailing. The medium train features a sheer overlay with a heavily embellished beaded and embroidered floral pattern along the scalloped edge.

2969.description: This is a fitted trumpet gown in a lilac hue, featuring long sleeves and a scoop neckline. The entire dress is heavily embellished with intricate beaded, sequined, and appliqued patterns in gold, silver, and deep purple tones, creating a sweeping botanical motif across the bodice and skirt. The skirt falls close to the body before flaring slightly into a short train at the floor.

2970.description: This lilac mermaid gown features a high scoop neckline and fitted long sleeves. It is heavily covered in dense beadwork and sequined appliqués forming large, organic leaf or feather patterns radiating across the bodice and cascading down the skirt. The sheer tulle overlay falls into a fitted shape through the hips before flaring outward into a medium sweep train.

2971.description: This is a fitted trumpet gown in navy blue fabric, featuring long sleeves and a scoop neckline. The entire garment is densely covered in swirling, linear patterns of sparkling beads and sequins in shades of silver, pink, and blue. The dress closely follows the body curves down to the knees before flaring out slightly into a short sweep train with matching embellished details.

2973.description: This is a heavily embellished mermaid gown featuring a high illusion neckline and long sleeves. The entire sheer-base tulle fabric is densely covered in silver beading, sequins, and embroidery in linear and clustered patterns that create a glittering effect. The fitted silhouette hugs the body down to the mid-thigh before flaring out into a moderately-sized floor-sweeping train with intricate beaded detailing along the hem.

2974.description: This is a form-fitting mermaid silhouette gown crafted from sheer nude mesh completely covered in dense silver and gold beading, embroidery, and sequins arranged in intricate geometric and curved patterns. It features an illusion high-neckline with a sweetheart inner structure and long sleeves embellished with matching beadwork down the arms. The heavy embellishment follows down the fitted body, flaring out at the bottom into a medium train with scalloped beaded edging.

2975.description: This champagne and silver gown features a fitted mermaid silhouette with a medium sweep train. The entire garment is densely covered in geometric patterns of silver beads, crystals, and sequins over an illusion mesh base. It has a high illusion scoop neckline and long sheer sleeves similarly encrusted with beading.

2977.description: This is a form-fitting sheath gown in a champagne and nude colorway featuring extensive all-over beadwork in intricate swirling patterns. It has a sheer illusion scoop neckline and long sheer sleeves densely covered in beads. The dense beaded embellishment continues down the length of the fitted silhouette, tapering toward a small beaded train at the hem.

2979.description: This fitted mermaid gown features an illusion neckline with a sweetheart sweetheart bodice and long sleeves. The entire surface is densely covered in intricate silver and clear beading, sequins, and embroidery arranged in geometric scroll patterns. The skirt flares out from the knee into a sheer tulle hemline that extends into a medium train with beaded accents.

2980.description: This fitted mermaid gown features a sheer illusion neckline with a scoop shape and long sleeves. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate beaded and sequined embroidery creating geometric, art-deco-inspired scalloped patterns across the bodice, sleeves, and skirt. The dress closely follows the lines of the body before flaring slightly at the hem into a short sweep train.

2981.description: This trumpet gown features an illusion neckline with a deep sweetheart or v-neck base and long sheer sleeves. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate beadwork, sequins, and embroidery arranged in vertical lines and curved patterns that trace the bodice and hips. The fitted silhouette flares out at the knees into a voluminous, heavily embellished circular train pooling on the floor.

2982.description: This is a long-sleeved sheath gown featuring a scoop neckline and an all-over heavy embellishment of geometric beaded and sequined patterns creating an abstract linear motif. The garment is floor-length with minimal volume and falls straight to the hem without a train. The fabric base is sheer dark grey tulle overlaid with dense metallic beadwork and embroidery.

2983.description: This is a long-sleeved sheath gown in a dark mauve or greyish-purple hue. The dress features a high scoop neckline and a fitted silhouette that falls straight to the floor with a short sweep train. It is densely covered in geometric and linear patterns of sequins, beads, and embroidery over the entire garment.

2984.description: This is a heavily embellished champagne and gold gown featuring a mermaid silhouette, high neckline, and long sleeves. The dress is densely covered in intricate beadwork, sequins, and embroidery forming geometric and radiating patterns across the entire garment. It is fitted through the body and flares slightly at the hem with a short train.

2985.description: This is a champagne and nude illusion mermaid gown with long sleeves and a high neckline. The entire dress is heavily embellished with dense silver beading and embroidery forming ornate, symmetrical filigree and damask patterns down the bodice, hips, and flared hem. The skirt fits closely through the thighs before flaring out into a medium length beaded train.

2987.description: This fully beaded trumpet gown features a high scoop neckline and long sleeves, completely covered in intricate geometric silver beadwork and embroidery over a champagne base. The garment fits closely through the torso and hips before flaring slightly at the hem with a short circular train.

2989.description: This is a form-fitting mermaid gown featuring heavy, intricate beading and sequin embellishments arranged in ornate, symmetrical patterns across the entire silhouette. The neckline combines an illusion sheer scoop with an off-shoulder strap design, accompanied by long sheer sleeves densely covered in sparkle work. The dress hugs the hips and thighs before flaring out near the floor into a medium-length structured train.

2990.description: This champagne and silver trumpet gown features dense, intricate crystal beading and sequin embroidery forming elaborate damask-like patterns across the entire silhouette. It has an illusion sheer high neckline over a sweetheart bodice, combined with long sheer sleeves heavily embellished with matching beadwork. The fitted skirt flares gently from the knees into a sweeping, heavily decorated long train.

2992.description: This fitted trumpet gown features extensive, intricate silver beading, embroidery, and sequin embellishments arranged in ornate geometric and swirling patterns over a champagne illusion fabric. The bodice includes a high illusion scoop neckline and a distinct teardrop cutout just below the collar. It has long sheer sleeves embellished with heavy beadwork along the arms and shoulders. The gown hugs the hips before flaring gracefully at the lower legs, extending into a medium sweep train featuring matching linear bead patterns.

2993.description: This is a form-fitting trumpet gown featuring a sheer illusion scoop neckline and long sleeves, fully covered in intricate silver and tonal beading, sequins, and embroidery arranged in geometric and swirling patterns. The fitted silhouette closely follows the contours of the body through the hips before flaring slightly at the hem into a short sweep train. The dense embellishment spans the entire surface of the garment, creating an opulent and shimmering texture.

2994.description: This fitted floor-length gown features a scoop neckline and long sleeves. The entire surface is densely covered in intricate silver and clear beading, sequins, and embroidery forming elaborate geometric and curved patterns. The skirt follows a straight silhouette that gently pools at the floor into a short train.

2996.description: This is a heavily embellished mermaid silhouette bridal gown featuring long sleeves and a high illusion neckline. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate beadwork, sequins, and embroidery in ornate swirling and geometric patterns over a nude-toned lining. The fitted bodice flows down through the hips before flaring out into a dramatic, sweeping train with a heavily decorated scalloped hem.

2997.description: This is a heavily embellished mermaid gown featuring a high illusion neckline and long sleeves. The dress is densely covered in intricate silver beading, embroidery, sequins, and appliques over a champagne and nude base layer, forming geometric and swirling patterns that trail down the fitted skirt into a medium train.

3004.description: This fitted mermaid gown features a nude illusion base entirely covered in dense, intricate silver and champagne beading arranged in flowing, wavy vertical patterns. The neckline is high with an illusion sheer panel, complemented by long sheer sleeves and an attached ivory cape that cascades down the back to form a medium sweep train, secured at the neck with a large crystal brooch.

3005.description: This fitted sheath gown features heavy, dense linear beading and embroidery arranged in organic, flowing wave patterns across the entirety of the garment. It has a high illusion neckline with long sleeves and a center-front slit on the skirt. Attached at the shoulders are long, flowing sheer capes that pool into an extended train.

3006.description: This fitted mermaid gown features a high neckline and long sleeves, completely covered in dense, concentric arched beadwork that creates a wave-like pattern across the entire silhouette. Attached at the shoulders is a flowing, sheer chiffon cape that billows outward and extends into a dramatic train behind the gown. The beading follows a curved geometric layout over a blush and champagne toned underlayer, cascading downward toward the hemline and train.

3007.description: This is a form-fitting mermaid gown featuring a high scoop neckline and long sleeves, rendered in a champagne or gold-toned fabric. The entire surface of the dress is densely covered in intricate beaded detailing arranged in flowing, sweeping wave patterns that follow the contours of the body. The gown fits closely through the hips before flaring out at the knees into a moderate sweep train adorned with the same heavy beadwork.

3009.description: This green fitted mermaid gown features an illusion scoop neckline and long sheer sleeves. The entire surface is densely covered in intricate silver beaded embroidery forming swirling vertical patterns. A distinctive looped and draped sculptural embellishment originates from the left shoulder and sweeps across the upper torso. The skirt flares gently at the hem with a short embellished train.

3011.description: This champagne and nude colored mermaid gown features heavy intricate beading, sequins, and dimensional applique arranged in elaborate swirling and feathered linear patterns over an illusion tulle base. The neckline is a sheer scoop with an illusion sweetheart bodice foundation, and the sleeves are long and fitted with beaded cuffs. The dress fits closely through the hips and thighs before flaring subtly at the hem into a short sweep train.

3013.description: This green fitted sheath gown features dense, intricate silver sequin and bead embellishments arranged in swirling, organic wave patterns across the bodice, sleeves, and skirt. The upper bodice incorporates sheer illusion netting with asymmetrical draping and a high scoop neckline. The long sleeves are fitted with beaded cuffs, and the silhouette maintains a straight, column-like shape down to the floor without a train.

3015.description: This champagne and silver gown features a fitted mermaid silhouette with a high leg slit on the left side. The entire dress is densely covered in intricate silver beadwork and sequin embroidery forming baroque patterns. It has a V-neckline with an illusion inset, long sleeves with slight shoulder gathering, and a short, embellished train.

3019.description: This green sheath dress features full coverage with a scoop neckline and long sleeves. The garment is heavily covered in diagonal rows of beading and sequins, creating a linear pattern that wraps around the torso and down the skirt. Additional beaded and embroidered applique motifs are placed on the right shoulder and bottom left hem. The dress falls straight to the floor with minimal volume and no train.

3020.description: This blue long-sleeved sheath gown features an illusion neckline with a sheer yoke. The entire garment is densely covered in geometric sequin, bead, and embroidery patterns. Long sleeves feature hanging beaded fringe details cascading from the shoulders and outer arms. The gown falls in a straight, fitted silhouette with minimal volume and no visible train.

3023.description: This teal gown features an illusion high neckline and long sheer mesh sleeves. The fitted sheath silhouette is heavily embellished with dense silver beading, sequins, and geometric embroidery patterns throughout. A decorative fabric bow is affixed at the left side of the waist, with draped fabric originating from the waistline. The skirt flows down into a short sweep train.

3026.description: This green fitted sheath gown features long sheer sleeves and a scoop neckline. The entire sheer-layered garment is heavily embellished with intricate beaded and sequined embroidery in ornate swirling patterns. A high slit rises up the center front skirt, and the hem flows into a short sweep train.

3032.description: This fitted mermaid gown features an illusion scoop neckline with long sleeves and heavy beadwork arranged in intricate linear and draped patterns across the entire surface. The bodice incorporates distinct structured cups covered in beading, creating a corset-like appearance. The skirt falls closely along the body, flaring slightly at the hem with a short train.

3034.description: This black sheath gown features an intricate overlay of dense silver beading and embroidery throughout the bodice, sleeves, and skirt. The bodice includes an illusion high neckline with a black velvet structural element across the chest and sheer beaded sections. Long fitted sleeves are covered in heavy beaded fringe that extends downward. The skirt is column-shaped and embellished with heavy vertical crystal fringe creating a patterned net effect down to a short train.

3037.description: This blue sheath gown features a high illusion scoop neckline and long sheer sleeves. The entire surface of the garment is heavily embellished with intricate geometric and cascading crystal beading in a dense pattern. The fitted silhouette falls smoothly to a floor-length hem with a short train.

3042.description: This is a fitted, full-length sheath gown in a champagne and nude color palette. The high-neck bodice and long sleeves are densely covered in intricate beaded and sequin embroidery arranged in flowing linear patterns. A prominent, smooth satin sash drapes across the torso, gathered at the hip with a decorative crystal brooch and extending down the skirt as a cascading panel.

3043.description: This fitted sheath gown features a sheer nude fabric base heavily encrusted with dense silver and champagne beading arranged in intricate radiating patterns. It has a high illusion neckline, long sheer sleeves finished with feather cuffs, and vertical lines of feather fringe cascading down the skirt. The silhouette is straight and floor-length with no visible train.

3050.description: This is a form-fitting mermaid gown made of sheer illusion mesh heavily laden with intricate beadwork and pearl embroidery in geometric and curved patterns. It features a scoop neckline over a sweetheart bodice structure, long sleeves, and a fitted skirt that flares slightly at the hem with a short train.

3051.description: This is a lilac long-sleeved sheath gown featuring a high illusion neckline and dense bead and sequin embellishments arranged in swirling, leaf-like patterns across the bodice and skirt. Diagonal soft draping fabric overlays the bodice on one side. The long sleeves are fitted and fully beaded, and the skirt falls straight to the floor with a subtle short train.

3053.description: This is a fully sequined long-sleeve gown in a silver and grey colorway. The silhouette is fitted and sheath-like, falling straight down to the floor with a short sweep train. It features a rounded scoop neckline and structured long sleeves with padded shoulders. The dense sequin embellishment covers the entire garment from top to bottom.

3054.description: This is a fully sequined long-sleeve gown in dark grey and silver tones, featuring a fitted mermaid silhouette that flares slightly at the hem into a short train. The bodice has an illusion V-neckline with a sheer sheer insert covering the upper chest. The entire garment is densely covered in shimmering sequins, providing a high-glamour finish. Long fitted sleeves complete the fully covered front and upper body.

3058.description: This a-line gown features an intricate ivory lace and organza overlay heavily embellished with dense beading, sequins, and embroidery across the bodice and cascading down the voluminous skirt. It has a scalloped v-neckline and long, fitted lace sleeves with beaded detailing at the cuffs. The gown falls from a fitted waist into a medium length train with matching appliqué details.

3059.description: This champagne and nude A-line gown features an illusion scoop neckline with long sleeves. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate beading, sequins, and embroidery forming radiant, sunburst-like patterns on the bodice that cascade down the voluminous skirt. The waist is defined and the skirt flows outward into a medium sweep train with visible beaded botanical motifs.

3060.description: This is a full-length a-line gown featuring an illusion neckline and long sheer sleeves. The bodice showcases visible boning with heavy pearl and bead embellishment in a sweetheart-shaped underlay design, transitioning into scattered beading and lace appliqués down the full skirt. The fabric is a combination of sheer tulle overlay and patterned lace underneath, falling with medium volume to a short train.

3061.description: This ivory a-line gown features a sheer illusion neckline overlaying a sweetheart bodice with long lace sleeves. The entire dress is heavily adorned with intricate lace applique, embroidery, and subtle beadwork covering the fitted bodice and flowing skirt. The structured bodice has visible corset detailing through the sheer fabric. The skirt falls in a medium volume A-line silhouette with a short train.

3062.description: This ivory a-line gown features a high illusion neckline and long sleeves, fully covered in intricate embroidery, beading, and sequins. The bodice showcases a structured sweetheart shape underneath sheer beaded tulle, transitioning smoothly into a flared, full skirt with layered lace patterns and vertical linear embellishments. The dense placement of beads and sequins creates a sparkling, textured surface extending from the collar down to the floor-length hem.

3064.description: This ivory a-line wedding gown features an illusion scoop neckline and long sheer sleeves. The bodice and skirt are densely decorated with intricate beaded and embroidered feather-like patterns and sequin accents. A beaded waistband defines the natural waistline, from which the full-volume layered skirt falls gracefully into a medium sweep train.

3065.description: This fitted mermaid gown is fully saturated with heavy beadwork arranged in cascading draped swags across the bodice, sleeves, and skirt over a sheer nude foundation. It features an illusion scoop neckline, long sheer sleeves, and a floor-sweeping beaded train accompanied by a detachable flowing sheer cape in a matching champagne tone.

3067.description: This is a form-fitting mermaid gown featuring heavy beaded swags in concentric arrangements across the entire bodice and skirt. The upper portion includes an asymmetrical sheer overlay creating a one-shoulder neckline paired with a long draped fabric panel that extends into a medium train. The sleeves are long and completely covered in intricate beading matching the body of the dress.

3069.description: This fitted trumpet gown features a champagne-toned underlayer entirely covered by an intricate, sweeping pattern of silver beading, embroidery, and sequins. It has a high illusion scoop neckline and long sheer sleeves similarly embellished with dense beadwork. The dense geometric beadwork traces the silhouette, culminating in a subtle sweep train.

3070.description: This is a fully-beaded trumpet gown featuring a high scoop neckline and long sheer sleeves with subtle shoulder shaping. The entire silhouette is densely covered in intricate metallic silver and champagne embroidery, beading, and sequins arranged in ornate geometric patterns. The dress fits closely through the hips before flaring out slightly at the hem into a short sweep train.

3072.description: This is a form-fitting mermaid gown featuring a high scoop neckline and long sleeves with subtle shoulder volume. The dress is densely covered in intricate metallic beading, sequins, and embroidery forming geometric and vertical patterns over a nude-toned illusion underlayer. It follows a slim silhouette down to the knees before flaring out slightly into a short sweep train with matching embellished trim.

3073.description: This is a fitted mermaid gown featuring a high illusion neckline and long sleeves, fully covered in dense, intricate silver and crystal beading, embroidery, and sequins arranged in symmetrical linear and geometric patterns. The sheer fabric construction creates a nude illusion base with heavy embellishment density throughout the bodice, sleeves, and skirt. The garment fits closely through the hips before flaring slightly at the hem into a short embellished train.

3074.description: This fitted mermaid gown is heavily embellished with intricate crystal beading and silver sequins forming swirling linear patterns over a nude and champagne base. It features a sheer illusion scoop neckline with long sleeves and light shoulder gathering. A draped chiffon overskirt extends from the back into a long train, complementing the beaded hemline.

3076.description: This fitted trumpet gown features a scoop neckline and long sleeves, fully covered in intricate silver and white beadwork, sequins, and embroidery arranged in geometric and floral-inspired patterns. The bodice is structured with defined paneling leading into a form-fitting skirt that flares out at the bottom into a medium-length circular train with matching heavily embellished detailing.

3077.description: This fitted mermaid gown features an illusion neckline with long sleeves, entirely covered in dense geometric beaded and sequin embellishments forming chevron patterns. The garment falls closely to the body before flaring at the lower thigh into a structured skirt with a medium sweep train adorned with matching beadwork. The illusion netting creates a sweetheart neckline effect underneath the high-neck sheer overlay.

3079.description: This fitted trumpet gown is densely covered in geometric patterns of silver beading and sequins over a nude-toned underlayer. It features a high scoop neckline and long sheer sleeves with matching beaded embellishments throughout. The structured bodice transitions into a fitted skirt that flares slightly at the hem with a short train.

3081.description: This champagne gown features a fitted silhouette with a high neckline and long sheer sleeves. The bodice and neckline are heavily embellished with intricate beading and crystal details over sheer tulle. The lower skirt is crafted from a gathered, draped metallic fabric that falls into a short sweep train.

3083.description: This is a fitted mermaid gown featuring a sheer illusion high neckline and long sleeves. The dress is densely embellished with intricate beadwork and embroidery forming swirling, flame-like patterns that cascade down the entire length of the garment and onto the sweep of the long train. The fabric falls close to the body before flaring out at the lower thighs into an elaborately decorated hem.

3084.description: This fitted trumpet gown features a sheer illusion scoop neckline and long sleeves. The dress is densely covered in heavy silver beading and embroidery forming sweeping, organic vine or feather-like patterns across the bodice, sleeves, and skirt. The fabric is a sheer dark grey or olive tulle over a lining, falling into a slim skirt with a short train adorned with trailing beadwork.

3085.description: This fitted sheath gown features a nude illusion fabric heavily encrusted with intricate silver beading, sequins, and embroidery in ornate, swirling geometric patterns. The bodice has an illusion neckline and long sheer sleeves densely covered in beadwork, with sheer vertical boned paneling visible at the waist. The embellishment is dense throughout, creating a continuous sparkling pattern from the neckline down to the hemline. The skirt follows a straight silhouette and extends into a short, heavily beaded train.

3086.description: This is a heavily beaded and embroidered mermaid gown in a champagne or nude tone featuring a fitted silhouette through the hips that flares out into a long train. The garment has a square neckline and long, fitted sleeves completely covered in dense silver embellishments and intricate linear patterns. Dense beadwork, sequins, and embroidery cover the entire bodice and skirt in symmetrical swirls and medallions, culminating in heavy ornamentation along the hemline and train.

3088.description: This is a long-sleeved A-line gown featuring an illusion scoop neckline over a sweetheart bodice structure. The bodice and skirt feature extensive diagonal draping layered with intricate patterned lace and subtle beading. The long sleeves are fitted with gathering at the shoulders, and the skirt flows into a short train.

3091.description: This champagne and nude gown features a fitted silhouette with a smooth, flowing skirt that falls straight to the floor without a train. The bodice is heavily embellished with intricate beadwork and shimmering crystals in a sweeping pattern over an illusion base. It has a high scoop neckline and long sheer chiffon bishop sleeves that gather into beaded cuffs. The waistline is accented with delicate ruching and soft draping that cascades down the hip.

3094.description: This ivory a-line gown features an illusion scoop neckline with long sheer bishop sleeves gathered into ornate lace cuffs. The fitted bodice is adorned with dense white lace and applique detailing extending down from the sheer yoke over a sweetheart foundation. The lightweight chiffon skirt falls softly to the floor with a short sweep train.

3100.description: This is a blush-colored pleated gown featuring an illusion high neckline and sheer long bishop sleeves with banded cuffs. The bodice incorporates visible boning and intricate beading outlining a sweetheart shape, complemented by a ruffled accent running over the right shoulder. Draped fabric converges at the center waist above a vertically pleated skirt that falls straight to the floor with a short sweep train.

3104.description: This champagne-colored gown features a high neckline with sheer illusion detailing across the chest adorned with intricate beadwork. The bodice is heavily draped diagonally, featuring beaded accents flowing down into a beaded bow at the waist. The long sleeves are semi-sheer with puffed shoulders and fitted cuffs. The skirt is made of lightweight, lustrous fabric with soft vertical draping and falls into a short, sweeping train.

3105.description: This ivory and champagne a-line gown features long sheer sleeves and an illusion neckline overlaying a sweetheart bodice. The dress is heavily adorned with intricate lace and 3D floral appliques distributed across the bodice, sleeves, and falling vertically down the layered skirt. The skirt falls softly to the floor with moderate volume and terminates in a short train.

3106.description: This is a trumpet style gown featuring an illusion high neckline overlaying a sweetheart bodice. The garment has long, sheer sleeves densely covered in beadwork. Intricate beaded and embroidered patterns radiate from the center bust and waistline over a lace base fabric. The skirt flows into a subtle trumpet silhouette with a short train trimmed in lace.

3107.description: This a-line gown features an illusion scoop neckline and long sheer sleeves constructed with tulle. The bodice and sleeves feature dense floral lace appliques and botanical embroidery that extends sparsely down the full-length skirt. The skirt falls straight to the floor with moderate volume and no visible train.

3108.description: This champagne-colored gown features a sheer illusion neckline with long, bishop-style sleeves gathered at beaded cuffs. The bodice incorporates a V-neckline wrap design with heavy draping across the waist and dense beadwork embellishment on one side of the chest. The skirt is completely pleated, falling in vertical folds into a floor-length hemline without a train.

3110.description: This fitted mermaid gown features a nude-toned base with an intricate ivory lace underlayer and dense silver beading and embroidery throughout. The bodice has an illusion high neckline and long sheer sleeves heavily embellished with beadwork. A structured, heavily beaded draped overskirt wraps around the waist and cascades into a medium train.

3111.description: This ivory a-line gown features an illusion scoop neckline with long sleeves and visible boning on the structured bodice. The entire garment is densely covered in silver and translucent embroidery, beading, and sequined botanical appliques that cascade down the sheer tulle layers of the skirt. The skirt falls with medium volume into a short train at the floor.

3115.description: This ivory gown features a structured, heavily beaded corset bodice with delicate spaghetti straps and a square neckline. The skirt is crafted from soft pleated chiffon that flows downward with dramatic diagonal draping gathered on one side. The floor-length garment finishes with a short sweep train at the back.

3117.description: This blush-colored gown features a sweetheart neckline overlaid with an illusion mesh panel adorned with intricate beading and detailing. The bodice and skirt showcase extensive ruching and draping that converges at the waistline. Long bishop sleeves gather into beaded cuffs.

3118.description: This is a long-sleeved, high-neck metallic gold gown with a fitted sheath silhouette and floor-length hem without a train. The fabric has a reflective sheen and fluid drape. Asymmetric gathering and heavy draping originate from a twisted knot detail at the waist, creating diagonal folds across the bodice and a cascading fabric panel down the front skirt. The long sleeves feature slight gathering at the shoulders.

3122.description: This champagne colored a-line dress features an illusion neckline and long sheer bishop sleeves with buttoned cuffs. The bodice is densely covered in pearl and bead embellishments in an intricate, structured pattern that dips low at the waist. The skirt is made of lightweight, pleated fabric that falls softly to the floor with medium volume and no visible train.

3131.description: This fitted sheath gown features an asymmetric one-shoulder neckline and a single long sheer sleeve adorned with dense vertical lines of silver beading. The champagne and nude fabric is heavily embellished throughout with intricate swirling patterns of silver beads and crystal embroidery that flow vertically down the bodice and skirt. The gown follows a straight, form-fitting silhouette with minimal volume, falling into a short beaded sweep train.

3137.description: This blue sheath gown features heavy, intricate silver beading arranged in geometric patterns covering the entire bodice, long sleeves, and skirt. The neckline is a scoop shape with an illusion sheer panel extending upward. The fitted silhouette falls straight to the floor with minimal volume and no visible train.

3141.description: This fitted mermaid gown features an all-over dense beaded and sequined fabric in silver, combined with an illusion high neckline and long sleeves. A prominent sculptural white fabric feature with layered large leaf-like appliques cascades diagonally from the left shoulder down across the bodice and skirt. The gown includes asymmetric fabric draping across the upper chest and flows into a beaded medium-length train.

3142.description: This ivory mermaid gown features an illusion neckline with a sweetheart sweetheart base and cap sleeves. The entire dress is heavily embellished with intricate beadwork forming swirling, organic patterns. The hemline of the skirt and train is finished with dense floral appliques and feather-like texturing creating volume at the base.

3145.description: This is a fitted mermaid gown featuring long illusion sleeves and a scoop illusion neckline. The entire dress is heavily embellished with intricate beaded patterns and sequins arranged in curving, symmetrical designs that contour the body. The gown finishes in a medium sweep train with matching embellished patterns.

3146.description: This ivory gown features a fitted trumpet silhouette adorned with intricate geometric beadwork, sequins, and embroidery that forms striking chevron and curvilinear patterns across the entire garment. It has a sweetheart neckline framed by a scoop shape, long fitted sleeves, and is accompanied by a sheer veil and a long embellished train that pools on the floor.

3147.description: This trumpet gown features an illusion high neckline and long sheer sleeves with heavy beaded detailing. Intricate geometric beadwork and draped beaded swags overlay the bodice and fitted hips, transitioning into a flared skirt with lace underlayers. The dress includes a medium sweep train adorned with matching beadwork.

3148.description: This gown features a fitted sheath silhouette crafted from smooth, flowing chiffon with pronounced asymmetrical draping across the bodice and skirt. The neckline is an asymmetrical illusion style, featuring a sheer panel on one side adorned with dense floral lace applique and beading that extends over the shoulder and down one long, sheer lace sleeve. The opposite sleeve is long, fitted, and made of solid fabric with subtle shoulder gathers. The skirt falls straight to the floor with gentle gathering at the hip, ending in a short, subtle train.

3149.description: This ivory sheath gown features heavy, all-over silver beading, embroidery, and sequin embellishments arranged in intricate vertical patterns. The dress includes a scoop neckline and long, fitted sleeves with subtle gathering at the shoulders. A distinct layered peplum detail accentuates the waistline above a straight-falling skirt. The lightweight fabric falls into a floor-length hem without a visible train.

3150.description: This ivory mermaid gown features a fitted silhouette through the bodice and hips that flares outward at the knees into a long, elaborately detailed train. The garment has a high neckline and long sleeves with subtle shoulder volume. Dense, intricate metallic embroidery and pearl beading cover the entire exterior of the dress, arranged in symmetrical vertical patterns down the front and cascading outward on the train.

3151.description: This ivory sheath gown features a high neckline and long sleeves with punctuated puffed shoulders. The garment is heavily covered in intricate beading, embroidery, and lace patterns forming elaborate swirls and motifs across the entire surface. A pointed peplum-style overlay detail wraps around the waistline. The skirt follows a straight fitted silhouette down to a short train at the floor.

3152.description: This fitted mermaid gown features a high neckline and long sheer sleeves completely covered in dense, intricate geometric beading and embroidery patterns. The bodice and skirt feature ornate beaded scroll and diamond motifs cascading vertically down the fitted silhouette. The gown extends into a circular medium-length train detailed with matching beadwork radiating outward.

3153.description: This ivory trumpet gown features a high illusion neckline overlaid with a structured, wrapped v-neck bodice and heavy geometric crystal beading throughout the lower skirt and long sleeves. Long sheer capes or panels drape down from the shoulders to the floor, blending into a medium train with embellished scalloped edging. The midsection incorporates gathered vertical draping around a heavily beaded central closure detail.

3154.description: This ivory gown features a fitted sheath silhouette covered in dense beading and floral applique. It has an illusion high-neck collar with a sweetheart neckline underneath, paired with long sheer beaded sleeves. Asymmetric draping originates from the hip and cascades down the front. The skirt flows down into a short train.

3156.description: This ivory mermaid gown features an illusion scoop neckline and long sheer sleeves with dense beadwork and lace applique distributed evenly across the bodice, sleeves, and flared skirt. The heavily embellished fitted silhouette transitions into a long cathedral-length train edged with intricate lace detailing. A matching sheer long veil with lace trim drapes from the crown.

3157.description: This fitted floor-length gown features dense, heavy silver and white beading, embroidery, and crystal appliqués in intricate geometric and vertical patterns across the entire surface. The bodice has a rounded illusion neckline and structured, puffed long sleeves. A flared peplum waist accentuates the fitted silhouette, which falls straight to the ground without a train.

3158.description: This is a heavily beaded and sequined mermaid gown featuring long sleeves and an illusion neckline over a sheer, boned corset bodice. Swirling geometric embroidery and crystal embellishments cascade densely across the entire garment, following the fitted silhouette down to a flared skirt and short sweep train.

3159.description: This ivory gown features a fitted sheath silhouette with an illusion high-neck over a sweetheart or v-neckline base and long sheer sleeves. Dense, ornate silver and ivory beadwork, sequins, and embroidery cover the entire garment in elaborate symmetrical scroll and leaf patterns. The gown hugs the hips closely before falling to the floor with a short sweep train.

3162.description: This fitted sheath gown features a high neckline and long sleeves with subtle gathering at the shoulders. The base fabric is densely covered in geometric patterns of shimmering beads and sequins in a lilac hue. A smooth, satin-like draped fabric sash originates diagonally from the right shoulder, wraps across the bodice, and falls down the left side into a sweeping medium train.

3171.description: This blue sheath gown features a scoop neckline and long sheer sleeves with heavy bead and embroidery work arranged in intricate swirling patterns across the entire silhouette. An attached solid blue pleated fabric panel drapes from the right shoulder down to the floor, forming a short train. The dense beadwork creates a shimmering, textured finish over the fitted silhouette.

3173.description: This is a blue floor-length gown featuring a high neckline and long sheer sleeves. The underlayer is a fitted sheath style covered in dense silver crystal beading, embroidery, and sequins in an intricate symmetrical pattern. A voluminous sheer tulle overskirt is attached at the waist, adding fullness and trailing slightly behind the wearer.

3180.description: This is a heavily embellished strapless gown in a gold and champagne hue, featuring a fitted sheath silhouette. The entire garment is densely covered in shimmering beads and sequins from the sweetheart neckline down to the hem. A high thigh slit reveals the leg, and the structured bodice has visible vertical boning. The gown falls into a minimal volume skirt with a short train.

3185.description: This champagne and nude mermaid gown features an illusion high neckline overlaying a sweetheart bodice and long sheer sleeves. The entire silhouette is densely covered in intricate, swirling beaded and sequin embroidery forming branching patterns. The skirt hugs the hips before flaring slightly at the hem into a short sweep train.

3190.description: This fitted sheath gown is rendered in a sheer champagne tulle fabric heavily embellished with dense rows of iridescent beads and pearls arranged in radiating, swirling starburst patterns. It features a sheer jewel neckline with long sleeves and subtle gathering at the shoulders. The beading follows a continuous structural pattern over the bodice and cascades down the length of the skirt to a short hem train.

3195.description: This fitted trumpet gown features a sheer illusion high neckline and long sleeves that flare into dramatic ruffles at the cuffs. The entire garment is crafted from a sheer lace base overlaid with dense, three-dimensional floral appliques distributed heaviest at the bodice and tapering toward the hem. The skirt falls close to the body before flaring slightly at the floor into a short sweep train. The fabric combines a neutral champagne underlayer with ivory lace and floral details.

3200.description: This is a long-sleeved trumpet gown featuring a scoop neckline and an all-over heavy embellishment of beads and sequins in swirling, patterned lines over a nude base. The garment fits closely through the torso before flaring slightly at the hem with no visible train. The intricate pattern covers the entirety of the garment from neckline to hem.

3202.description: This is a long-sleeved straight-silhouette gown covered in geometric beaded and sequined patterns in multi-color metallic tones including gold, silver, burgundy, and green over a sage green base. It features a high scoop neckline and long sleeves. A gathered, draped solid sage green satin sash wraps across the waist and hips, extending into a short cascading panel and train down the right side.

3205.description: This fitted trumpet gown features an illusion high neckline and long sheer sleeves with gathered shoulder details. It is heavily covered in intricate geometric beadwork, embroidery, and sequins arranged in symmetrical patterns over a champagne-colored base. The dense embellishment continues downward through the fitted silhouette into a short sweep train.

3209.description: This grey gown features a fitted mermaid silhouette with a sheer illusion neckline and long sleeves. The dress is densely embellished with intricate beading and sequins arranged in geometric patterns radiating across the bodice, sleeves, and skirt. Delicate draping is visible on the upper chest. The skirt flares slightly at the hem with a short train.

3211.description: This fitted trumpet gown features a high neckline and long sleeves. It is heavily embellished with intricate geometric beading, sequins, and embroidery patterns over a sheer nude and champagne underlayer. The garment falls closely to the body, flaring slightly at the hem with a short train.

3212.description: This green one-shoulder gown features a straight sheath silhouette with a long sheer sleeve on one arm. The bodice showcases diagonal pleated tulle draping across the chest, transitioning into dense sequin and embroidered leaf-like scrollwork patterns covering the entire garment from the waist down to the hem. The dress is floor-length with no train and maintains a fitted profile throughout.

3215.description: This ivory a-line gown features intricate diagonal draping across the bodice and asymmetrical pleating on the skirt. One shoulder is accented with an attached sheer long sleeve, while the opposite shoulder features a flowing, floor-length draped panel. Crystal and bead applique adorns the upper right bodice and the left hip. The skirt falls softly into fine accordion pleats with a short sweep train.

3216.description: This ivory sheath gown features a square neckline supported by beaded spaghetti straps. The bodice combines heavily beaded, textured metallic sections with asymmetrically draped fabric wrapping across the chest and waist. The skirt falls straight with a soft, gathered drape wrapping around the front and down to the floor. The back is partially visible through the straps and follows the same fitted column silhouette with a clean hem.

3223.description: This is a form-fitting sheath gown featuring a high neckline and long sleeves. The dress is densely covered in intricate beadwork and sequins arranged in linear and feathered patterns throughout. The fabric is sheer overlay on a neutral lining, falling straight to the floor with minimal volume.

3353.description: This champagne-colored a-line gown features an illusion V-neckline and long, sheer sleeves crafted from fine tulle. The bodice is densely covered in intricate silver and tonal beadwork, crystals, and sequins arranged in geometric and linear patterns. Vertical beaded strands cascade down the full tulle skirt, adding weight and sparkle to the flowing silhouette. The dress has full coverage with a fitted waistline and falls to the floor without a train.

3354.description: This is a fitted sheath gown covered entirely in intricate silver beading and pearl embroidery forming geometric patterns across the entire garment. It features a high scoop neckline and long sleeves embellished with hanging beaded fringe along the arms. The dress skims the silhouette closely down to a medium sweep train extending behind.

3356.description: This ivory a-line wedding dress features an illusion high neckline overlaying a sweetheart bodice, adorned with dense floral lace applique and beading. The sheer long sleeves are gathered into cuffs, and the waist features intricate gathering and draping that cascades into the flowing skirt. The lightweight fabric falls softly to a short train.

3358.description: This sheath gown features an intricate, floor-length beadwork pattern covering the entire surface in geometric and scrolling motifs. It has long sleeves, a scoop neckline, and a fitted silhouette that falls into a small train. The heavy bead embellishment is set on a neutral nude or champagne sheer fabric background.

3359.description: This black and gold evening gown features an illusion scoop neckline and long sleeves. The dress is heavily embellished with intricate geometric sequin and bead patterns. Asymmetric soft draping is present across the bodice, flowing down into a draped sash panel along the front. The fitted silhouette extends into a subtle short train.

3360.description: This is a form-fitting gown with a mermaid silhouette, featuring a sheer illusion scoop neckline and long sleeves. The dress is densely covered in intricate, swirling beaded embellishments that create a flowing wave pattern across the entire garment. It is rendered in a champagne and nude tone with metallic beading, fitting closely through the hips before flaring slightly at the hem with a short train.

3361.description: This champagne and nude fitted sheath gown features an illusion round neckline with long sleeves. The entire surface is densely covered in intricate beadwork and embroidery forming geometric and swirling patterns. The silhouette contours the body closely down to a subtle short train at the floor.

3362.description: This A-line gown features an illusion high neckline and long sleeves. The entire garment is heavily embellished with intricate beading and embroidery forming geometric and radiating patterns over an underlying lace layer. The fitted bodice transitions at the waist into a flared, multi-layered skirt that falls to the floor with a short train.

3363.description: This fitted mermaid gown features a sheer illusion scoop neckline and long sleeves in a lilac base color. The dress is densely embellished with intricate swirling embroidery, beading, and sequins in copper and silver tones forming flame-like patterns throughout the entire garment. It features a fitted silhouette that flares gently at the hem with a short train.

3364.description: This floor-length navy blue dress features a fitted sheath silhouette made from a lustrous, fluid fabric with diagonal ruching and draping across the bodice and waist. The neckline is a modest V-shape, complemented by sheer long bishop sleeves that gather at the cuffs. A prominent fabric rosette applique is centered at the left hip, from which vertical gathers cascade down the skirt. The back and lower details are obscured, and the skirt falls straight to the floor with no train.

3365.description: This fitted sheath gown is densely covered with vertical rows of silver and crystal beading and sequins over a nude-toned base. It features an illusion high round neckline with long sleeves and a prominent sculptural bow detail on one shoulder. The silhouette skims the figure closely down to a subtle short sweep train.

3366.description: This champagne and nude trumpet gown features an illusion neckline with a square inner structure and long sheer sleeves. The entire silhouette is heavily embellished with dense beadwork, pearls, and intricate swirling embroidery arranged in sweeping drapery patterns across the bodice and skirt. The lower skirt flares slightly into a short train finished with elaborate embroidered scalloping along the hem.

3367.description: This champagne-colored gown features a sheer illusion neckline and long sleeves covered in dense, intricate beading and embroidery forming a botanical or feather-like pattern across the bodice, shoulders, and extending down the skirt in flowing vertical lines. The silhouette is a soft a-line with a sheer tulle overlay falling gracefully to the floor into a short train. The bodice is fitted through the waist with the beadwork radiating outward from a central point.

3368.description: This green fitted mermaid gown features long sleeves and a scoop neckline. The entire dress is heavily embellished with dense tonal beaded embroidery arranged in intricate curving patterns over sheer fabric. The skirt falls close to the body before flaring slightly at the hem with a short train.

3369.description: This champagne-colored mermaid gown features a fitted silhouette that flares into an expansive, intricately beaded train. The sheer illusion mesh is heavily embellished with dense, silver beadwork and embroidery forming swirling leaf and feather-like patterns across the bodice, long sleeves, and skirt. An asymmetric draped fabric panel crosses the left side of the upper chest over a structured sweetheart inner bodice. The neckline is a modest scoop framed by sheer illusion mesh with long fitted sleeves.

3370.description: This is a fully beaded sheath gown featuring long illusion sleeves and a sheer scoop neckline. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate metallic silver and champagne beading and sequins arranged in geometric and linear patterns radiating from the waist. The skirt falls straight with minimal volume, continuing the vertical crystal line work down to the floor. The gown is crafted from a sheer tulle base over a neutral lining.

3371.description: This fitted sheath gown features a high illusion scoop neckline and long sleeves. The dress is densely covered in intricate beaded and sequined swirls forming a botanical motif over a sheer taupe or mauve fabric layer. A distinct pleated fabric accent is draped across the upper left chest area. The garment falls closely to the floor into a short sweeping train.

3372.description: This fitted sheath gown features a nude undertone overlaid with champagne-toned sheer fabric entirely covered in dense, intricate beading and embroidery forming swirling botanical patterns. It has a high scoop illusion neckline and sheer long sleeves, both detailed with delicate pearl and crystal beading along the structured chest area. The gown falls closely to the body through the hips before flaring slightly at the hem into a short sweep train.
