3373.description: This ivory and champagne sheath gown features an intricate arrangement of dense beading and embroidery forming geometric and radiating patterns across the entire silhouette. The neckline combines a sweetheart bodice with a wider scoop illusion overlay, complemented by sheer long sleeves completely covered in beadwork. Draped fabric converges near the center waist, creating a structured corseted look that extends downward into a fitted skirt with a short train.

3374.description: This fitted sheath gown is crafted from a nude and champagne underlayer covered by an ivory lace overlay. Dense three-dimensional floral appliques and beadwork embellish the entirety of the garment, growing denser near the high neckline and fitted bodice. The long sleeves feature sheer lace and dramatic tiered flared bell cuffs. The skirt falls close to the body before pooling slightly into a short train at the back.

3376.description: This fitted sheath gown features an all-over intricate pattern of dense silver beading, embroidery, and sequins creating a continuous linear motif over a champagne base. The long-sleeved dress has an illusion scoop neckline with sweetheart bodice framing underneath and light gathers at the shoulders. The silhouette skims the body closely down to a subtle puddle hem with a short train.

3377.description: This pink gown features a soft, pleated chiffon skirt that flows in a medium volume to the floor without a train. The fitted bodice is heavily embellished with dense rows of beadwork forming draped, scalloped patterns across the chest and torso. Long, sheer chiffon sleeves are gathered into cuffs at the wrists, complementing the modest scoop neckline.

3378.description: This is a fitted satin gown in silver with a high illusion neckline and long sheer sleeves heavily embellished with beading and embroidery. The bodice features asymmetrical draping and dense floral applique work that cascades down the skirt and onto the hemline. An attached overskirt creates an a-line silhouette, opening at the front to reveal the embellished sheath underskirt with a side slit. The look is completed with a medium-length sweep train.

3380.description: This fitted trumpet gown features extensive beaded embroidery in ornate swirling and linear patterns over a sheer illusion fabric. The bodice includes a sweetheart neckline beneath an illusion high-neck overlay and sheer long sleeves. The heavy beading creates an intricate design cascading down the length of the skirt to a short sweep train.

3382.description: This champagne-toned gown features an a-line silhouette crafted from sheer mesh overlaying a nude lining. The deep v-neckline includes an illusion insert at the center front and long sheer sleeves. Dense beading and crystal embroidery cover the entire garment in vertical patterned lines and geometric motifs. The skirt falls with medium volume into a short train.

3384.description: This black gown features a fitted sheath silhouette with a high neckline and long sleeves. The bodice and skirt are heavily embellished with intricate beaded and sequin patterns arranged in swirling motifs. Diagonal draping across the torso creates an asymmetrical wrap effect, complemented by a draped side panel. The skirt falls straight to a subtle short train.

3385.description: This ivory and champagne trumpet gown features a high neckline and long sheer sleeves heavily dense with intricate beadwork and crystal embellishments. The fitted bodice showcases a corset-style structure covered in elaborate beading patterns and stone appliques, complemented by a large sculptural floral applique on the right shoulder. The skirt is fitted through the hips before flaring out into a ruffled hemline with layered fabric details and a medium length train.

3386.description: This is a fitted mermaid gown featuring a high neckline and long sleeves, rendered in a champagne and nude tone. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate silver and tonal beading, sequins, and embroidery in ornate, symmetrical baroque patterns. The silhouette fits closely through the torso and hips before flaring out at the knees into a medium-length beaded train.

3387.description: This ivory and champagne gown features an illusion high scoop neckline with a heavily beaded collar detail and sweetheart bodice lines underneath. The fitted mermaid silhouette is densely covered in intricate beadwork and crystal embroidery arranged in swirling geometric patterns. Long sheer sleeves feature slight gathers at the shoulders. The skirt flares out at the knees into a medium train with heavy beaded scalloped edging.

3388.description: This champagne colored gown features a sheer illusion neckline accented with pearl and bead embellishments that extend across the upper chest. The bodice includes a structured, sheer corset style with vertical boning and gathered fabric. Long, sheer bishop sleeves gather at the wrist with fitted cuffs. The skirt is heavily draped with vertical pleats converging at a knotted center waist detail, flowing gracefully into a full, floor-length skirt without a train.

3389.description: This lilac gown features an asymmetric beaded vine motif that extends from the right waist across the bodice and onto the left shoulder, as well as down the left sleeve. The bodice and skirt are constructed with diagonal draping of chiffon fabric that falls in a straight silhouette. It has a V-neckline and long, sheer bishop sleeves gathered at the cuffs. The skirt falls straight to the floor with minimal volume and no train.

3390.description: This black gown is crafted from a glitter-infused fabric featuring a fitted sheath silhouette. It has a high scoop neckline with soft cowl draping across the bodice and long straight sleeves. The waist is accented with crossed beaded bands, from which a draped fabric panel cascades down the left hip into a short train at the back.

3391.description: This champagne and gold gown features a sheath silhouette with an illusion scoop neckline and sheer long sleeves. The bodice is densely covered in intricate beadwork and pearls with heavy diagonal draping of pleated fabric across the front, fastened with a jeweled applique at the waist. The skirt falls straight to the floor with heavy beaded embellishments creating vertical patterns, ending with no train.

3392.description: This black gown features a straight sheath silhouette with a high round neckline and long sheer bishop sleeves cuffed at the wrists. The bodice is constructed from a combination of matte fabric and draped velvet, accented with intricate concentric crystal and bead embellishments forming a distinct geometric pattern across the chest and extending down the center waist. The skirt falls in a straight, floor-length column with a smooth, minimalist finish and no train.

3394.description: This champagne-colored a-line gown features soft chiffon fabric with extensive horizontal and diagonal draping across the bodice and waist. The bodice has an illusion high neckline overlaying a sweetheart line, paired with long, sheer, fitted sleeves that gather slightly at the shoulders. A beaded chevron appliqué accentuates the asymmetrical drape crossing the lower waistline. The skirt flows loosely into a medium train with gathered soft folds.

3395.description: This champagne and nude gown features a fitted sheath silhouette with a sheer illusion scoop neckline and long sleeves. The bodice is densely covered in intricate vertical and radiating silver beading and sequins, punctuated on the right chest by a large sculptural fabric rosette applique with ruffled petals. Heavy soft draping wraps diagonally across the waist and falls vertically down the skirt, which concludes in a short floor-sweeping train.

3396.description: This black gown features a high neckline and long sleeves, constructed from a soft, fluid fabric with prominent diagonal draping across the bodice and hip. Dense silver crystal beading covers the entire right sleeve and extends as an elaborate, ornate applique across the right shoulder and chest. The skirt falls straight to the floor with minimal volume and no visible train. The left sleeve is plain black fabric with a gathered shoulder and fitted cuff.

3397.description: This black gown features a sheer illusion high neckline with long sleeves and asymmetrical heavy draping across the bodice and skirt. The right sleeve and right side of the bodice are densely embellished with shimmering copper or gold beading arranged in geometric patterns. The left sleeve is made of a sheer, gathered fabric with a blouson cuff. The skirt falls straight to the floor in soft pleats and gathers from the draped waist.

3398.description: This black gown features a fitted sheath silhouette with a high neckline and long sleeves. The bodice and sleeves are densely embellished with silver beading arranged in intricate geometric and curved patterns. The lower portion of the gown is made of smooth black fabric with cascading vertical draping down the front and a short train.

3399.description: This is a black floor-length gown featuring a fitted silhouette and an asymmetrical one-shoulder and high illusion neckline. The right sleeve is sheer and heavily embellished with intricate silver beading and rhinestones extending across the bodice in a diagonal pattern, culminating in a jeweled cluster at the waist. The left sleeve is plain sheer fabric with a fitted cuff. The skirt incorporates side draping and falls into a short puddle train.

3401.description: This is a light sage green gown featuring an asymmetrical illusion neckline and one long sheer sleeved arm on the left, paired with a long fitted sleeve on the right. The bodice showcases dense diagonal draping intersected by a wide panel of heavy silver beading and crystal embellishment running across the chest. The skirt falls in straight, gathered vertical pleats down to the floor with minimal volume and no train.

3402.description: This champagne-colored gown features a fitted sheath silhouette with a plunging v-neckline and long, sheer sleeves. The bodice is densely covered in intricate beadwork and crystal embellishments forming ornate geometric patterns. Heavy vertical draping gathers at a central jewel-encrusted waist accent, flowing down into a soft, smooth skirt with a short train.

3403.description: This fitted long-sleeved gown features a high neckline and contrasting panel construction. A black and gold sequin fabric covers the lower skirt, one sleeve, and an upper diagonal portion of the bodice. A solid black draped fabric panel crosses over the bodice and cascades down the side into a short train.

3404.description: This champagne and nude gown features a fitted sheath silhouette with an illusion high neckline overlaying a v-neck bodice. The bodice and skirt incorporate heavy diagonal draping, contrasted on one side by dense vertical rows of metallic beading and sequins extending from the right shoulder down to the hem. Long, sheer bishop sleeves are finished with heavily beaded cuffs matching the bodice embellishment. The soft lightweight fabric flows downward into a short sweeping train.

3405.description: This champagne and nude colored sheath gown features long sheer bishop sleeves and an asymmetrical sheer illusion neckline. The bodice is heavily embellished with vertical lines of beading and sequins on one side, contrasting with smooth draped chiffon on the other side. The waistline features diagonal draping that extends down the skirt, while the right side of the skirt is entirely covered in dense beaded vertical stripes. The gown falls into a slim, fitted silhouette with a short chiffon train.

3406.description: This black gown features a fitted sheath silhouette with a high neckline and long sleeves. The underlying fabric is densely covered in vertical rows of silver beading and sequins. A sheer, pleated fabric drapes diagonally across the bodice and cascades down the front and back into a long train.

3407.description: This is a strapless sheath gown featuring a straight neckline and a fitted silhouette that follows the body lines down to a floor-length hem without a train. The entire dress is heavily embellished with dense beading, embroidery, and sequins forming an intricate, swirling wave-like pattern across an illusion mesh base over a champagne lining. The bodice is structured and fitted through the waist, seamlessly transitioning into the skirt.

3408.description: This is a sleeveless sheath gown featuring a scoop neckline with an illusion sheer panel at the upper chest and sides of the bodice. The entire dress is heavily embellished with intricate beading and embroidery forming elaborate damask-inspired patterns over a champagne and nude colored lining. A high thigh slit opens the front skirt, which falls in a straight line to a short train.

3409.description: This sleeveless gown features a fitted sheath silhouette in a silver colorway with heavy vertical beaded and sequined embellishments throughout. The neckline is a halter style. A high thigh-high slit is present on the front left leg. The gown falls straight to the floor with minimal volume and no visible train.

3411.description: This is a fitted trumpet gown featuring intricate, dense beading and crystal work in elaborate Art Deco-inspired scalloped and geometric patterns across the entire silhouette. It has a high illusion neckline and long sheer sleeves with gathered, puffed shoulders. The fitted bodice flows smoothly into a slim skirt that pools into a short, heavily embellished sheer train.

3412.description: This is a form-fitting lilac evening gown featuring an illusion scoop neckline and long sleeves with subtle gathering at the shoulder. The entire sheer-layered dress is densely covered in intricate silver and tonal beadwork and sequin embroidery forming swirling scrollwork and filigree patterns. The silhouette hugs the hips before flaring slightly at the hem into a short sweep train.

3415.description: This is a heavily beaded and embroidered trumpet gown featuring an illusion neckline and sheer long sleeves with subtle shoulder volume. The dense, intricate beaded patterns create vertical and ornate scrollwork designs across the entire fitted bodice and skirt. The gown has a nude base fabric overlaid with shimmering metallic beading and culminates in a short, sheer embellished train.

3418.description: This is a floor-length A-line gown featuring dense geometric beading and sequin embellishments arranged in diagonal and chevron patterns across the entire garment. The gown has a modest round scoop neckline, long fitted sleeves with slight gathering at the shoulders, and a defined waistline from which the voluminous skirt falls into deep pleats. The fabric is heavily embellished with reflective silver and gold beadwork over a champagne base. The back and train details are not visible.

3420.description: This is a fitted long-sleeved sheath gown featuring a high neckline, constructed from a black and gold sequin fabric arranged in geometric patterns. The bodice is accented with an asymmetric draped solid black fabric overlay that wraps across the waist and cascades into a long flowing overskirt and medium train.

3421.description: This fitted trumpet gown features a high illusion neckline and long sheer sleeves with gathered shoulders. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate beadwork, sequins, and metallic embroidery forming swirling leaf-like patterns over a champagne-colored base. A narrow beaded belt defines the waistline, while the skirt flows down into a short sweep train.

3423.description: This fitted sheath gown features a high neckline and long sleeves fully covered in dense, geometric sequin and beading embellishments. A smooth satin fabric is draped asymmetrically across the bodice and waist, extending into a medium overskirt and train. The underlying sheath silhouette maintains a continuous linear beaded pattern throughout the skirt.

3424.description: This is a black trumpet silhouette gown featuring dense silver beadwork and sequin embroidery in intricate geometric and damask-inspired patterns throughout the bodice, sleeves, and skirt. The garment has a sheer illusion scoop neckline with long sleeves and falls into a fitted skirt with a short train at the hem.

3425.description: This black gown features long sleeves, a fitted mermaid silhouette, and a high neckline. The entire dress is heavily embellished with dense silver beading and sequins in intricate geometric and baroque patterns. Sheer illusion panels are visible at the sides of the waist. The skirt falls closely to the body before flaring slightly at the hem with a short train.

3426.description: This fitted mermaid gown features an illusion high neckline with a sweetheart bodice underneath and sheer long sleeves. The dress is densely covered in heavy silver beading, sequins, and intricate geometric applique patterns spanning the entire length from the bodice down to the flared hem. Visible boning details structure the translucent corset-style midsection. The skirt extends into a medium-length train with matching heavily embellished linear and geometric designs.

3428.description: This is a fitted sheath gown in a champagne or nude tone, featuring a high neckline and long sheer sleeves with subtle shoulder padding. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate beadwork, sequins, and metallic embroidery forming geometric and linear patterns. The gown follows a straight silhouette that gently flares into a short puddle train at the floor.

3432.description: This is a heavily embellished mermaid gown featuring a high illusion neckline and sheer long sleeves. The dress is densely covered in intricate lace appliqués, beadwork, and embroidery that creates detailed geometric and floral patterns throughout the fitted bodice and skirt. The skirt flares out from the knee into a long, dramatic cathedral-length train with ornate lace edging. A matching sheer, embroidered cape or veil extends from the shoulders.

3433.description: This is a heavily embellished mermaid gown featuring a plunging V-neckline and long sleeves. The entire garment is densely covered in shimmering sequins, intricate beadwork, and embroidery forming geometric and swirling patterns. The silhouette fits closely through the bodice and hips before flaring out at the knees into a medium train with scalloped detailing at the hem.

3434.description: This blush-colored gown features a fitted bodice, long sleeves, and a modest scoop neckline. The entire surface of the dress is densely covered in intricate, wave-like patterns formed by fine white beading and embroidery. The skirt flows gracefully in an a-line silhouette, maintaining the wavy beaded embellishment all the way to the floor-length hem.

3435.description: This is a fitted sheath gown featuring long illusion sleeves and a combination sweetheart and V-neckline. The gown is constructed from an intricate lace fabric overlaid on a champagne-toned lining, with heavy asymmetrical draping gathered at the left hip and cascading downwards. Delicate beaded appliques accent the neckline and bodice. The hem finishes in a scalloped lace edge with a short train.

3436.description: This is a form-fitting mermaid gown featuring sheer illusion mesh over a nude lining. The garment is heavily embellished with dense swirling patterns of silver and gold beads and sequins across the entire bodice, sleeves, and skirt. It has long sheer sleeves and an illusion scoop neckline, flaring out slightly at the hem into a short train.

3437.description: This is a form-fitting mermaid gown featuring a high neckline and long sleeves in a nude and champagne tone. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate, silver beaded and sequined embroidery forming organic leaf and vine patterns. The skirt hugs the hips before flaring slightly at the hem into a short, embellished train.

3438.description: This is a full-length, long-sleeved mermaid gown featuring a high neckline and dense, all-over embellishments including lace, embroidery, beadwork, sequins, and dimensional appliqués. The fitted silhouette traces the body closely down to the knees before flaring out into a structured skirt with a medium train. The bodice and sleeves are fully covered with intricate beadwork and floral-inspired embroidery, creating a lavish, high-coverage look. A matching sheer veil frames the garment.

3439.description: This is a floor-length mermaid gown featuring a high neckline and long sleeves with subtle shoulder volume. The dress is densely covered in heavy silver beading, sequins, and embroidery forming intricate flame or feather-like vertical patterns across the bodice, sleeves, and skirt. The fitted silhouette flares out at the bottom into a ruffled, semi-sheer train with matching embellishments.

3440.description: This is a form-fitting mermaid gown featuring a high illusion neckline and long sleeves. The dress is constructed from a black base fabric completely covered in dense sequin and bead embellishments arranged in a sweeping, asymmetric metallic gold and bronze linear pattern. The fitted silhouette flares into a dramatic floor-sweeping train with sheer black tulle ruffles at the hem. The back details match the front with continuing sequin patterns.

3441.description: This is a floor-length trumpet gown featuring long sleeves and a high neckline. The garment is heavily covered in intricate silver beadwork and embroidery forming geometric and swirling patterns over a champagne-colored base. The silhouette is fitted through the hips and thighs before flaring subtly at the hem with a short train.

3442.description: This fitted mermaid gown features an illusion high-neckline and long sheer sleeves constructed from fine netting. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate silver and crystal beading, embroidery, and sequins forming symmetrical geometric and swirling patterns that trace the torso and hips. The fitted silhouette flares slightly at the knees into a moderate, structured train edged with matching beadwork. The overall design offers full coverage while maintaining a translucent, highly embellished effect.

3444.description: This fitted mermaid gown features a high illusion neckline and long sheer sleeves heavily detailed with vertical rows of beading and crystal embroidery. The bodice is densely covered in intricate beadwork creating geometric patterns, complemented by a large structured organza bow accenting the right shoulder. The skirt is crafted from patterned lace overlaid with scattered crystal beading, flaring out slightly at the hem into a medium sweep train.

3445.description: This champagne and nude long-sleeve gown features an illusion scoop neckline and a fitted a-line silhouette that falls into a short train. The sheer tulle fabric is densely covered in intricate beaded and pearl patterns that swirl across the bodice and cascade vertically down the skirt and sleeves. The garment provides full coverage with long sheer sleeves and a high illusion neckline.

3446.description: This fitted mermaid gown features a sheer illusion high neckline with dense silver beadwork, embroidery, and sequin embellishments arranged in ornate symmetrical patterns across the entire bodice and long sleeves. The heavy embellishment continues down the fitted skirt, creating a dramatic focal point before flaring out into a medium-length train with a decorative hem. The underlying fabric appears to be a neutral champagne or nude tone overlaid with sheer mesh and intricate metallic beadwork.

3447.description: This A-line gown features a nude and champagne undertone overlaid with sheer tulle. The bodice and long sleeves are densely covered in intricate silver beading and embroidery, forming swirling patterns over an illusion neckline with a sweetheart shape beneath. The skirt falls with medium volume to the floor, displaying cascading beaded and embroidered scrollwork motifs that taper toward the hem. A short train trails behind the gown.

3449.description: This champagne and nude colored a-line gown features an illusion scoop neckline with long sleeves and heavy overall embellishment. The bodice and skirt are densely covered with intricate beading, sequins, and embroidery in flowing, curved vertical patterns that create a textured, shimmering surface over a patterned base fabric. The skirt flows outward with medium volume into a short train.

3450.description: This fitted mermaid gown features an illusion neckline over a sweetheart bodice with long sleeves. The entire dress is heavily embellished with dense beading and sequins arranged in radiating linear and geometric patterns across the torso and sleeves. The lower skirt transitions into a layered lace hemline and extends into a medium chapel train.

3452.description: This is a fitted mermaid gown featuring a sheer illusion high neckline with long sleeves, heavily embellished throughout with dense silver beading, vertical linear embroidery, sequins, and scattered colorful gemstones in red, blue, and green. The beadwork creates vertical linear patterns over the entire garment, transitioning into a fitted silhouette that flares at the bottom into a long, detailed train with textured edging.

3453.description: This champagne-toned mermaid gown features an illusion neckline with long sleeves and heavy overall beadwork and embroidery. The dense crystal and sequin embellishments radiate in curved patterns from a focal point at the hip, creating a sculpted effect over a lace base. The dress hugs the body closely before flaring out slightly at the hem with a short train.

3454.description: This ivory trumpet gown features a high neckline and long sheer sleeves. The garment is heavily covered in intricate vertical beaded embroidery combined with dense floral appliques concentrated more heavily on the left shoulder and cascading down the bodice and skirt. The fitted silhouette flares slightly at the hem into a medium lace-trimmed train.

3456.description: This fitted trumpet gown features a sheer illusion neckline and long sleeves completely covered in intricate linear beading, sequins, and embroidery. The beadwork follows geometric and architectural curved patterns down the bodice and skirt. The dress falls into a dramatic flared hem with an extensive train featuring linear beaded embellishments on sheer fabric.

3457.description: This is a champagne-colored mermaid gown featuring an illusion scoop neckline and long sleeves. The dress is densely covered in intricate beaded and sequin embroidery in ornamental and damask patterns over sheer fabric. It fits closely through the torso and hips before flaring out into a voluminous skirt with a long, heavily embellished train.

3459.description: This fitted mermaid gown features a high illusion neckline and long sleeves, completely covered in dense beading, sequins, and silver embroidery over an ivory and champagne base. The beadwork forms intricate swirling patterns across the bodice, arms, and flared skirt. The gown hugs the figure before flaring out at the knees into a medium train with heavy embellishment along the hem.

3460.description: This ivory mermaid gown features a fitted silhouette with an illusion high-neckline and long sleeves. The dress is heavily embellished with intricate beading, embroidery, and dimensional floral appliques arranged in elaborate swirling patterns over a sheer mesh base. The skirt falls close to the body before flaring slightly at the hem with a short train.

3462.description: This is a form-fitting mermaid gown featuring a high neckline and sheer long sleeves. The dress is densely covered in intricate, geometric silver beading and embroidery radiating from the bodice and waistline, creating a sunburst pattern. The illusion tulle underlayer has a champagne tone, supporting the heavy beadwork throughout the skirt which flares out into a medium train with ruffled hem detailing.

3463.description: This is a trumpet-silhouette gown featuring an illusion high neckline and long sheer sleeves. The garment is heavily covered in intricate beaded and embroidered swirling patterns that create an organic, vine-like layout across the bodice, sleeves, and skirt. The fitted skirt flares out near the bottom into a ruffled hemline with a short train.

3464.description: This is a fitted mermaid gown in a champagne or nude color, featuring a high illusion neckline and long sleeves. The entire surface is densely covered in intricate silver and crystal beading, sequins, and embroidery arranged in geometric chevron and radiating starburst patterns. The gown follows a streamlined silhouette through the torso and hips before flaring out slightly at the hem with a short train.

3465.description: This is a heavily beaded champagne-colored trumpet gown with an illusion high neckline overlaying a sweetheart bodice. It features long, sheer sleeves with gathering at the shoulders and dense crystal and bead embroidery arranged in intricate geometric and scrolling patterns across the entire garment. The silhouette fits closely through the hips before flaring out into a voluminous multi-layered tulle train trimmed with beading.

3466.description: This is a fitted, straight-silhouette gown featuring a sheer illusion scoop neckline and long sheer sleeves. The entire dress is heavily embellished with intricate vertical and radiating patterns of gold and silver beading and sequins over a nude-toned base layer. The garment falls closely to the body before flaring slightly at the floor with a short sweep train.

3467.description: This blush-colored gown features a fitted sheath silhouette with a sheer illusion one-shoulder neckline and bishop-style long sleeves. The bodice showcases intricate diagonal pleating and draping overlaid on semi-sheer panels, accented by lines of fine beading. A pleated overlay extends from the waistline to form a medium-length train, while the underlying skirt falls straight to the floor in lightweight fabric.

3468.description: This light blue gown features a sheer illusion neckline and sheer long bishop sleeves with fitted cuffs. The semi-sheer bodice displays exposed boning and dense floral applique and beading over the chest. The waist features horizontal draping forming a knot detail at the center, flowing into a slim fitted skirt made of smooth fabric that falls straight to the floor without a train.

3469.description: This champagne and nude colored a-line gown features an illusion neckline combined with off-shoulder draped sleeves. The sheer bodice is heavily embellished with three-dimensional floral appliques and beaded accents concentrated across the chest and waist. Long sheer sleeves feature beaded cuffs. The skirt is made of a shimmering, lightweight fabric that falls in soft pleats to a short train.

3471.description: This grey gown features a straight sheath silhouette with long sleeves and an illusion v-neckline. The entire garment is densely covered in vertical lines of beading and sequins. The skirt falls straight to the floor with a short sweep train at the back.

3472.description: This is a fully embellished long-sleeved sheath gown with a fitted silhouette in a champagne or gold tone. The garment features intricate beaded and sequined embroidery arranged in dense, symmetrical geometric patterns radiating across the bodice and skirt. The neckline is a modest scoop, and the long sleeves feature light gathering or structuring at the shoulders. A subtle front or side slit is visible near the hemline.

3473.description: This trumpet gown features a sheer illusion high neckline and long sheer sleeves, entirely covered in dense beaded and sequined embroidery. The beading follows geometric and sunburst ray patterns radiating from focal points at the bodice and hips. The gown has a fitted silhouette through the body and flares subtly into a short train at the hem.

3474.description: This blue trumpet gown features an illusion scoop neckline and long sheer sleeves with intricate heavy silver beading and embroidery throughout the bodice, sleeves, and skirt. The garment falls closely to the body before flaring gently at the hem into a short sweep train.

3476.description: This black gown features a high neckline and long sleeves, falling into a fitted trumpet silhouette. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate silver beadwork and sequin embroidery in geometric and vertical patterns. The cuffs and the hemline are accented with black feathers.

3478.description: This champagne and nude gown features a fitted a-line silhouette covered entirely in vertical rows of dense beading and sequins. The bodice has a v-neckline with diagonal overlapping beaded stripes that create a faux-wrap appearance. Long, sheer sleeves are also thoroughly covered in vertical beaded lines down to the wrists. A defined beaded band encircles the natural waistline, below which the skirt falls straight to the floor into a short, subtle sweep train.

3479.description: This champagne and blush gown features a fitted sheath underlayer with a square neckline and long sheer sleeves, heavily encrusted with dense silver beading and sequins across the bodice down to mid-thigh. An attached, voluminous overskirt with star-like beaded motifs extends into a medium train. The garment provides full coverage with intricate, sparkling embellishments covering the entirety of the silhouette.

3481.description: This light sage-green floor-length gown features an asymmetrical one-shoulder neckline with a sheer illusion panel creating a high-neck effect. The bodice and skirt are constructed with fine, diagonal fabric draping across the front. A prominent diagonal band of dense, silver beading and crystal embellishment runs across the bodice. The long sleeves are sheer and gathered into fitted cuffs at the wrists. The skirt falls straight to the floor with continuous vertical pleating and no visible train.

3482.description: This champagne ball gown features an illusion neckline with long sleeves and heavy intricate beadwork and embroidery across the entire bodice and skirt. The voluminous skirt displays elaborate beaded scrollwork and flourishes extending downward toward a lace-trimmed hemline. The gown includes a structured bodice with defined waist shaping and a medium-length train.

3483.description: This ivory A-line gown features an all-over floral lace pattern accented with delicate beading. It has a fitted bodice with a high mandarin collar and a row of small covered buttons extending down the center front. The long sleeves are fitted through the arm, and the voluminous skirt flows outward to the floor with a clean hemline.

3485.description: This is a full-length, fitted sheath gown in a light blue metallic fabric with a subtle sheen. The bodice features diagonal pleating and draping that originates from a rhinestone-encrusted brooch accent at the right hip. The long sleeves are semi-sheer with volume, gathered into fitted cuffs. The skirt falls straight to the floor with minimal pooling and a clean hem.

3487.description: This is a fitted sheath gown featuring dense beaded embellishments covering the entirety of the garment in draped swag patterns. It has a high neckline and long sleeves. The dress falls straight to the floor with a minimal volume skirt and ends in a short train.

3488.description: This is a black floor-length fitted gown featuring a high neckline and long sheer sleeves with heavy beadwork. The dress is densely embellished with intricate black beading arranged in curving, cascading patterns across the bodice, torso, and skirt. The bodice includes a sweetheart-shaped underlay beneath an illusion high-neck netting. The silhouette is sleek and narrow, falling straight to the floor with a clean hem.

3489.description: This is a long-sleeved, a-line gown featuring an illusion round neckline with a sheer mesh yoke. The bodice showcases diagonal draping overlaid with dense silver beading forming abstract, sweeping patterns. The skirt falls straight to the floor in a minimalist silhouette, completely covered in vertical beaded waves. It ends in a short sweep train.

3490.description: This is a champagne and nude colored mermaid gown featuring an illusion neckline and long sleeves. The dress is heavily embellished with intricate silver sequin and bead embroidery forming leaf or vine patterns across the bodice, sleeves, and skirt. The fitted silhouette flares out at the bottom into a short train.

3492.description: This navy blue mermaid gown features a fitted silhouette that flares into a medium train with ruffled edges. The dress is fully covered in heavy beadwork, sequins, and intricate embroidery in matching dark tones. It has a high neckline and long sheer sleeves with matching embellishments concentrated down the arms and bodice, incorporating visible vertical boning details on the bodice.

3493.description: This green mermaid gown features a high neckline and long sheer sleeves. The garment is heavily covered in dense sequin and bead work forming large swirling floral and abstract motifs throughout the bodice and skirt. The hemline and lower skirt flare are finished with dense feather trim extending into a short train.

3494.description: This fitted sheath gown features a scoop neckline and long sleeves, fully covered in intricate silver and clear beading with interspersed emerald green accents forming geometric swirls and vertical lines. The garment falls straight to the floor with minimal volume and finishes in a short beaded train. The fabric is a champagne-toned sheer base densely layered with sparkling beadwork throughout the bodice, sleeves, and skirt.

3495.description: This green gown features a fitted trumpet silhouette with long sleeves and a high neckline. The bodice and sleeves are heavily embellished with intricate beadwork and dimensional floral appliques cascading down the front. Feathers accent the sleeves and descend from the hip area down to the hemline, creating a textured finish that flows into a short train.

3496.description: This fitted mermaid gown features heavy, intricate silver beadwork and sequin embroidery in elaborate geometric patterns across the entire silhouette. It has a V-neckline and long sleeves covered in dense linear bead details. The skirt hugs the figure and flares slightly at the hem with a short circular train featuring matching radiating beadwork.

3497.description: This champagne and nude colored a-line gown features long sleeves and a high illusion neckline. The bodice and skirt are heavily embellished with dense crystal beading, silver embroidery, and sequined applique arranged in intricate leaf and vine patterns over a lace base layer. The full skirt falls to the floor with a short train, maintaining moderate volume.

3498.description: This champagne and ivory a-line gown features an illusion scoop neckline with long sleeves and heavy ornamentation. The entire bodice and sleeves are covered in dense floral beading, embroidery, and 3D floral appliques over a sweetheart shaped lining. The full skirt falls from a structured waistband with vertical beading, cascading into elaborate floral lace patterns down to a medium train.

3499.description: This champagne and ivory trumpet gown is heavily embellished with dense beading, sequins, and dimensional appliques covering the entire surface in an intricate geometric pattern. It features a high illusion neckline with a jewel-encrusted collar and long, sheer fitted sleeves. The skirt follows a fitted silhouette that gently flares near the hem into a medium sweep train featuring matching embellished details. The bodice is structured with full coverage, long sleeves, and a column-like skirt shape.

3501.description: This green fitted sheath gown features a high neckline and long sheer sleeves with gathered shoulders. The entire dress is densely covered in geometric patterns of silver beading and sequins. A thick satin sash wraps horizontally across the waist with a side knot accent and diagonal draped folds. The skirt follows a slim silhouette, flaring slightly at the hem with a short train.

3502.description: This is a fitted mermaid gown featuring an illusion one-shoulder neckline and long sleeves. The fabric is heavily embellished with intricate swirling beadwork, sequins, and embroidery forming organic leaf or flame patterns across the entire silhouette. A dimensional floral applique sits centrally on the asymmetric bodice. The skirt hugs the figure closely before flaring at the hem into a short sweep train patterned with matching metallic beadwork.

3503.description: This is a long-sleeved sheath gown in a muted green shade, featuring a high illusion neckline. The garment is heavily covered in dense beadwork and sequin embellishments arranged in sweeping, organic patterns across the bodice, sleeves, and skirt. A prominent gathered fabric overlay with layered ruffles drapes from the left hip down the side of the skirt. The silhouette is fitted through the hips and thighs, falling straight to the floor with a subtle short train.

3504.description: This is a fitted sheath gown in champagne and gold tones, featuring a floor-length silhouette with a short train. The neckline is a sheer illusion scoop over a sweetheart bodice shape, paired with long sheer sleeves. Heavy beadwork and intricate embroidery cover the entire dress in geometric and scroll patterns. The fabric falls straight with minimal volume.

3505.description: This black and silver gown features a sheath silhouette with a high neck and long, off-shoulder sleeves. The garment is heavily covered in intricate silver beadwork and embroidery forming ornate patterns across the bodice, sleeves, and skirt. Cold-shoulder cut-outs reveal the upper arms, accented with small draped elements. The skirt falls straight to the floor, terminating in a short embellished train.

3506.description: This trumpet-silhouette gown features an illusion high-neckline and long sleeves, fully covered in intricate, swirling beaded and sequined embroidery patterns over a champagne-toned fabric. The beadwork creates dense, organic linear motifs that cascade down the fitted bodice and flare out through the skirt. The skirt extends into a medium-length train edged with matching embellished details. The bodice is sheer with a sweetheart-shaped illusion panel on the chest.

3507.description: This fitted mermaid gown features an illusion high neckline and long sleeves crafted on sheer tulle. It is heavily embellished with intricate swirling beadwork, sequins, and embroidery forming symmetrical patterns over the entire garment. The gown includes an illusion cutout detail at the bodice and falls into a flared skirt with a medium sweep train.

3508.description: This is a heavily embellished trumpet gown featuring full-length sheer sleeves and an illusion neckline framing a sweetheart base. The entire gown is dense with intricate silver beading, embroidery, and sequins forming swirling filigree and floral-inspired patterns. The silhouette fits closely through the hips before flaring slightly at the hem into a short sweep train.

3509.description: This fitted trumpet gown features a high neckline and long sleeves. The dress is densely embellished with intricate swirling patterns of beads and sequins over a sheer nude and champagne underlayer. The silhouette hugs the figure before flaring slightly at the hem with a short train.

3510.description: This fitted floor-length gown features an illusion scoop neckline and long sheer sleeves, crafted from a nude-toned sheer mesh base. The dress is densely covered in intricate silver beadwork and embroidery forming symmetrical, flowing scrollwork and diamond lattice patterns that trace the curves of the body. The beadwork cascades down to the hem, intensifying into ornate clustered motifs around the lower skirt and extending into a short sweep train.

3511.description: This champagne and nude a-line gown features an illusion high neckline overlaying a sweetheart v-neckline bodice. Long sheer sleeves and the entire dress are densely embellished with vertical lines of beads and pearls creating a radiant pattern. The skirt falls softly to the floor with moderate volume and ends in a short train.

3513.description: This champagne and nude mermaid gown features an illusion high neckline with long sleeves, fully covered in intricate beadwork, embroidery, and sequins in swirling, ornate patterns. The heavily embellished fitted bodice transitions into a flared skirt that extends into a medium chapel train. The dense ornamentation covers the entire silhouette from the collar to the hemline, creating a high-shine, textured finish.

3515.description: This champagne-colored a-line gown features an illusion v-neckline and long sleeves, densely covered in intricate beading, sequins, and embroidery. The fitted bodice showcases vertical crystal-encrusted detailing and a sheer structure, transitioning at the waist into a flowing skirt with cascading beaded leaf and feather-like appliques over a patterned lace underlayer. The gown falls to the floor with a medium volume and no visible train, maintaining heavy embellishment throughout.

3516.description: This champagne-colored a-line gown features an illusion neckline with long sleeves and heavy silver beadwork arranged in ornate, symmetrical baroque patterns. The beaded designs trace the bodice, waist, and cascade down the skirt to the hem, adding dense texture and sparkle. The gown falls to the floor in soft folds with a short, light train.

3517.description: This champagne colored a-line gown features an illusion neckline and long bishop sleeves with gathered cuffs. The fitted bodice is heavily embellished with intricate gold embroidery and beading over a sheer mesh base. The skirt falls in soft, vertical folds to the floor with a minimal volume and no train.

3519.description: This champagne-toned sheath gown features heavy, dense beadwork and sequin embroidery in elaborate geometric swirl patterns across the entire silhouette. The bodice has a distinct peplum overlay trimmed with hanging beaded fringe at the lower edge. It is styled with a scoop neckline and long, fitted sleeves featuring slight gathering at the shoulders. The skirt falls straight to the floor into a short train covered entirely in the same sparkling embellishments.

3520.description: This champagne and gold mermaid gown features an all-over heavy embellishment of dense beading, sequins, and embroidery creating intricate geometric and swirling patterns. The bodice has an illusion scoop neckline and long, fitted sleeves with slight volume at the shoulders. A beaded peplum-style overlay detail sits at the hips, transitioning into a fitted skirt that flares slightly at the hem with a short train.

3521.description: This is a form-fitting trumpet style gown featuring an illusion off-shoulder neckline and sheer long sleeves. The dress is densely covered in intricate silver and champagne beading, embroidery, and sequin work in ornate scroll and linear patterns. The beadwork creates structured vertical and geometric arrays down the fitted bodice and flares out into the skirt which flows into a short train.

3522.description: This fitted sheath gown features a high illusion neckline and long sleeves, fully covered in intricate silver beadwork, sequins, and embroidery arranged in geometric and chevron patterns throughout. The garment is heavily embellished with crystal bead strands and features scattered dark burgundy or jewel-toned embellishments across the bodice and skirt. A contrasting deep burgundy train flows from behind the fitted gown, extending onto the floor. The dress offers full coverage with a structured fit extending down to the floor-length hemline.

3523.description: This is a fitted sheath gown featuring an illusion neckline with a deep v-neck bodice overlay. The bodice is heavily embellished with vertical crystal and bead patterns over a corset-style structure. Long, sheer bishop sleeves feature gathered cuffs tied with fabric bows. The skirt is crafted from draped chiffon, wrapping asymmetrically across the hips into a knotted drape detail at the front, falling into a medium sweep train.

3525.description: This is a fitted long-sleeve mermaid gown featuring an illusion scoop neckline and heavy beadwork. The garment is densely covered in silver beading, sequins, and embroidery in intricate leaf and vine patterns over a greyish-champagne mesh base. The silhouette fits closely through the hips and thighs before flaring out at the hem into a short sweep train.

3526.description: This fitted long-sleeve gown features an illusion sweetheart neckline and sheer lace sleeves. The bodice and skirt showcase intricate layered draping with a gathered center knot detail and cascading fabric panels. Allover lace fabric covers the gown with delicate beadwork accents, falling into a short sweep train.

3527.description: This champagne and nude long-sleeved a-line gown features an illusion scoop neckline and full coverage throughout the bodice and arms. Dense linear and geometric beading and embroidery are intricately patterned across the bodice, sleeves, and skirt, creating a radiant texture that cascades downward. The tulle skirt falls with medium volume into a short sweep train. The garment is entirely covered in elaborate beadwork.

3541.description: This fitted trumpet gown features a high illusion neckline and long sleeves, fully covered in dense, geometric beadwork and pearl embellishments. The champagne-colored fabric contours the figure closely before flaring out slightly at the hem into a short sweep train. Intricate linear and diamond bead patterns map across the entire bodice and sleeves, creating a heavily textured, sparkling finish.

3543.description: This is a heavily embellished trumpet gown featuring an all-over dense pattern of intricate silver beading and embroidery on a nude or champagne base. The neckline is a modest scoop and the sleeves are long and fitted. Dense, voluminous ruffles cascade down the skirt from the hip level, creating a dramatic layered texture that pools slightly into a short train at the floor.

3544.description: This fitted trumpet gown features a high neckline and long sleeves, rendered entirely in a champagne-toned fabric densely encrusted with intricate silver and gold beading. Feathers are heavily incorporated, cascading along one sleeve and sweeping asymmetrically across the bodice and skirt alongside beaded scroll patterns. The gown hugs the figure closely through the torso and hips before flaring subtly at the floor into a long, dramatic train edged with feathers and beadwork.

3545.description: This fitted trumpet gown features a high illusion neckline and long sheer sleeves, heavily encrusted with geometric beadwork and sequins over a nude and champagne base. The bodice showcases an intricate high collar bead necklace effect with a sweetheart neckline illusion underneath. Dense vertical and diamond-patterned crystal beadwork cascades down the length of the gown, transitioning into a slight flared hem with a short train.

3548.description: This fitted trumpet gown features a high illusion neckline with a structured choker-style collar and long sleeves. The entire dress is densely covered in vertical and curved patterns of tonal pink and lilac sequins and beading that sweep across the bodice and flare into a short train at the floor.

3549.description: This is a fully embellished champagne-colored fitted gown featuring a mermaid silhouette. The dress has an illusion scoop neckline with long sheer sleeves and intricate linear and geometric beadwork distributed densely throughout the bodice, waist, and skirt. The beadwork follows structured patterns creating vertical lines that accentuate the form down to a short train.

3550.description: This champagne and gold gown features a fitted trumpet silhouette covered entirely in intricate geometric beading and embroidery. It has a sheer illusion neckline layered over a v-neck shape with long sleeves and heavy overall bead embellishment. A dramatic side overskirt in smooth fabric drapes from a crystal embellishment at the waist down into a short train.

3552.description: This fitted mermaid gown features a champagne-toned sheer mesh base entirely covered in dense silver beading, sequins, and embroidery arranged in intricate geometric and swirling patterns. The bodice has an illusion high neckline overlaying a plunging v-neckline shape, and the long sleeves are fitted with matching embellishments throughout. The skirt hugs the figure closely before flaring gently at the hem with a short train.

3554.description: This is a heavily beaded long-sleeve mermaid gown featuring a V-neckline. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate beadwork arranged in geometric and linear patterns that contour the body. It has long, fitted sleeves and falls closely to the figure before flaring out slightly at the hem with a short train.

3555.description: This green fitted gown features a scoop neckline and long sleeves. The bodice includes diagonal pleating and dense beaded embroidery. Feathers are incorporated along the cuffs and heavily clustered around the lower skirt and short train.

3556.description: This fitted mermaid gown features an asymmetrical arrangement of dense beadwork and embroidery forming swirling linear patterns across the bodice, illusion neckline, and long sleeves. A sheer illusion mesh base supports the heavily embellished olive green fabric. Large, voluminous gathered tulle ruffles drape over the left hip and cascade down the skirt to a moderate train.

3562.description: This fitted trumpet gown features a square neckline and long sleeves. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate beaded and sequined embroidery forming ornate, swirling patterns over a champagne-colored base. The silhouette contours the body closely before flaring slightly at the hem into a short train.

3563.description: This champagne and nude mermaid gown features an illusion high-neckline over a sweetheart bodice with long sleeves. The entire silhouette is densely covered in intricate silver beading, sequins, and embroidery forming elaborate swirling and floral patterns. The fitted bodice transitions smoothly down the hips before flaring slightly at the hem with a short train.

3564.description: This is a floor-length sheath gown featuring full coverage with a high scoop neckline and long sleeves. The entire surface of the garment is heavily embellished with intricate geometric patterns created from dense gold beading and sequins over a sheer nude lining. The skirt follows a straight, fitted silhouette downwards before pooling into a short sheer tulle train at the floor.

3565.description: This is a fitted sheath gown featuring long sleeves and a scoop neckline. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate silver and clear beading arranged in geometric and cascading patterns over a champagne lining. The skirt falls straight to the floor with minimal volume, trailing into a short sweep train at the back.

3567.description: This trumpet gown features heavy gold and silver sequin and bead embroidery in a wavy, swirling pattern spanning the entire silhouette. The neckline is a high illusion style with sheer long sleeves and draped pleated chiffon capes falling from the shoulders to the floor. The gown has a fitted bodice that transitions smoothly into a slim trumpet skirt with a short train. The heavy beadwork provides dense overall embellishment against a champagne base fabric.

3571.description: This fitted trumpet gown features a high scoop neckline and long sleeves. The entire surface is densely covered in geometric patterns of sequins and beads in multicolored tones including gold, blue, purple, and silver. The silhouette hugs the figure through the hips before flaring slightly at the hem with a short sweep train.

3575.description: This is a black floor-length gown featuring a straight sheath silhouette with a short train. The bodice has diagonal draping across the front and an asymmetrical one-shoulder neckline with sheer long sleeves ending in fitted cuffs. An ornate beaded floral applique adorns the right shoulder and sheer upper chest area. A wide vertical panel of accordion pleating runs down the right side of the skirt, contrasting with the smooth fabric of the main body.

3580.description: This fitted mermaid gown features a black base overlaid with an intricate swirl pattern of metallic gold, silver, and black beadwork and sequins forming abstract vertical motifs. It has sheer long sleeves and an illusion high scoop neckline. The skirt fits closely through the hips and thighs before flaring out into a sheer tulle train embellished with sweeping beaded lines.

3582.description: This floor-length gown features a fitted bodice with a scoop neckline and long sleeves, falling into a medium-volume a-line skirt without a train. The entire garment is heavily embellished with intricate silver embroidery, sequins, and beadwork creating ornate patterns over an ivory base fabric. An additional draped fabric panel extends across the bodice diagonally from the shoulder.

3583.description: This champagne and nude gown features an a-line silhouette crafted from sheer tulle overlaid with intricate silver beading and embroidery. The bodice has an illusion neckline and long sheer sleeves densely covered in vertical and curved beaded patterns that trace the torso. The skirt falls softly to the floor with radiating beaded stripes descending from the waist into a short train.

3585.description: This champagne and nude colored a-line gown features a high neckline and long sleeves. The dress is densely covered in intricate beaded detailing arranged in vertical wavy patterns across the entire garment, from the bodice down to the floor-length hem. The skirt falls with medium volume and terminates in a clean hem with no train.

3586.description: This is a floor-length trumpet gown in champagne with heavy silver embroidery, beading, and sequin work creating intricate patterns across the entire garment. It features a high illusion neckline and long sheer sleeves densely covered in beadwork. The embellishment follows vertical and ornamental motifs that flow down the fitted silhouette to a flared hem with a medium length train.

3588.description: This fitted sheath gown features heavy, intricate geometric and floral beading, embroidery, and sequins in a champagne and gold palette. The bodice combines a sweetheart neckline with square-cut straps and sheer side cut-outs at the waist. The skirt falls straight to the floor with a high front-left side slit edged with beaded fringe, leading into a short train.

3589.description: This fitted trumpet gown features a sheer midriff panel and a square neckline with short sleeves. The entire garment is densely embellished with beadwork, sequins, and dimensional appliques over a nude and champagne base. The skirt includes a central front slit and falls into a short train.

3590.description: This fitted sheath dress features a square neckline and cap sleeves adorned with beaded fringe. The garment is heavily embellished with dense gold beading, sequins, and embroidery in an intricate geometric art-deco pattern over a nude illusion base. The skirt falls straight to a midi length with a sheer beaded hemline and no train.

3591.description: This is a fitted trumpet silhouette gown featuring a square neckline and cap sleeves. The bodice and skirt are densely embellished with intricate beadwork and sequins arranged in geometric and radiating patterns over sheer fabric, including an illusion cutout at the midsection. The gown falls smoothly to the floor and finishes with a short sheer train.

3596.description: This fitted sheath gown features heavy, dense beadwork and sequin embroidery arranged in directional geometric patterns across the entire silhouette. It has long sleeves, an illusion scoop neckline, and a defined waistline. A high front slit extends up the lower skirt, which falls straight down with no discernible train.

3597.description: This is a fitted sheath gown covered entirely in vertical lines of dense gold beading and sequins. The neckline features an asymmetric illusion construction with a diagonal strap detail across the right shoulder. Sheer, floor-length tulle capes are attached at the shoulders, cascading down the back and sides. The dress falls straight to the floor with minimal volume and no visible train.

3598.description: This fitted mermaid gown features a sheer champagne base completely covered in dense gold and silver beadwork and sequins arranged in geometric diamond and triangle patterns. It has a structured square neckline and long sleeves. The dress fits closely through the hips before flaring slightly at the hem with a short train.

3599.description: This fitted trumpet gown features a one-shoulder neckline with an asymmetrical illusion bodice and a curved semi-sheer cutout detail. The entire garment is densely covered in vertical and curved patterns of silver and champagne sequins and beading. It has one long sleeve and falls into a sleek, floor-length hemline without a noticeable train.

3600.description: This is a pale green gown featuring a fitted sheath silhouette with lightweight, flowing fabric. The bodice showcases asymmetrical diagonal draping across the front paired with a structured, beaded panel on the upper right side featuring floral crystal and bead embellishments. The dress has thin straps, a square-cut asymmetrical neckline, and falls smoothly to the floor into a short train.

3601.description: This black gown features a fitted sheath silhouette with a straight skirt that falls to the floor, accented by a high side slit on the left leg. The sheer illusion bodice has a scoop neckline and is sleeveless, heavily decorated with dense gold, bronze, and black embroidery and beading across the front. The lower skirt is rendered in a smooth, opaque black fabric with minimal embellishment. The back and train details are not visible in the image.

3602.description: This is a fitted sheath gown featuring long sleeves and a scoop neckline. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate beaded and sequin embroidery forming swirling scrollwork patterns. A center-front slit opens the lower skirt. The silhouette closely follows the lines of the body with minimal volume and no train.

3603.description: This champagne and nude gown features an a-line silhouette crafted from layered tulle. The illusion neckline reveals a sweetheart bodice underneath, paired with long sheer sleeves having slight gathering at the shoulders. Dense beadwork and crystal embroidery cover the bodice in geometric patterns, transitioning into swirling, vine-like beaded motifs that cascade down the full skirt. The skirt flows into a short tulle train.

3604.description: This fitted trumpet gown is densely covered in shimmering sequins and beading over a champagne-toned fabric. The square neckline and cap sleeves feature matching heavy embellishment. Diagonal draping across the hips accentuates the fitted silhouette before flowing down to a straight hemline with no train.

3606.description: This fitted sheath gown features a square neckline with wide straps and is densely covered in heavy beaded and sequined embellishments throughout. The waist is defined by a structured, corset-style patterned band with vertical beading. A high thigh-length slit on the front left adds a contrasting element to the heavily embellished floor-length skirt.

3607.description: This fitted sheath gown in a lilac hue features a high neckline and long sleeves. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate geometric patterns made of vertical beaded lines and reflective sequins that create a striking diamond motif across the bodice. The cuffs and the floor-length hem are finished with matching purple feathers, adding textural contrast. The silhouette is straight and tapers slightly at the hem with no visible train.

3612.description: This is a champagne and nude colored mermaid gown featuring dense beadwork, embroidery, and sequin embellishments arranged in vertical swirled patterns across the entire silhouette. It has an illusion sweetheart neckline with long sheer sleeves and structured bodice detailing. The skirt flares out slightly at the hem with a short train.

3619.description: This is a heavily embellished a-line gown featuring an illusion high neckline and long sleeves. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate beadwork, sequins, and embroidery forming elaborate baroque and swirling patterns across the bodice, sleeves, and skirt. The skirt has a medium volume that flows into a short train at the back.

3620.description: This champagne and nude mermaid gown features an illusion high-neckline and long sleeves. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate swirling beadwork, embroidery, and dimensional floral applique details that follow the contours of the silhouette. The skirt fits closely through the hips before flaring gracefully at the hem into a short sweep train.

3621.description: This fitted mermaid gown features long sheer sleeves and an illusion high neckline. The entire surface is heavily embellished with intricate silver beadwork, embroidery, and sequins arranged in ornate baroque patterns over a champagne lining. The skirt flares slightly below the knees into a medium-length sheer train with embroidered motifs along the hem.

3622.description: This is a champagne-colored mermaid gown featuring an illusion scoop neckline and long sleeves. The dress is densely covered in intricate beadwork, silver embroidery, and sequins forming sweeping, curved, and abstract linear patterns across the bodice, sleeves, and skirt. The fitted silhouette hugs the body down to the knees before flaring out into a short tulle train edged with matching beadwork.

3623.description: This champagne and nude colored trumpet gown features heavy crystal beading, silver embroidery, and sequin embellishments arranged in elaborate swirling and geometric patterns over the entire fitted silhouette. The upper bodice has an illusion scoop and v-neckline design with sheer long sleeves. The dress falls closely to the body, flaring slightly at the hem with a short train adorned with vertical beaded fringe details.

3625.description: This ivory and nude trumpet gown features a high neckline and long sleeves with flared cuffs. The structured bodice and skirt are heavily adorned with dimensional floral appliques, beading, and intricate lacework, accented by diagonal draping across the torso. The skirt falls into a flared silhouette extending into a medium sweep train.

3626.description: This champagne and nude mermaid gown features heavy, intricate silver beaded and sequined embroidery in ornate leaf and vine patterns distributed across the bodice, sleeves, and skirt. The upper bodice has an illusion high neckline and long sheer sleeves covered in delicate beadwork. Diagonal ruching wraps across the midsection, transitioning into a fitted silhouette that flares at the knees into a medium-length sheer train adorned with matching embroidery.

3627.description: This champagne-colored gown features a fitted sheath silhouette with an illusion high neckline and long sleeves. The dress is densely covered in silver beading, embroidery, and sequins arranged in intricate linear and geometric leaf-like patterns. The skirt skims the figure before flaring slightly at the hem with a medium tulle train.

3628.description: This fitted mermaid gown features a high neckline and long sheer sleeves completely covered in intricate beadwork, embroidery, and sequins. The bodice exhibits a structured, corset-like visible boning design that flows seamlessly into a heavily embellished skirt. The gown finishes in a medium train with scalloped detailing and dense linear and geometric bead patterns throughout.

3629.description: This is a dramatic, floor-length black gown featuring a fitted silhouette and an illusion scoop neckline with long sheer sleeves. The garment is heavily embellished with dense silver embroidery and beading across the bodice, sleeves, and down the front skirt. A prominent pleated black bow accents the right shoulder and extends across the chest. The skirt falls close to the body before flaring at the hem into a short train.

3630.description: This is a fitted sheath gown in champagne featuring heavy overall crystal and bead embroidery creating intricate patterns across the bodice, sleeves, and hem. The neckline is a sheer illusion high-neck with a v-neck sweetheart inner line and beaded draping accents. Long fitted sleeves are accented by dramatic, voluminous dark navy blue ruffled sheer fabric cascades that extend down the outer arms and continue into a medium ruffled train at the back.

3631.description: This fitted trumpet gown features a sheer illusion scoop neckline and long sleeves crafted over a nude base. It is heavily embellished with intricate metallic beadwork and swirling embroidery forming symmetrical scroll and art deco patterns from the bodice down through the skirt. The skirt hugs the figure and gently flares at the hem into a short sweep train.

3632.description: This ivory mermaid gown features a high neckline and long sleeves. It is heavily embellished with intricate crystal beading, embroidery, and lace appliqules forming sweeping patterns over the bodice and fitted hips. The skirt flares out from the mid-thigh into a flared hemline with a medium train adorned with matching bead clusters.

3633.description: This champagne-toned mermaid gown features a high neckline and long sleeves, creating a fully covered upper silhouette. The entire dress is densely embellished with intricate beadwork, sequins, and embroidery arranged in geometric and chevron patterns that contour the body. It hugs the figure closely through the hips before flaring outward at the lower thigh into a structured skirt with a medium sweep train.

3634.description: This fitted mermaid gown features a high illusion neckline and long sheer sleeves. The bodice and skirt are densely covered with intricate white lace appliqu_s, floral embellishments, and beadwork over a champagne underlayer. The gown hugs the hips before flaring out into a dramatic flared hem and a long, ornate lace train.

3635.description: This is a form-fitting mermaid gown featuring a high illusion neckline and long sheer sleeves heavily adorned with lace and beading. The bodice incorporates a visible boned corset structure beneath sheer lace appliqués and floral-detailed sweetheart bust panels. Dense lace and beaded embroidery cascade down the fitted silhouette through the skirt and extend onto the floor into a medium to long decorative lace train. The collar, shoulders, and cuffs feature intricate high-density beadwork and applique detailing.

3636.description: This ivory gown features a fitted trumpet silhouette with a sheer illusion high neckline and long sleeves. The entire garment is densely embellished with intricate beadwork forming geometric and swirling patterns, including a structured bustier-style bodice underneath the sheer overlay. The skirt flows down into a short train featuring detailed lace work along the hemline.

3637.description: This is a fitted trumpet-silhouette gown featuring an illusion high neckline and long sheer sleeves. The entire dress is heavily embellished with intricate geometric and curvilinear beadwork, sequins, and embroidery in a champagne and silver color palette. The dense embellishment forms structured motifs across the bodice and radiates outward along the skirt, which pools into a medium length beaded train.

3638.description: This fitted mermaid gown features an illusion high neckline with long sheer mesh sleeves. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate silver beadwork and sequins arranged in geometric and chevron patterns radiating outward across the bodice and skirt. The dress follows a sleek silhouette down to a short sweep train with matching embellished hemline detailing.

3639.description: This is a full-length navy blue mermaid gown crafted from sheer tulle heavily laden with intricate tonal beadwork and embroidery. The design features a high round neckline and long sheer sleeves with subtle volume at the shoulders. Dense beadwork covers the bodice and hips, trailing downwards into ornate swirling patterns along the flared skirt and short train.

3640.description: This lilac illusion gown features long sheer sleeves and an illusion high-neckline over a sweetheart bodice. The fitted mermaid silhouette is heavily decorated with swirling patterns of dense silver sequins and beading, accented by a prominent dimensional floral applique at the hip. The floor-length skirt flares at the bottom into an elaborate ruffled hemline that extends into a long, circular train.

3641.description: This is a lilac floor-length sheath gown featuring a high illusion neckline and long sleeves. The dress is densely embellished with intricate swirling beadwork, sequins, and embroidered floral appliques in darker purple and metallic tones across the bodice, shoulders, and lower skirt. Vertical sequin stripes run down the length of the skirt. Attached to the left shoulder is a sheer tulle cape-like overlay that flows down into a medium train.

3642.description: This is a long-sleeved mermaid gown featuring an illusion high neckline and intricate dense embellishments of beading, embroidery, and sequins creating ornate damask-like patterns over a champagne underlay. The fitted silhouette hugs the body through the hips before flaring out slightly at the hem into a short sweep train with embroidered edging. The bodice has an illusion sweetheart neckline beneath the beaded high collar and long sheer sleeves covered in delicate vertical beadwork.

3643.description: This is a fitted trumpet gown featuring a v-neckline and long sleeves, rendered in a champagne and gold tone. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate patterns of beads and sequins arranged in horizontal bands and linear motifs. The silhouette closely skims the body through the torso and hips before flaring out slightly at the hem with a short train.

3644.description: This is a fully embellished mermaid gown in a warm champagne and gold tone, featuring dense beadwork, embroidery, and sequins across the entire silhouette. The garment has a fitted bodice with a high neckline and long, fitted sleeves providing full coverage. The skirt fits closely through the hips before flaring out at the knees into a medium-length train.

3645.description: This ivory and nude mermaid gown features an off-shoulder sweetheart neckline with long, sheer embellished sleeves. The entire silhouette is heavily adorned with intricate silver beading, sequins, and embroidery arranged in ornate, symmetrical patterns over the bodice and cascading down the fitted skirt. The skirt flares slightly at the hem into a short sweep train.

3646.description: This fitted mermaid gown features an illusion high neckline and long sleeves. The dress is densely covered in intricate beadwork and embroidery forming symmetrical baroque patterns throughout the entire garment. It is fitted through the body before flaring slightly at the hem into a short sweep train.

3647.description: This fitted trumpet gown features a sheer illusion scoop neckline and long sleeves completely covered in intricate silver beading and embroidery. Dense crystal and pearl embellishments create geometric and draped bead patterns cascading down the bodice and skirt. The fitted silhouette flows into a short sheer train with detailed beading along the hem.

3648.description: This black gown features a fitted mermaid silhouette with dense, intricate silver bead and sequin embroidery forming baroque patterns across the bodice, sleeves, and skirt. It has a high neckline and long fitted sheer sleeves embellished with matching beading. The skirt follows the curves down to a flared hem with a short train.

3649.description: This ivory gown features a straight, sheath silhouette with a high neck and sheer long split cape sleeves. Dense beaded and embroidered patterns radiate downward from the neckline in intricate linear motifs across the bodice and skirt. The lightweight fabric falls straight to the floor with minimal volume and no noticeable train.

3650.description: This fitted trumpet gown features a sheer illusion high neckline with long sleeves, densely covered in intricate metallic silver and blue beadwork, embroidery, and sequin patterns arranged in symmetrical geometric motifs. The heavy embellishment spans the entire length of the gown, creating an elaborate statement piece. The skirt hugs the figure closely before flaring out gently near the hem into a short sweep train.

3651.description: This is a form-fitting trumpet gown featuring a sweetheart bodice beneath a sheer illusion high neckline and long sleeves. The dress is densely covered in intricate silver and crystal beading arranged in geometric and chevron patterns throughout the bodice and skirt. The hem flows into a short sheer train with elaborate beaded scrollwork and ruffled trim. The garment has full coverage through the bodice and sleeves with a structured, heavy drape.

3652.description: This pale blue A-line gown features full-length sheer sleeves and an illusion round neckline over a sweetheart bodice structure. The entire garment is densely covered in vertical linear beadwork, sequin strands, and intricate botanical-inspired beaded embroidery that cascades from the bodice down the skirt. The multi-layered tulle skirt falls straight to the floor with moderate volume and no visible train.

3653.description: This ivory gown features an A-line silhouette with a high illusion neckline and long sleeves. The bodice is densely encrusted with intricate beading and embroidery forming geometric and radiating patterns. The skirt flows gracefully to the floor in medium volume, continuing the heavy embellished motif with vertical lines of beads and sequins. The gown has full coverage and a floor-length hemline without a train.

3654.description: Floor-length A-line gown constructed from heavily embellished champagne and silver lace. It features full-length fitted sleeves, an embellished high-neck collar, and an illusion décolletage over a sweetheart-shaped internal bodice. Intricate linear and scrollwork beadwork and sequins cover the bodice, waistline, and flare through the skirt into a short pooling train.

3655.description: This champagne-colored a-line gown features heavy beaded and sequined embellishments arranged in vertical stripes along the floor-length tulle skirt and dense geometric patterns across the bodice. It has long sheer sleeves and an illusion high neckline overlaying a sweetheart bodice. The waistline is defined by continuous vertical beadwork, and the skirt falls in a full shape without a train.

3656.description: This champagne and nude gown features an a-line silhouette crafted from sheer tulle overlaid with dense linear and diagonal beadwork. The bodice showcases an illusion neckline with a sweetheart-shaped inner lining and intricate diagonal beaded draping across the chest. Long illusion sleeves are fully covered in vertical rows of beads and metallic embroidery that continue downward onto the flared skirt. The skirt falls with medium volume to the floor into a short train, embellished with vertical beaded lines and swirling scroll motifs.
