3657.description: This black gown features a fitted sheath silhouette with long sheer sleeves and an illusion high neckline overlaying a V-neck bodice. The entire surface is heavily embellished with dense black beaded swags and vertical patterns, creating an intricate draped effect down the length of the skirt. The bodice includes diagonal draped fabric panels accented by the heavy beadwork. The garment falls straight to the floor with no visible train.

3660.description: This green long-sleeve gown features a sheer illusion scoop neckline and fitted sheath silhouette. Dense silver and crystal beading and embroidery form intricate baroque and medallion patterns across the bodice, transitioning into vertical beaded trails down the skirt. The sheer sleeves are diagonally striped with beading, and the skirt falls straight to a short train.

3661.description: This champagne-colored gown features a sheer illusion scoop neckline and long, fitted sheer sleeves. The entire surface is heavily embellished with dense beadwork and pearls arranged in radiating, linear starburst patterns originating from a central medallion motif at the waist. The A-line skirt falls in soft folds to the floor, maintaining the vertical beaded lines down to a short train.

3662.description: This is a full-length a-line gown featuring an illusion high-neckline and long sleeves, constructed from sheer tulle overlaying a sweetheart bodice base. The gown is heavily embellished with dense silver and champagne beading, intricate embroidery, and lace appliques distributed evenly across the bodice, sleeves, and flowing skirt. The structure falls into a medium volume shape, ending at the floor with no visible train.

3663.description: This full-length A-line gown features a high-neckline and long sleeves with full coverage. The bodice and sleeves are heavily embellished with dense beading and pearl work fading into a patterned lace skirt with scattered bead embroidery. The gown has a medium volume skirt and a short train.

3664.description: Floor-length A-line gown constructed from patterned lace with dense crystal and bead embroidery. Features a sheer illusion jewel neckline with a beaded collar and fitted sheer long sleeves with radiating crystal embellishments. The bodice displays a symmetrical starburst motif in sequins and beads that extends past the natural waist into vertical cascading trails over the pleated, full-length skirt.

3665.description: This ivory a-line gown features long sheer sleeves and a high scoop neckline over an illusion bodice with visible boning. The entire gown is densely covered with intricate floral lace embroidery and delicate beadwork, extending from the bodice down through the flowing skirt. The skirt falls softly in medium volume to the floor with a subtle short train.

3667.description: Floor-length chiffon gown featuring an illusion high neckline and long bishop sleeves gathered into fitted cuffs. The bodice showcases an asymmetric pleated overlay with radiating linear crystal and pearl beading extending towards a pointed drop waistline. A softly gathered, flowing chiffon skirt falls smoothly to the ground without a visible train.

3669.description: This champagne-colored mermaid gown features a high illusion neckline and long sleeves, densely covered from top to bottom with intricate silver and gold beading, embroidery, and sequin work in ornate scroll and filigree patterns. The structured bodice extends into an asymmetrical dropped waist overlay that transitions into a fitted skirt flaring dramatically at the knees. A sweeping long train features a heavily embellished scalloped hemline with dimensional edging.

3671.description: This gown features a fitted trumpet silhouette, crafted from a base fabric heavily embellished with dense, intricate swirling patterns of beading and embroidery. It has a high round neckline and long sleeves, providing full coverage. The dress is form-fitting through the bodice, waist, and hips, flaring gently below the knee to the floor. There are no visible slits or cut-outs, and the back is assumed to be fully covered like the front. The hem touches the floor without extending into a train.

3672.description: This mermaid gown features a champagne base fabric heavily embellished with intricate silver beading and sequins, forming ornate patterns across the entire garment. It has a high mock-neckline with an illusion panel extending to the bust, and long, fitted sleeves. The dress is closely fitted through the bodice, waist, and hips, then flares dramatically below the knee into a full skirt with a long train.

3673.description: This ivory gown features a high-neck and long sleeves, entirely covered in dense beading and sequins arranged in intricate curvilinear patterns. The fabric is fitted through the bodice, waist, and hips, then flares out into a mermaid silhouette. The gown extends into a medium-length train, which is also fully embellished.

3674.description: This champagne-colored gown features a fitted trumpet silhouette covered heavily in intricate silver beading, sequins, and embroidery forming elaborate geometric and floral patterns. It has a sheer illusion scoop neckline with long sleeves and falls into a medium circular train.

3676.description: This is a long-sleeved trumpet gown covered entirely in intricate silver beading and embroidery over a nude and champagne base fabric. The neckline is a modest illusion scoop with long fitted sleeves completely decorated in diamond-pattern beadwork. Heavy ornamentation creates geometric and cascading patterns down the bodice, waist, and skirt, finishing in a short train.

3678.description: This gown features a fitted trumpet silhouette crafted from a light, possibly sheer, fabric densely embellished with silver beading. The beading forms a distinct wavy, geometric pattern across the entire garment, including the high mock-neckline and long fitted sleeves. The gown hugs the body from the neck through the hips before flaring gently from the mid-thigh or knee, culminating in a medium-length train. There are no visible slits or cut-outs, providing full coverage.

3679.description: Floor-length sheath gown constructed on a sheer champagne-nude tulle base, heavily encrusted with linear and scrollwork beading and sequins throughout. The bodice features an illusion scoop overlay atop a defined sweetheart bustier structure with semi-sheer panels. Long fitted sheer sleeves are embellished with delicate beading, while the skirt falls in a straight, body-skimming line to the floor with an ornate geometric and lattice bead pattern.

3680.description: This is a fitted sheath gown featuring an illusion neckline and long sleeves. The entire dress is densely covered in vertical and diagonal lines of silver and lilac sequins and beading creating a striped or wave-like geometric pattern. The skirt falls straight to the floor with a minimal volume and includes a short sweep train.

3681.description: This fitted trumpet gown is densely covered in intricate beaded and sequined embroidery creating abstract patterns throughout the entire silhouette. It features long sleeves with gathered, puffed shoulders and a sheer illusion neckline over a sweetheart bodice structure. The skirt skims closely down the body before flaring slightly at the hem with a short sweep train.

3682.description: Full-coverage sheath gown features a sheer illusion high neckline and fitted long sleeves over an opaque champagne base. Dense, ornate beadwork and pearl embroidery create geometric gridlines, scrollwork medallions, and linear contours across the entirety of the dress. The fitted silhouette closely traces the body through the hips before opening into a short sweep train pooling at the ground.

3684.description: This fitted mermaid gown features an illusion sweetheart neckline and sheer long sleeves, crafted from nude tulle covered in dense geometric beading and pearl embellishments. The beading forms intricate linear and chevron patterns across the bodice, torso, and hips, creating a highly structured, heavily embellished surface. The skirt hugs the body down to the knees before flaring out into a short, heavily beaded train.

3685.description: This is a fully embellished champagne-colored mermaid gown featuring an intricate pattern of dense beading and embroidery over an illusion mesh base. The bodice has a v-neckline framed by sheer illusion fabric extending to the neckline, complemented by long fitted sleeves with slight shoulder structure. The heavily beaded design cascades down the fitted silhouette, flaring slightly at the hem into a short sweep train.

3686.description: This fitted trumpet gown features a nude base fabric entirely covered in intricate silver beading, forming a dense, swirling pattern. It has a high-neck collar with an illusion V-neck panel on the bodice and long, fitted sleeves. A distinct horizontal band of beading accentuates the waist. The gown extends to a short sweep train.

3687.description: This grey gown features a fitted trumpet silhouette with long sleeves and a high neckline. The entire garment is densely covered in geometric embroidery and heavy beading and sequins forming intricate patterns across the bodice and skirt. The fabric falls straight from the hips into a small sweep train. The shoulders are slightly gathered at the sleeve head.

3688.description: The gown features a black base fabric, heavily adorned with silver and grey beading and sequins in a swirling, organic pattern across the entire garment. It has a scoop neckline and long sleeves, maintaining full coverage. The silhouette is fitted through the bodice, waist, and hips, then dramatically flares out from the knees to form a long train. A large black fabric rose applique is positioned on the left shoulder, from which a sheer black cape drapes down to the floor, contributing to the train.

3689.description: This black floor-length gown features a fitted mermaid silhouette with a short train. It has a high neckline and long sheer sleeves. The entire surface is heavily embellished with dense silver beading and embroidery forming intricate baroque and damask patterns across the bodice, sleeves, and skirt.

3691.description: This black gown features a fitted mermaid silhouette with long sleeves and an illusion scoop neckline. The entire dress is heavily embellished with dense rows of gold and silver sequins and beadwork forming dynamic, sweeping vertical patterns across the dark tulle base. The skirt hugs the hips before flaring slightly at the hem with a short sheer tulle train.

3692.description: Floor-length black evening gown with a form-fitting column silhouette and all-over linear beading arranged in concentric wave and scalloped patterns. Features a draped fabric cowl neckline that sits at the base of the neck and fitted, sheer-look long sleeves with continued beaded detailing. The skirt remains closely tailored through the hips and thighs before slightly opening to pool into a rounded, scalloped-edge circular train.

3693.description: The gown features a nude-toned base fabric, intricately embroidered and overlaid with dense, three-dimensional ivory floral appliques from the high-neckline to the hem. It has long sleeves and a fitted silhouette through the bodice, waist, and hips, flaring into a trumpet shape below the knee. The back is not visible, and a medium-length train extends from the skirt, also adorned with floral appliques.

3694.description: This gown features an ivory lace overlay atop a nude lining, creating a fitted silhouette that gently flares from the knee. It has an off-shoulder neckline with a sweetheart shape beneath the lace, and long, sheer lace sleeves. The bodice is structured with visible boning details, and the skirt includes a draped panel on the left side. The dress offers full coverage with a short train.

3695.description: This fitted mermaid gown features an off-shoulder neckline with a sweetheart illusion detail and long sheer sleeves. The bodice showcases exposed boning with heavy vertical embroidery and beading, accented by draped fabric forming a cascading center overlay at the hips. The skirt is crafted from sheer lace over a nude lining, flaring out slightly at the hem with a short lace-trimmed train.

3696.description: Floor-length fitted gown rendered in an olive green semi-sheer fabric overlaid with dense, symmetrical geometric beadwork and sequins. The design features a high crew neckline, full-length fitted sleeves, and a defined horizontal cut-out detail at the upper waist. The skirt maintains a body-contouring silhouette before gently pooling at the floor into a short circular train.

3698.description: This fitted gown features a nude base fabric heavily embellished with intricate geometric patterns of silver beading and sequins throughout the entire garment, including the long sleeves. It has a high scoop neckline and a decorative brooch-like embellishment on the left hip. The dress maintains a sleek, body-hugging silhouette from the bodice to the mid-thigh, then gently flares to the floor with no visible train. The back is not visible, but the front offers full coverage.

3699.description: This fitted trumpet gown features a high neckline and long sheer sleeves completely covered in intricate geometric and curvilinear beadwork and embroidery. The dense pattern creates a continuous sparkling texture over a nude and champagne illusion base, hugging the figure down to the knees before flaring out slightly into a short train. The bodice incorporates a defined waistline with radiating bead motifs.

3700.description: This is a form-fitting mermaid gown featuring a sheer illusion base densely covered in intricate beaded and sequin embroidery forming geometric patterns across the entire silhouette. It has a structured high neckline and long sleeves with heavily embellished cuffs. The skirt closely follows the contours of the body down to the knees before flaring out slightly into a short sweep train with matching metallic linear detailing.

3701.description: This gown features a fitted sheath silhouette, entirely covered in intricate silver beading over a champagne-toned base fabric. It has a high, rounded neckline and long, fitted sleeves, providing full coverage. The dense beading forms elaborate geometric and curvilinear patterns across the entire garment, creating a shimmering effect. The dress falls straight to the floor with no visible train or slits.

3703.description: This heavily beaded gown features a fitted trumpet silhouette, gently flaring from the knee to the floor. It has a V-neckline and long sleeves, with intricate silver beading forming geometric patterns on the bodice and vertical lines on the skirt. The entire garment is covered in shimmering embellishments, extending to a short train. The gown offers full coverage.

3704.description: This fitted mermaid gown features an intricate, floor-length bead and crystal embroidery pattern over a sheer illusion tulle base. The bodice includes an illusion v-neckline with a sheer insert at the décolletage and structured waist detailing. Long illusion sleeves are fully embellished with dense vertical and geometric beading. The skirt follows a fitted silhouette through the hips before flaring slightly at the hem into a short sweep train.

3705.description: This blue gown features a fitted trumpet silhouette with a high neckline and long sleeves. The entire garment is densely covered in heavy beadwork, sequins, and embroidery arranged in an elaborate geometric mosaic pattern. The skirt falls close to the body before flaring slightly at the hem into a short sweep train.

3706.description: This blue sheath gown features a high neckline and long sleeves fully covered in dense beading. The bodice is accented with diagonal chiffon draping wrapping from the shoulder across the waist. The skirt features intricate geometric beadwork patterns and a short train.

3707.description: This fitted trumpet gown features a nude-toned sheer lining overlaid with intricate metallic beading and sequin embroidery in a dense, swirling feather-like pattern. The dress has an illusion high scoop neckline with long sleeves and falls smoothly into a short sweep train. The embellishment covers the entire garment from the neckline down to the hem.

3710.description: This fitted trumpet gown features a high illusion neckline and long sleeves completely covered in dense silver beadwork and intricate swirling embroidery. The beaded patterns cascade down the bodice in symmetrical scrollwork and geometric motifs over a sheer fabric layer. The skirt hugs the figure closely and extends into a short sheer train with heavy beaded borders along the hem.

3711.description: This gown features a black opaque fabric for the main body with sheer black chiffon sleeves and an illusion panel across the upper chest. The bodice is draped with pleats, and the skirt is fully pleated, falling in soft folds to the floor. Intricate silver-toned beading and embroidery adorn the right shoulder and chest, extending diagonally across the bodice and along the left side of the waist. The gown has a high round neckline and long, voluminous sheer sleeves gathered at the shoulders and cuffed at the wrists.

3712.description: This black lace gown features a high round neckline and long fitted sleeves, all adorned with intricate lace patterns and beading. The bodice is sheer with a nude lining underneath, while the skirt maintains a fitted, straight silhouette with a high slit on the left leg. A black satin ribbon is tied at the waist, and the dress falls to the floor with no train.

3713.description: Floor-length black evening gown featuring a rounded jewel neckline and sheer full-length sleeves finished with subtle pleated cuff ruffles. The fitted bodice is heavily embellished with tonal raised beadwork in organic scroll motifs extending to the hips. A sheer floral lace skirt incorporates asymmetrical waist gathers that drape diagonally across the front, extending into a short pooling hem.

3715.description: This black gown features a fitted silhouette crafted entirely from patterned lace with a solid underlay. The bodice has a scoop neckline and long lace sleeves with slight gathering at the shoulders. A central knot detail at the waist gathers the fabric into cascading vertical drapes and ruffles that open into a front slit. The skirt flows down to a short lace train.

3716.description: This green metallic gown features a fitted sheath silhouette with a scoop neckline and long sleeves. The fabric has a reflective sheen and subtle draping across the bodice. Intricate silver beaded vine and floral embroidery adorns the right shoulder and flows diagonally down towards the left hip. The skirt falls straight to the floor with no visible train.

3717.description: This gown is crafted from a flowing, soft fabric in a nude hue, featuring extensive draping across the bodice and midsection. It has a high round neckline adorned with dense beading that extends diagonally over the right shoulder. Long, full balloon sleeves gather at the wrists with cuffs. A large, multi-layered fabric flower applique is positioned on the left hip, complementing the diagonal draping. The dress falls in a sheath silhouette to the floor with no train.

3718.description: This champagne-colored gown features a one-shoulder neckline and asymmetric diagonal draping across the bodice. It has sheer long sleeves with gathered cuffs and a fitted sheath skirt. Diagonal cut-outs at the waist reveal embellished beaded bands, complemented by an overlay of gathered fabric cascading from the waist into a short train.

3719.description: This a-line gown features a structured bodice heavily adorned with dense beading and intricate embroidery forming ornate patterns across the chest and long sheer sleeves. The scoop neckline frames the upper chest, and the waistline transitions smoothly into a flowing, lightweight skirt with moderate volume. The skirt has a subtle shimmer effect and falls cleanly to the floor with no visible train.

3720.description: This white gown features a high illusion neckline and long sheer sleeves with gathered cuffs. The bodice displays intricate white embroidery on the left side, overlaid with diagonal draping that extends from the right shoulder across the bust and waist. The skirt falls in a smooth sheath silhouette, providing full coverage. The gown has no visible train.

3722.description: The gown features a fitted bodice and long sleeves, both heavily embellished with intricate beading and embroidery in a swirling pattern. The neckline is a modest scoop. The sleeves are long with fitted cuffs and a voluminous, sheer balloon shape from elbow to wrist. The skirt is a flowing A-line in a shimmering, plain fabric, extending to the floor with no train. The back of the gown is not visible.

3723.description: This champagne-colored gown is crafted from a shimmering fabric that drapes elegantly. The bodice features a V-neckline with intricate silver beading and embroidery, extending into a long, fitted, beaded sleeve on one side. The opposing side showcases a long, flowing, balloon-style sleeve. The waist is cinched with elaborate draping and accented by a prominent crystal embellishment, leading to a fitted skirt that flows into a short train.

3724.description: This is a fitted trumpet silhouette gown featuring a high neckline and long sleeves in a striking black fabric densely covered with intricate silver beading and sequins. The beadwork forms complex geometric and damask-inspired patterns that trace the bodice, waist, and hips before flaring out into a short train at the hem. The dress is fully covered from the neck down to the floor, displaying heavy embellishment density throughout the entire garment.

3725.description: The gown features a nude-toned sheer overlay, heavily embellished with intricate silver beading in swirling, organic patterns across the high-neck bodice, long sleeves, and A-line skirt. The bodice has a visible corset-style structure beneath the beading, creating a fitted silhouette before the skirt gently flows to the floor. The dress offers full coverage with its high neckline and long sleeves, and it has no visible train.

3728.description: This is a heavily embellished champagne and silver gown featuring a fitted mermaid silhouette with a high scoop neckline and long sheer sleeves. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate beadwork, embroidery, and sequins arranged in symmetrical, ornate patterns radiating from the bodice and hips. The dress hugs the figure closely down the body before flaring slightly at the hem into a short sweep train.

3733.description: This gown features a flowing skirt in a light nude fabric, which drapes softly from the natural waistline. The bodice and full-length sleeves are intricately embellished with dense beading, forming geometric and floral patterns. The neckline is a modest scoop, also adorned with beading. The dress offers full coverage and concludes with a subtle, short train.

3737.description: This mermaid silhouette gown features a champagne-toned base fabric heavily embellished with intricate silver beading and embroidery from the illusion round neckline to the hem. The bodice includes draped fabric details over a sweetheart lining, complementing the long, fully embellished sleeves. The gown is fitted through the body and hips, flaring out below the knee into a short train, offering full coverage.

3738.description: This mermaid gown features a sheer base fabric heavily embellished with intricate patterns of beading and sequins. It has a high-neck illusion neckline and long illusion sleeves, both fully covered in embellishment. The gown is fitted through the bodice, waist, and hips, flaring out below the knee into a medium-length train, with dense embellishment covering the entire garment.

3739.description: This champagne-toned gown features a fitted mermaid silhouette, fully embellished with dense silver beading in intricate swirling patterns. It has a high round neckline and long, fitted sleeves, providing full coverage. The dress hugs the body from the bodice through the hips before gently flaring out at the hem, with no visible train or cut-outs.

3741.description: This fitted trumpet gown features a sheer illusion high neckline and long sleeves with subtle shoulder gathering. The entire nude-toned silhouette is densely covered in intricate geometric and scrolling beadwork patterns. It falls close to the body before flaring at the hem into a short, sheer train edged with beadwork.

3742.description: This is a fitted trumpet gown featuring an illusion high neckline layered over a sweetheart bodice and long sleeves, creating a sheer upper yoke. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate beaded and sequined embroidery forming swirling, organic scrollwork patterns. The skirt skims the hips and thighs before flaring out slightly at the hem into a short sweep train with an organza or tulle border.

3744.description: This gown features a nude-toned base fabric, heavily embellished with intricate silver beading and sequins that form ornate patterns across the entire garment. It has a fitted silhouette that hugs the body from the bodice through the hips, falling straight to the floor. The neckline is an illusion scoop, with long sheer sleeves that feature prominent puffed shoulders and fitted cuffs. The gown offers full coverage and has no visible train.

3747.description: This fitted trumpet gown features a high scoop neckline and long sheer sleeves with a dense pattern of vertical and swirling beaded embroidery. Silver sequins and beading cover the entire nude and champagne colored sheer base fabric in an elaborate leaf-like scrollwork motif. The dress follows the contours of the body closely before flaring out slightly at the hem into a short sweep train.

3748.description: This fitted gown features a champagne-colored base with a sheer overlay, entirely embellished with silver beading and sequins in a wavy, organic pattern. It has a high illusion neckline and long illusion sleeves, both adorned with the same intricate embellishment. The dress maintains a full coverage silhouette, hugging the body before subtly flaring at the hem, with no visible train.

3755.description: This heavily beaded gown features a nude base fabric with intricate silver beading forming geometric and curvilinear patterns throughout. It has a high-neckline with a sheer illusion panel across the upper chest and long, sheer sleeves with a subtle puff at the shoulders. The dress is form-fitting through the bodice, waist, and hips, gently flaring at the hem into a short train. The back detail is not visible.

3757.description: This a-line gown features an illusion neckline with a sweetheart bodice underneath and long, flared sleeves. Dense silver and crystal beading, embroidery, and sequin work cover the entirety of the garment in intricate leaf and vine patterns over a champagne base. The skirt falls in moderate volume down to a short train.

3760.description: This is a long-sleeved A-line gown in a blush or nude tone with an overlay of white lace and floral appliqués. The neckline is high, and the sleeves are long with flared, ruffled cuffs. Dense botanical lace and 3D floral appliqués decorate the bodice, shoulders, and cascade down the skirt. The skirt falls in a medium-volume A-line silhouette to the floor without a train.

3762.description: This ivory gown features an illusion neckline with long sleeves and an a-line silhouette. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate vertical patterns of silver beading, embroidery, and sequins that radiate outward from the waist and shoulders. The skirt falls with medium volume down to the floor with no visible train.

3764.description: This full-length a-line gown features an illusion scoop neckline and long sheer sleeves. The tulle fabric is heavily embellished with intricate beadwork and embroidery forming geometric and scalloped patterns across the bodice and cascading down the skirt in swags. The waist is defined by dense beading that transitions into vertical motifs over the skirt. The skirt falls with medium volume to the floor without a train.

3765.description: This ivory mermaid gown is intricately adorned with dense floral lace appliques and beading throughout. It features a high mock-neck collar and long sleeves crafted from sheer illusion fabric, both heavily embellished. The bodice includes a sheer illusion V-neck panel over an opaque, structured corset-style lining, and the fitted silhouette flares dramatically from the mid-thigh into a full skirt with a scalloped hem. A long, elaborate train extends from the back, mirroring the gown's extensive lace and applique detailing.

3766.description: The gown features a pleated, shimmery ivory fabric for the skirt, which falls in a straight silhouette from the natural waist. The bodice has a sheer illusion round neckline and is heavily embellished with silver beading and embroidery in a swirling, floral-like pattern over a nude lining. Long, pleated sleeves with beaded cuffs complete the design. The dress offers full coverage with no visible slits or cut-outs and has no train.

3767.description: This A-line gown features a textured, subtly shimmering white fabric for the skirt, which flows softly from the natural waist. The bodice has a sheer illusion round neckline and long sheer sleeves that are slightly puffed at the shoulder and gathered at the wrist. The opaque part of the bodice is intricately embellished with dense beading and embroidery in a structured, corset-like pattern over a sweetheart lining, while the sheer neckline and sleeves have scattered subtle beading. The gown offers full coverage and concludes with a short train.

3776.description: This gown is crafted from a nude-toned fabric, entirely adorned with dense silver beading arranged in intricate geometric and wave patterns. It features a high rounded neckline and long sleeves, with a prominent structured peplum detail at the natural waist. The dress maintains a fitted silhouette through the bodice, waist, and hips, gently flaring out at the hem. There are no visible slits, cut-outs, or a train.

3777.description: This is a trumpet silhouette gown featuring a high-neckline and long sleeves. The dress is densely embellished with intricate beading and embroidery forming geometric and radiating patterns across the bodice, sleeves, and shoulders. The skirt fits closely through the hips and thighs before flaring out at the hem into a medium train with detailed embellishments along the border.

3778.description: This champagne and nude a-line gown features long sleeves and a high illusion neckline densely covered in intricate beaded and sequin embellishments. Geometric and linear beaded patterns are heavily concentrated across the bodice and cascade downwards in vertical stripes along the skirt. The sheer overlay falls in a medium-volume a-line silhouette, ending in a short sweep train.

3780.description: This gown is crafted from a shimmering fabric, entirely covered in dense vertical lines of sequins or beads. It features a high round neckline and long, fitted sleeves. The bodice is fitted, transitioning to a defined waistline, from which the skirt flows into a full A-line silhouette that reaches the floor with medium volume and no train. The dress offers full coverage with no visible slits or cut-outs.

3782.description: This mermaid gown features a nude-toned sheer fabric base, entirely embellished with dense silver beading arranged in swirling patterns. It has a high-neckline and long sleeves, both crafted from the same beaded sheer material, with an opaque sweetheart-shaped lining visible on the bodice. The dress is fitted through the body, flaring out below the knee into a medium-length train.

3784.description: This mermaid gown is entirely covered in dense silver beading and sequins, forming intricate geometric and swirling patterns across the fabric. It features a high scoop neckline and long sleeves with prominent puffed shoulders. The fitted silhouette flares out gracefully below the knee, extending into a short train, with the heavy embellishment consistently covering the entire garment.

3791.description: The gown features a shimmering blush fabric for the A-line skirt and long bishop sleeves, which gather at the wrists. The bodice has an illusion scoop neckline over a sweetheart-shaped lining, heavily embellished with dense beading that extends slightly onto the sheer neckline. A distinct band of intricate beading defines the natural waistline. The skirt flows with medium volume, forming soft pleats and extending into a medium-length train.

3792.description: This gown is crafted from a dark grey fabric entirely covered in shimmering silver sequins, arranged in diagonal stripes across the garment. It features a fitted silhouette through the bodice and hips, gently flaring into a trumpet shape at the hem. The dress has a deep V-neckline with a wrap-style bodice and long sleeves. The back is not visible, and there are no visible slits or cut-outs. The hem touches the ground without a distinct train.

3793.description: This fitted trumpet gown features an all-over heavy beading and sequin embellishment in a champagne and gold tone. The bodice has a square neckline with short cap sleeves and a visible structured corset-style construction with vertical boning details. Diagonal draping lines sweep across the hip and skirt, flowing down into a subtle short train at the floor.

3794.description: This champagne and gold gown features an off-shoulder neckline with draped cap sleeves and a sweetheart bodice. The entire structured sheath silhouette is densely covered in vertical rows of beading and sequins. Asymmetrical fabric draping crosses over the hips, flowing into a thigh-high front slit and a short sweep train.

3795.description: This fitted mermaid gown is crafted from a sheer, light-colored fabric, heavily embellished with intricate beading and embroidery. The dress features a high scoop neckline and long, fitted sleeves with a subtle puff at the shoulders. The entire garment, from bodice to the flared skirt and train, is densely covered in ornate, symmetrical patterns formed by small, round beads. The skirt flares out below the knee into a ruffled hem, extending into a medium-length train.

3796.description: This champagne-colored gown features a high neckline and long sleeves in a fitted a-line silhouette. The entire dress is heavily embellished with intricate geometric and radiating patterns of beads and sequins over sheer mesh. It falls into a short, sweeping train at the back with layered tulle construction.

3801.description: This mermaid gown features a sheer base fabric in champagne, entirely covered in dense, intricate beading and sequins that form geometric and swirling patterns. It has a high-neckline and long, fitted sleeves, offering full coverage. The dress is fitted through the bodice, waist, and hips, flaring out dramatically below the knee into a medium-length train.

3802.description: The gown is crafted from a champagne-toned fabric, entirely adorned with dense, shimmering beading and sequins that form intricate, swirling patterns throughout. It features a high round neckline and long sleeves, offering full coverage. The silhouette is a soft A-line, with the fabric draping smoothly from the fitted bodice and gently flaring to the floor, culminating in a short train at the back.

3803.description: This heavily embellished mermaid gown features a high round neckline and long sleeves with puffed shoulders. The entire dress is densely covered in intricate beading and sequins, forming elaborate patterns. The silhouette is fitted through the bodice, waist, and hips, flaring out below the knee. The gown concludes with a medium-length train and offers full coverage.

3807.description: This fitted trumpet gown features a sheer illusion neckline with an asymmetrical diagonal strap detailing across the upper chest. It has sheer long sleeves and is heavily encrusted with dense rows of silver and crystal beading, sequins, and embroidery arranged in intricate geometric and draped patterns spanning the bodice and full length of the skirt. The beadwork cascades down the skirt towards a short sweep train.

3808.description: This champagne-colored gown features a fitted sheath silhouette crafted from lightweight chiffon with delicate horizontal and diagonal draping across the bodice and waist. It has a modest v-neckline and long, sheer bishop sleeves with banded cuffs. Small pearl beading is sparsely scattered across the draped bodice and shoulders. The skirt falls straight to the floor, ending in a short sweep train.

3809.description: This green fitted trumpet gown features a high neckline and long sleeves. The entire surface is densely covered in geometric patterns created with silver and gold beading, sequins, and embroidery. It falls into a slight flared hem with a short train.

3810.description: This is a heavily beaded and embroidered sheath gown in a champagne gold hue, featuring a fitted silhouette with a high leg slit on the wearer's left side. The garment has a square neckline and thick straps with fringe beaded detail on the right shoulder. Intricate beadwork and sequin patterns cover the entire surface from bodice to hem in symmetrical motifs.

3813.description: This is a sleeveless sheath gown featuring a v-neckline and a straight mid-calf hemline. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate beaded and embroidered geometric patterns over a champagne-toned fabric. The silhouette is fitted closely to the body with minimal volume and no train.

3814.description: This black gown features a floor-length straight silhouette with a short train. The bodice is heavily embellished with gold and black beadwork and embroidery in geometric patterns, complemented by a high neckline and sheer long bishop sleeves. The skirt incorporates side draping originating from a large beaded floral applique at the hip. The lower skirt is crafted from a smooth, flowing fabric falling straight to the floor.

3824.description: This ivory gown features a fitted silhouette, heavily embellished with vertical lines of beading and sequins from the V-neckline to the hem. An off-shoulder draped cape, adorned with horizontal beading, extends into long, sheer panels that flow to the floor. The dress has a long, embellished train, and offers full torso coverage with an open décolletage and shoulders.

3826.description: This gown features a champagne-toned base fabric, heavily embellished with intricate silver beading and embroidery. It has an illusion scoop neckline and long, fitted sleeves with a slight puff at the shoulders, all adorned with dense embellishment. The fitted inner dress is covered in ornate patterns, while a voluminous, layered overskirt flares from the waist, featuring scattered beading and embroidered motifs along its wide hem. The gown extends into a long train, combining the embellished inner skirt and the flowing overskirt.

3827.description: This grey gown features a scoop neckline and long sleeves with flared bell cuffs. The entire garment is densely embellished with intricate silver beading, sequins, and embroidery arranged in geometric sunburst patterns across the bodice and vertical linear cascades down the skirt. The silhouette is an A-line style falling to the floor with a minimal train. The fabric consists of a sheer tulle overlay covering a matching lining.

3828.description: This is a form-fitting mermaid silhouette gown featuring long sleeves and a high neckline, fully covered in dense, intricate beading and sequin embroidery arranged in swirling, sweeping patterns. The fabric is sheer mesh densely encrusted with champagne and gold embellishments over a matching neutral lining. The gown hugs the body closely down to the knees, where it flares out into a structured skirt that pools into a medium length train with matching embellished patterns.

3829.description: This gown features a black scoop neckline and long sleeves, both adorned with dense black beading arranged in a wavy pattern over a sheer fabric. The bodice is fitted, transitioning to a flowing A-line skirt made of a lightweight fabric that falls in soft pleats from the natural waist to the floor. The dress offers full coverage with no visible slits or cut-outs, and it has no train.

3830.description: This is a fitted sheath gown featuring long illusion sleeves and a high illusion neckline. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate silver beadwork and sequin embroidery forming elaborate swirling and vertical patterns over a champagne colored base layer. The silhouette skims the body closely before flaring slightly at the hem into a short sweep train.

3831.description: This is a white mermaid gown featuring intricate lace, heavy beading, embroidery, sequins, and dimensional applique across the entire garment. The bodice has a sheer illusion high neckline with long sleeves and a visible sweetheart bodice lining beneath the patterned overlay. The fitted silhouette hugs the body down to the mid-thigh before flaring out into a moderately volumized skirt with a matching embroidered and lace-edged medium sweep train.

3832.description: This is a full-length, A-line gown featuring vertical rows of dense beading and sequins cascading down the entire length of the dress. The bodice has a wrapped v-neckline with diagonal pleating and draping, complemented by sheer long sleeves fully encrusted with vertical beaded lines. The skirt falls with medium volume from a defined waistline into a clean hem without a train.

3834.description: This is a full-length trumpet gown featuring a high scoop neckline and long sleeves. The entire surface is covered in dense, intricate beading arranged in a wavy, swirling linear pattern over a lilac fabric base. The silhouette fits closely through the bodice and hips before flaring gracefully at the hem into a short train.

3835.description: This is a form-fitting mermaid gown featuring a sheer dark base completely covered in dense silver crystal beading and sequin embellishments. The bodice has an illusion neckline and long sleeves with a distinct geometric lattice pattern formed by the beadwork. The garment is heavily encrusted throughout, creating a glittering texture that follows the silhouette down to a flared hem with a short train.

3837.description: This a-line gown features an illusion high neckline with sheer long sleeves and a fitted bodice. The entire dress is heavily embellished with vertical patterns of silver beading, sequins, and embroidery over a champagne base. The beadwork converges at the waist and radiates outwards along the skirt, which falls to a short train.

3838.description: This light blue-green fitted trumpet gown features a high scoop neckline and long sleeves. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate beaded and sequin embroidery arranged in ornate patterns, featuring vertical stripes down the bodice and skirt. The gown flows into a medium train decorated with matching beadwork.

3839.description: This fitted sheath gown features a high scoop neckline and long sleeves, fully covered in intricate geometric beadwork and sequins in navy, gold, and bronze tones. A solid dark navy satin sash wraps around the waist, accented with a gathered floral detail at the side from which a dramatic side drape and short train cascade down. The gown falls closely to the figure with minimal volume, maintaining a sleek and structured profile.

3841.description: This trumpet gown features a high neckline and long sleeves, fully covered in intricate silver and clear beading, sequins, and embroidery radiating from the waist and shoulders in geometric patterns. The silhouette is fitted through the hips before flaring gracefully at the hem into a medium sweep train. The beadwork creates a high-density, shimmering texture across the entire garment.

3856.description: This is a form-fitting mermaid gown featuring a high sheer illusion neckline over a structured sweetheart corset bodice with visible boning. The long sleeves and entire silhouette are densely covered in intricate beaded floral embroidery and sequins over a nude-toned lining with a soft blush overlay. The skirt hugs the body before flaring out at the knees into a medium-length train adorned with matching beadwork.

3857.description: This trumpet gown features a fitted silhouette crafted from a nude-toned sheer fabric overlaid with intricate silver beading, embroidery, and sequins in elaborate geometric and swirling art deco patterns. It has a high neckline with long, sheer sleeves adorned with delicate beadwork throughout. The dense embellishment follows the curves of the body, extending down to a medium-length sheer train with embellished borders.

3859.description: This pink a-line gown features long sheer chiffon sleeves with fitted cuffs and a scoop neckline with an illusion panel. The bodice is densely covered in silver and gold beading and sequins that form a sweetheart shape against the sheer upper yoke. The floor-length skirt is constructed from gathered chiffon that falls in soft vertical pleats with medium volume and no visible train.

3860.description: This champagne-toned a-line gown features an illusion high neckline and long sheer sleeves heavily detailed with vertical silver beading and crystal embroidery. The bodice showcases intricate beaded leaf and vine motifs across the chest that transition into cascading vertical beaded lines down the skirt. The sheer tulle overlay creates a soft, voluminous silhouette that falls gracefully into a short train.

3861.description: This is a heavily embellished mermaid gown featuring intricate silver beading, sequins, and embroidery distributed densely over a nude and champagne base. The garment includes an illusion scoop neckline with long sleeves and a structured peplum waist detail that flares out over the hips. The fitted silhouette transitions into a flared skirt and terminates in a long, elaborately decorated train.

3863.description: This champagne-colored a-line gown features long sheer sleeves and a v-neckline. The bodice and skirt are extensively embellished with vertical strands of beads and crystal formations in cascading patterns. The layered tulle skirt flows into a short train.

3865.description: This dark green gown features a fitted trumpet silhouette with long sleeves and a V-neckline. The garment is heavily embellished with intricate beaded, sequenced, and embroidered patterns in swirling, organic motifs across the entire surface. The lightweight fabric falls closely to the body before flaring slightly at the hem with a short train.

3867.description: This A-line gown features an illusion neckline with a sweetheart sweetheart bodice underneath and long fitted sleeves. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate silver and clear beading, sequins, and embroidery over a patterned lace fabric. A prominent beaded and sequined panel cascades down the center of the full skirt, which flows into a medium-length train.

3868.description: This is a form-fitting trumpet style gown featuring long sheer sleeves and a high neckline. The garment is heavily covered in intricate silver and clear beading, embroidery, and sequins forming ornate swirling patterns across the entire silhouette. It features a fitted bodice and skirt that gently flares out into a short train at the hem.

3869.description: This is a fitted sheath gown featuring dense, intricate silver and crystal beading and sequin embellishments arranged in geometric lattice and floral patterns over a dark sheer fabric. It has a high scoop illusion neckline, long sheer sleeves, and illusion side cut-outs at the waist. The skirt skims the figure closely before pooling slightly into a short beaded train.

3870.description: This champagne-colored trumpet gown features a floor-length silhouette with a short train. It is densely covered in intricate silver beading, sequins, and embroidery forming swirling, organic flame-like patterns throughout the fabric. The garment includes long sheer sleeves and an illusion scoop neckline with a defined beaded waistband.

3871.description: This fitted trumpet gown features heavy, intricate geometric and scrollwork beading and embroidery spread densely across the entire surface. It has a v-neckline with an illusion inset, long sleeves with slight shoulder volume, and a modest short train composed of sheer embellished layers.

3876.description: This is a fitted, full-length navy dress with a V-neckline and long sleeves. The entire garment is densely covered in geometric sequin patterns in blue and bronze tones. A solid navy draped sash or panel originates from the waist and cascades down the side to form a long train.

3955.description: This ivory and champagne gown features a fitted lace underlayer covered in dense dimensional floral appliques and beadwork. The bodice has a modest scoop neckline and long sleeves that flare out at the wrist into ruffled bell cuffs. A thin fabric belt defines the natural waistline, beneath which a split sheer overskirt drapes over the heavily embellished sheath skirt, creating a layered a-line effect with a short train.

3962.description: This grey gown features an a-line silhouette with a gathered full skirt made of lightweight flowing fabric. The bodice includes an illusion neckline and long sheer sleeves heavily embellished with intricate beaded lines and heavy crystal clusters on the left shoulder. A diagonal draped satin panel wraps across the upper right bodice, contrasting with the sheer beaded mesh elements.

3988.description: This fitted trumpet gown features a sheer illusion underlayer heavily embellished with dimensional floral appliques, intricate lace, and subtle beading across the entire surface. The dress has a modest scoop neckline and long, fitted sheer sleeves that continue the dense floral detailing. It flares slightly at the lower thighs into a moderate sweep train with detailed lace edging.

3998.description: This trumpet gown is extensively covered with intricate beadwork, embroidery, and lace overlaying a champagne lining. It features a scoop illusion neckline and long sheer sleeves with matching beadwork clustered densely at the shoulders, bodice, and hips, thinning toward the hem. The skirt fits closely through the upper legs before flaring out slightly into a short sweep train.

4002.description: This is a full-length, A-line gown in a champagne-nude tone featuring an illusion high-neckline and long sleeves. The dress is densely covered in intricate beaded and embroidered scrollwork patterns across the bodice and cascading down the skirt. The sheer overlay falls loosely over a matching lining, maintaining a medium volume without an extended train. The bodice has full coverage with a sheer illusion yoke extending to the neck.

4003.description: This is a fully beaded and sequined long-sleeve trumpet gown in a warm champagne and gold tone. The neckline features a sheer illusion scoop style over a sweetheart underlayer, with intricate beadwork radiating outward from key points on the bodice. The dense embroidery and sequin embellishments form geometric and art-deco inspired patterns throughout the entire fitted garment. The skirt flares out slightly at the hem into a medium-length rounded train matching the elaborate ornamentation of the rest of the dress.

4005.description: This champagne-colored gown features a fitted a-line silhouette with a high illusion neckline and long sleeves ending in flared bell cuffs. The entire dress is heavily embellished with dense vertical patterns of beads, embroidery, and sequins. The fabric falls straight down with minimal volume and no visible train.

4006.description: This is a full-length, fitted mermaid silhouette gown featuring long sleeves and a structured high neckline with a central keyhole cutout. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate, swirling beaded and embroidered patterns in silver and crystal tones over an ivory base fabric. The silhouette skims the hips before flaring gracefully at the hem into a short sweep train with embroidered scalloped edges.

4007.description: This champagne and nude trumpet gown features dense vertical rows of beading and sequins covering the entire fitted silhouette. The bodice has a sweetheart neckline under a sheer illusion overlay with intricate criss-cross straps forming a high neckline effect. Long sheer sleeves are fully embellished with matching beadwork. The skirt flares slightly into a medium train with scalloped, embellished tulle hems.

4008.description: This ivory mermaid gown features a fitted silhouette that flares at the hem with a short train. The sheer illusion neckline and long sleeves are densely encrusted with intricate beading and embroidery forming ornate patterns over exposed corset boning at the bodice and continuing down the skirt. The bodice includes structured cups beneath the sheer overlay and a slight peplum detail at the hips.

4009.description: This ivory mermaid gown features extensive silver beading, sequins, and intricate embroidery arranged in swirling, baroque-inspired patterns across the entire garment. The bodice has an illusion high neckline overlaying a sweetheart shape, combined with sheer long sleeves. The dress fits closely through the hips before flaring out into a structured, medium-length train edged with detailed beadwork.

4011.description: This is a fitted, trumpet-silhouette gown featuring sheer long sleeves and an illusion high neckline over a sweetheart bodice foundation. The garment is heavily covered in intricate beaded embroidery forming symmetrical scroll and chevron patterns from the bodice down through the skirt. The beadwork cascades densely over the upper torso and flares outward into patterned lines along the skirt, terminating in a short sweep train.

4012.description: This champagne-colored mermaid gown is heavily embellished with intricate silver beading, embroidery, sequins, and appliques from the high illusion neckline down to the hem. It features long sheer sleeves and a fitted bodice that flares into a structured mermaid skirt with a long train. The dense ornamentation creates an ornate pattern covering the entire surface of the dress.

4013.description: This is a burgundy long-sleeved fitted gown with an illusion scoop neckline. The entire dress is heavily embellished with dense beading, sequins, and embroidery arranged in vertical and organic patterns over a sheer fabric base. The skirt fits closely through the hips before flaring slightly at the hem with a short train featuring sheer lined beadwork.

4015.description: This floor-length mermaid gown is rendered in a deep burgundy shade, densely covered in sparkling beading and sequins arranged in vertical patterns. It features a high illusion neckline with sheer detailing and long sleeves. The bodice showcases subtle vertical draping beneath the heavy embellishments. The fitted silhouette flares slightly at the hem into a short sweep train.

4016.description: This is a floor-length mermaid gown in a deep burgundy shade, heavily embellished with dense tonal beadwork and sequins forming intricate swirling patterns. It features an illusion high neckline with long sleeves and a fitted bodice that flares out slightly at the knees into a short, rounded train. The sheer illusion yoke at the upper chest is edged with delicate beaded details.

4017.description: This is a long-sleeved, fitted trumpet gown in a deep navy color, heavily embellished with dense silver beading and sequins covering the entire surface. The neckline is a modest scoop, and the sleeves are long with sheer panels on the forearms and ornate beaded cuffs. A distinct beaded belt detail accentuates the waistline. The silhouette is body-hugging down to the knees, where it flares out subtly into a floor-length hem with no visible train.

4018.description: This is a full-length, navy blue trumpet gown featuring long sleeves and a high neckline. The garment is heavily embellished with dense silver beading, sequins, and embroidery distributed in an intricate, sparkling pattern across the entire surface. The silhouette fits closely through the bodice and hips before flaring slightly at the hem with a short train.

4020.description: This is a full-length, fitted navy gown featuring a mermaid silhouette with a short train. It has a high neckline and long sleeves. The entire surface is densely embellished with beads, sequins, and intricate embroidery. The garment provides full coverage with a fitted shape through the torso before flaring slightly at the hem.

4022.description: This black gown features a fitted mermaid silhouette with full coverage and a scoop neckline. The entire garment is heavily embellished with dense black beading, sequins, and embroidery over a sheer mesh base.
