4298.description: This is a fully beaded floor-length sheath gown featuring a champagne-toned fabric covered in an intricate geometric diamond pattern of silver beads and crystals. The dress includes long sleeves, an illusion scoop neckline with a sheer yoke, and a structured peplum-style overskirt detail at the waist that falls straight down to the floor without a train.

4299.description: This is a black floor-length fitted trumpet gown featuring dense silver beadwork and intricate embroidery across the bodice, sleeves, and skirt. The long sheer sleeves are embellished with horizontal beaded banding, and the neckline is a rounded scoop style. Dense black tulle ruffles line the lower sides of the skirt, flowing into a short train at the back.

4300.description: This black gown features a fitted, mermaid silhouette with long sleeves and a scoop neckline. The entire surface is densely covered in intricate silver beadwork forming symmetrical filigree and geometric patterns. A sheer black tulle train extends from the hem, edged with matching beaded embroidery.

4301.description: This is a fitted sheath gown in black featuring dense silver beading in intricate geometric and baroque-inspired patterns. The gown has long sleeves and an illusion scoop neckline with sheer fabric detailing across the upper chest. The heavy embellishment runs continuously from the neckline down to the floor-length hem, creating a structured silhouette with no visible train.

4303.description: This a-line gown features a heavily beaded and sequined bodice with long sleeves and a scoop neckline. The skirt is made of flowing chiffon with soft gathers falling to a floor-length hem with a short train. The bodice exhibits dense, reflective embellishments extending down to a natural waistline.

4315.description: This black gown features a fitted sheath silhouette with a high round neckline and long sheer sleeves. Heavy silver beading, embroidery, and sequins form an ornate damask or medallion pattern across the bodice and shoulders. The skirt transitions to vertical beaded linear patterns running down the length to the floor-length hem, ending in a short sweep train made of sheer dark fabric.

4316.description: This fitted mermaid gown features a sweetheart neckline and is heavily encrusted with intricate silver beading, embroidery, and sequins over an ivory and champagne base. A contrasting dark blue satin detachable sleeve/drape attaches to one shoulder and falls into a long train down the back. The skirt flares out at the bottom with a beaded hemline and a medium sweep train.

4318.description: This champagne-toned gown features an intricate long-sleeve bodice with a high neckline, completely covered in dense gold beading, embroidery, and dimensional floral appliques. A fitted peplum layer extends from the waist over a full, floor-length skirt of sheer pleated fabric. The skirt is decorated with vertical beaded lines and cascading floral vine embroidery, pooling into a short train at the back.

4319.description: This gold sheath gown features long sleeves and a V-neckline. The bodice is densely covered in intricate beaded geometric patterns, transitioning into vertical beaded fringe over the hips that falls to mid-thigh. The skirt continues in a straight silhouette with all-over vertical beadwork and terminates in a short train.

4321.description: This ivory bridal gown features an intricate lace bodice with long sleeves and a high illusion neckline. The fitted silhouette transitions into a smooth, draped skirt with soft gathering along the side waist. A short sweep train completes the skirt in the back.

4323.description: This ivory a-line gown features a high illusion neckline with sheer long sleeves and a sweetheart bodice base. The garment is heavily covered in intricate lace appliqués, embroidery, beadwork, and sequins distributed densely across the bodice, sleeves, and skirt. The skirt flows outward into a medium volume shape, culminating in a long lace-trimmed train. A matching lace-edged veil is worn over the head.

4324.description: This ivory ball-gown features a high illusion neckline and long sleeves covered entirely in dense beaded embroidery and lace appliqués with sequins. The structured bodice meets a full, voluminous skirt covered in ornate floral patterns and shimmering accents that extend outward into a long train. The entire surface is heavily embellished from the collar down to the hem.

4325.description: This is an ivory full-length a-line gown featuring an illusion neckline and long sleeves. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate floral lace patterns and subtle beading. The bodice is fitted at the waist and flows out into a voluminous skirt with a short train.

4326.description: This ivory a-line wedding dress features an all-over lace construction with intricate floral appliques. It has a high neckline and long fitted sleeves with light gathering at the shoulders. The bodice is fitted through the natural waist, transitioning into a full skirt that falls gracefully to the floor and extends into a long, lace-trimmed train.

4327.description: This ivory a-line wedding gown is densely covered in intricate lace, beading, embroidery, and sequin applique from the high illusion neckline down to the hem. It features long sleeves and a structured bodice with a sweetheart sweetheart-shaped illusion overlay terminating at a high collar. The voluminous skirt falls in full pleats and folds into a medium length patterned train.

4328.description: This trumpet gown features intricate lace and applique detailing over an ivory fabric base. It has a high illusion neckline with a sweetheart bodice underneath, paired with long fitted lace sleeves. The silhouette fits closely through the hips before flaring gracefully at the knees into a short lace-trimmed train.

4329.description: This ivory a-line gown features a high illusion neckline and long sleeves completely covered in dense beading, embroidery, and sequin work. The structured bodice displays intricate patterned beadwork over a sweetheart lining, transitioning into a full, voluminous skirt with heavy lace and sequin appliqués. The heavily embellished floor-length skirt extends into a long, detailed train.

4332.description: This ivory gown is heavily embellished with intricate silver and white beading, forming dense, swirling patterns across the entire garment. It features a high mock neck and long, fitted sleeves, with a sheer illusion panel on the chest. The dress maintains a fitted silhouette, falling smoothly to the floor with full coverage, and does not have a train.

4333.description: This is a heavily embellished mermaid wedding gown featuring an illusion neckline and long sleeves. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate beaded and sequined embroidery with linear and leaf-like motifs. Vertical ruffled tulle trims edge the side seams and cascade down the skirt into a long, sweeping train.

4334.description: This black gown features a straight, fitted silhouette with long sleeves and an illusion scoop neckline. The garment is heavily embellished with intricate gold beadwork, embroidery, and sequins arranged in symmetrical motifs on the bodice and flowing into vertical wavy lines down the skirt. The construction features a sheer net overlay covering a dark base. The hem falls straight to the floor with no visible train.

4335.description: This is a fitted trumpet-silhouette gown featuring a high neckline and long sleeves. The dress is densely embellished all over with intricate beaded patterns and pearls, forming geometric lines and lattice motifs across the bodice and skirt. The fabric is sheer mesh overlaid on a champagne-colored lining, falling into a short train.

4336.description: This fitted sheath gown features a high-neckline and long sleeves with a column silhouette that cascades into a medium train. The sheer tulle fabric is completely covered with dense silver beadwork, sequins, and embroidery forming intricate linear and curved patterns across the bodice, sleeves, and skirt. The design is fully embellished, creating a continuous sparkling texture over a nude-toned lining.

4337.description: This champagne and nude gown features an a-line silhouette with a high illusion neckline and long sleeves. The bodice and upper chest are densely covered in intricate vertical beading, pearls, and embroidery, transitioning into a full skirt adorned with lace appliques and scattered beading. The dress falls to the floor with medium volume and terminates in a short train.

4338.description: This ball-gown features a dense arrangement of silver beading, sequins, and embroidery in geometric, radiating patterns across the bodice and full skirt. It has an illusion scoop neckline with long sleeves and falls in a full, voluminous silhouette with a short train.

4339.description: This ivory and champagne a-line gown features an illusion scoop neckline and long sheer sleeves. The bodice is heavily embellished with dense beading and intricate embroidery forming structured vertical lines and geometric patterns. The full skirt flows outwards with sparkling vine-like embroidery and sequin embellishments cascading down to a short train.

4340.description: This champagne-colored a-line gown features a high scoop neckline and long sheer sleeves. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate silver beading, sequins, and embroidery arranged in geometric sunburst patterns radiating from the center bodice. The skirt falls with medium volume in vertical lines of heavy embellishments down to the floor.

4341.description: This fitted trumpet gown features a sheer illusion scoop neckline and long sheer sleeves, heavily encrusted with intricate silver beading, sequins, and embroidery in a linear and baroque pattern. The dense embellishment covers the entire bodice and hips, tapering into lighter motifs down the flared skirt. The gown flows into a long embellished train that spreads across the floor.

4342.description: This fitted mermaid gown features a sheer illusion neckline and long sleeves. The fabric is heavily embellished with dense beadwork, sequins, and metallic embroidery laid over lace. The ornate patterning flows down the fitted silhouette into a flared hem with a short train.

4343.description: This ivory mermaid gown features an illusion high neckline with long sleeves and heavy silver beading, embroidery, and crystal embellishments distributed densely over the bodice and skirt. The fitted silhouette flows into a flared skirt with a patterned, heavily embellished long train. The sweetheart neckline sits underneath a sheer beaded illusion overlay.

4344.description: This trumpet gown features a high illusion neckline with long sleeves and dense, elaborate silver beadwork, embroidery, and sequin detailing arranged in intricate radiating patterns. The heavy embellishment covers the entire garment, following the fitted silhouette down to the hips before flaring outward into a moderately flared skirt with a sweep train.

4345.description: This fitted mermaid gown features an intricate high neckline and long sleeves fully covered in dense geometric beading and embroidery. The bodice incorporates a structured corset design with visible boning lines overlayed with elaborate crystal beadwork. The skirt closely follows the body curves down to the knees before flaring slightly into a medium length beaded sweep train.

4346.description: This fitted trumpet gown features a sheer illusion neckline and long sleeves completely covered in heavy beading, embroidery, and sequins. The structured bodice incorporates nude draping and a prominent bow detail at the center chest above a pointed basque waistline. Dense, ornate swirling bead and sequin patterns cover the entire silhouette down to a fluted skirt and a medium pleated train with ruffled edging.

4347.description: This is a heavily beaded and sequined one-shoulder gown featuring an asymmetrical neckline with feather and tulle ruffles along the top edge and extending down the single long sleeve. The bodice has a fitted peplum waist overlay cascading over a slim fitted sheath skirt covered in dense linear beadwork patterns. The dress falls straight down to a small sweep train.

4348.description: This fitted floor-length gown features an intricate, dense pattern of silver beading and embroidery over a champagne or nude base. The bodice includes an illusion neckline with a sweetheart sweetheart-shaped underlay and sheer paneling at the upper chest. Long sleeves feature slight gathering at the shoulders, leading into a straight column skirt that cascades into a small puddle train.

4349.description: This champagne-colored mermaid gown features dense, intricate beading and sequin embroidery forming geometric patterns over a sheer fabric base. The bodice includes a high illusion neckline and long sleeves with flared cuffs, complemented by a peplum waist detail that flows into a fitted skirt with a short train.

4350.description: This ivory sheath gown features a fitted silhouette with full coverage through a sheer illusion scoop neckline and long sleeves. The entire surface of the garment is heavily adorned with intricate beadwork and embroidery forming ornate geometric and swirling patterns. The silhouette skims the figure down to the floor, terminating in a short sweep train.

4353.description: This fitted sheath gown features an intricate all-over beaded and embroidered pattern covering the entirety of the garment. The bodice has an illusion high-neckline with a sweetheart sweetheart-style underlay, complemented by sheer long sleeves. A structured peplum-like overlay accents the waist, flowing downward into a slender skirt that ends in a short train.

4355.description: This champagne-colored fitted sheath gown features heavy beadwork and embroidery arranged in intricate geometric and scalloped patterns across the entire silhouette. The bodice has an illusion scoop neckline and long, fitted sheer sleeves, accented by a structured peplum waistline featuring central crystal flower appliques. The skirt falls straight to the floor in a slim column line without a train, fully covered in dense vertical beaded swirls.

4356.description: This is a form-fitting mermaid gown featuring a champagne and nude lining overlaid with dense, swirling silver beading and sequins that form vertical wave-like patterns from the bodice to the hem. The bodice has an illusion high neckline overlaying a sweetheart shape and long sheer beaded sleeves. A prominent structured ruffled peplum or oversized bow accent is attached at the natural waistline. The skirt hugs the hips and thighs before flaring out gently into a medium sweep train.

4357.description: This is a fully embellished long-sleeved sheath gown in a champagne-toned mesh overlay with dense silver beadwork and sequin embroidery forming intricate symmetrical and linear patterns from the scoop neckline down to the hem. The sleeves feature slight gathers at the shoulders, falling into fitted long sleeves. The silhouette follows a straight sheath line with minimal volume and no visible train.

4358.description: This fitted trumpet gown features a sheer illusion neckline with a scoop bodice underneath and long sleeves. The dress is densely covered in intricate beadwork, sequins, and embroidery arranged in ornate, symmetrical geometric and Art Deco-inspired patterns throughout the entire garment. The silhouette follows the lines of the body before flaring slightly at the hem into a short sweep train.

4359.description: This fitted sheath gown features an illusion neckline and long, fully embellished sleeves. The body of the dress is covered in dense silver sequins and beading arranged in intricate swirling patterns over a champagne-colored fabric. An asymmetrical overlay of sheer draped chiffon crosses the bodice from the right shoulder and gathers at the left hip with a crystal starburst applique. A long, floor-sweeping panel of the same draped chiffon flows from the hip applique down into a short train.

4360.description: This long-sleeved, fitted trumpet gown features a sheer illusion base completely covered in heavy silver and gold beading, sequins, and embroidery in an intricate geometric and swirling pattern. The neckline is a modest rounded illusion scoop with structured, lightly puffed shoulders on the long sleeves. The skirt follows a sleek silhouette down to the floor, flaring slightly at the hem with a short, beaded sweep train.

4361.description: This is a form-fitting mermaid gown featuring a high scoop illusion neckline and long sleeves, rendered in a champagne mesh base entirely covered in dense gold sequin and bead embroidery in an intricate geometric and swirling pattern. The gown falls closely to the body through the hips before flaring gracefully at the hem into a short sweep train. The sheer illusion fabric allows the metallic beadwork to create a cohesive, shimmering metallic body-con effect from the shoulders down.

4362.description: This fitted champagne-colored mermaid gown features a high neckline and long sleeves. It is densely covered in intricate geometric beadwork, sequins, and embroidery forming elaborate swirling patterns across the entire silhouette. The skirt flows down into a slight flare at the hem with a short train trailing behind.

4363.description: This gown features a fitted trumpet silhouette, crafted from a sheer nude-toned fabric, entirely adorned with dense black beading and sequins. The embellishment forms an intricate, symmetrical geometric pattern that covers the entire garment, including the round scoop neckline and full-length sleeves. The dress maintains a close fit through the bodice, waist, and hips, gently flaring out just above the knee to the floor. The back is fully covered, mirroring the front's elaborate embellishment and coverage.

4364.description: This fitted sheath gown features a sheer illusion base layer in a nude tone, fully covered in dense black sequin and bead embellishments arranged in intricate geometric and damask-inspired patterns. The high neckline and long sleeves provide complete upper body coverage. The skirt closely follows the contours of the body and flows into a short sweep train with matching embellishments.

4365.description: This black gown features a fitted trumpet silhouette with long sleeves and a scoop neckline. The entire garment is densely covered in shimmering sequins and patterned embroidery forming vertical wave-like motifs. It falls closely to the floor, culminating in a short train at the back.

4366.description: This is a full-length mermaid silhouette gown featuring long sleeves and a high scoop neckline. The dress is completely covered in dense silver and black sequin and bead embellishments arranged in an intricate, flame-like or abstract wavy pattern. It is fitted closely through the bodice and hips before flaring slightly at the hem with a short train.

4369.description: This is a fitted long-sleeve gown with a scoop neckline and a straight silhouette that flares slightly at the hem. The garment is heavily covered in intricate silver beadwork and embroidery forming geometric and floral patterns over a black base fabric. The intricate ornamentation spans uniformly across the bodice, sleeves, and skirt without interruption. The construction provides full coverage with a floor-length hem and no visible train.

4370.description: This is a black form-fitting mermaid gown featuring a high neckline and long sleeves. The dress is densely covered in intricate silver beadwork and embroidery forming elaborate geometric and floral patterns throughout. It falls closely to the body before flaring out at the bottom into a medium train with matching embellished details.

4371.description: This is a full-length, fitted mermaid gown in a dark navy hue featuring a high scoop neckline and long sheer sleeves. The entire garment is densely embellished with intricate silver embroidery, beading, and sequins in an ornate, symmetrical damask and scroll pattern. The fitted silhouette hugs the body down to the knees, where it flares out into a skirt with a short train trimmed with matching embroidered details.

4372.description: This black gown features heavy silver beading, embroidery, and sequin work in dense geometric and baroque-inspired patterns. It has a high illusion scoop neckline and long sheer sleeves with matching beadwork. The silhouette is fitted through the body with a slight flare at the hem, creating a trumpet shape.

4373.description: This green gown features a mermaid silhouette with heavy beading, sequins, and embroidery over the sheer illusion sleeves, upper bodice overlay, and entire lower skirt. The center bodice has a solid satin panel with a straight-across sweetheart neckline beneath a sheer scoop neck overlay. A pointed peplum waistline detail transitions from the smooth satin bodice into the heavily embellished fitted skirt that extends into a short train.

4374.description: This emerald green gown features a fitted trumpet silhouette with a full-length sequined and beaded lace skirt. The bodice has a smooth satin center with a peplum waistline edged in beadwork. An illusion scoop neckline and long sheer lace sleeves are heavily encrusted with tonal beads and sequins, matching the elaborate lace yoke across the upper chest.

4375.description: This green fitted sheath gown features a scoop neckline and long sleeves, fully covered in dense sequin and bead embroidery. The bodice and sleeves showcase scattered metallic beadwork and sequins, while the lower skirt is overlaid with vertical beaded fringe strands extending down to the floor. The silhouette is straight and column-like with minimal volume at the hem and no train.

4376.description: This green fitted sheath gown features a square neckline and long sleeves. The entire surface is heavily embellished with intricate silver beadwork, sequins, and embroidery forming geometric and floral patterns. The gown falls straight to the floor with minimal volume and no visible train.

4377.description: This is a fitted, full-length green gown featuring a square neckline and long sleeves. The dress is densely covered in intricate silver beadwork and embroidery arranged in geometric and art deco-inspired patterns that trace the silhouette. It follows a slim sheath shape down to a short sweep train at the hem.

4378.description: This is a fitted trumpet silhouette gown featuring long sleeves and a high neckline with sheer illusion detailing. The garment is densely covered in intricate beadwork, sequins, and embroidery in a matching dark berry tone. The pattern forms vertical lines and symmetrical scroll motifs down the length of the gown. It falls closely to the body, flaring slightly at the hem with a short train.

4379.description: This purple, fully sequined and beaded trumpet gown features a high illusion neckline and long sleeves. The dress is heavily embellished with intricate beaded patterns and sequins covering the entire fitted silhouette, transitioning into a slight flare at the hem with a short train.

4380.description: This is a fully embellished purple long-sleeve gown featuring an illusion scoop neckline and fitted sheath silhouette. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate beadwork, sequins, and embroidered swirling patterns. A structured peplum overlay accentuates the waistline before the skirt falls straight to the floor with no train.

4381.description: This is a full-length, straight sheath gown in a grey hue, densely covered with intricate dark beading and sequins in a flowing, abstract pattern. It features a squared neckline and long, fitted sleeves with light gathering at the shoulders. A beaded fringe overlay extends from the dropped waistline down the front of the skirt, adding heavy texture and movement. The gown maintains a slim, column silhouette with no visible train.

4382.description: This fitted sheath gown is rendered in a light blue fabric and heavily encrusted with dense silver sequins and beading arranged in a radiating, leaf-like pattern across the entire garment. It features a square neckline and long sleeves. The silhouette follows the lines of the body closely down to the floor, ending in a short train.

4383.description: This is a fitted trumpet-silhouette gown covered entirely in intricate, abstract swirled embroidery and densely packed sequins. It features a modest scoop neckline and long sheer sleeves with matching sequin patterns. The dress follows the contours of the body down to the knees before flaring out slightly into a short sweep train. The fabric is a shimmering metallic blue-grey shade.

4385.description: This is a floor-length, A-line gown heavily embellished with vertical lines of silver beads and sequins. It features a sheer illusion neckline and long sleeves. The bodice is fitted with structured paneling, and the skirt falls in a straight, minimal volume line to the floor with no visible train.

4386.description: This champagne and nude sheath gown features an illusion neckline with a sweetheart bodice detail and long illusion sleeves. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate silver and gold beading, embroidery, and sequins arranged in ornate scroll and linear patterns. The fitted skirt falls straight to a subtle short train.

4387.description: This champagne and ivory a-line gown features an illusion scoop neckline and long sleeves completely covered in dense beaded and embroidered details. The bodice and skirt showcase intricate geometric and floral beadwork patterns cascading down the lightweight fabric. The skirt flows into a short train with patterned panels extending to the hem.

4388.description: This ivory and champagne gown features an a-line silhouette with an illusion scoop neckline and long sheer sleeves. The bodice and sleeves are densely covered in intricate beadwork, sequins, and embroidery in swirling patterns over a sweetheart illusion foundation. The full skirt extends downward with vertical beaded embellishments and lace underlayers, flowing into a short sweep train.

4389.description: This is a heavily embellished trumpet gown featuring a nude lining overlaid with sheer tulle, densely covered in intricate silver beadwork, sequins, and embroidery forming geometric and floral motifs. The bodice has an illusion scoop neckline with long sleeves that feature heavily beaded detailing along the shoulders and cuffs. The fitted silhouette gently flares at the hem into a short sweep train.

4390.description: This green fitted trumpet gown features a high neckline and long sheer sleeves. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate beaded embroidery and sequins arranged in ornate scrolling patterns. The silhouette hugs the frame down to the floor, flaring slightly at the hem with a short train.

4391.description: This green evening gown features a fitted trumpet silhouette with a floor-length hem and short train. The garment is fully covered in dense beading, embroidery, and sequins arranged in intricate linear and scrolling patterns. It includes a high neckline, long sheer-illusion sleeves, and a form-fitting bodice that flows into a flared skirt.

4392.description: A black fitted sheath gown featuring sheer lace long sleeves and a matching illusion scoop neckline over a sweetheart bodice foundation. The bodice is densely draped with asymmetrical pleating across the torso. A dramatic pleated ruffle and flowing fabric overlay originates at the right hip and cascades down to the floor, forming a short train. The skirt beneath the overlay is crafted from patterned black lace.

4393.description: This long-sleeved sheath gown features an illusion neckline and is rendered in a black fabric densely patterned with a metallic gold floral brocade. The sheer black tulle bodice and long sleeves are heavily embellished with intricate black beadwork and sequin embroidery across the chest and shoulders. The skirt is dramatically draped and gathered at the center front waist, falling straight to the floor with minimal volume and no noticeable train.

4395.description: This black gown features an illusion high-neckline with sheer long sleeves. The bodice is densely embroidered with dark floral patterns and shimmering beading. The skirt is made of flowing chiffon with vertical draping gathered at the front waist, falling in a straight silhouette.

4396.description: This black gown features a long-sleeved bodice heavily embellished with intricate beaded embroidery over sheer fabric, terminating in a beaded fringe waistline. The skirt is made of lightweight, pleated black fabric that falls in soft gathers to the floor. The neckline is a modest round scoop, and the sleeves are full-length and fitted. The overall silhouette is an A-line style with a solid, opaque black skirt and a decorative, patterned top.

4397.description: This is a floor-length navy blue sheath gown featuring long, sheer mesh sleeves and an illusion scoop neckline. The bodice and sleeves are densely embellished with intricate silver beadwork and sequins arranged in a geometric radiating pattern over an illusion base, terminating in a distinct beaded hemline at the waist. The skirt is crafted from a smooth, flowing fabric that falls straight to the ground with minimal volume and no visible train.

4398.description: This is a navy blue long-sleeved evening gown featuring a heavily embellished bodice with intricate beading, sequins, and embroidery. The neckline is a modest round scoop, and the long sleeves are fitted and fully covered in matching beadwork down to the wrists. The skirt is composed of a smooth, flowing chiffon or georgette fabric with soft vertical pleats falling into a full A-line silhouette with no train.

4399.description: This two-toned evening gown features a fully beaded sheer long-sleeve bodice with vertical silver embellishments and a high scoop neckline. The lower half is crafted from smooth, draped blush fabric that gathers at the side of the waist in soft folds. The skirt falls in a straight sheath silhouette to a short train.

4400.description: This long-sleeved gown features an illusion scoop neckline with heavy beaded embroidery across the bodice and sheer sleeves. The skirt is crafted from smooth fabric with dramatic gathering and draping centered at the hip, falling into a slim silhouette with a short train.

4401.description: This a-line gown features a metallic grey shimmering fabric skirt and sheer illusion mesh bodice and sleeves. The bodice and long sleeves are densely embellished with gold and silver beading, embroidery, and sequins in an ornate, botanical-inspired pattern that cascades past the natural waistline. The neckline is a modest scoop framed by the sheer mesh yoke, and the skirt falls in soft, voluminous folds to the floor with no visible train.

4402.description: This is an A-line gown featuring a sheer illusion neckline and long sleeves. The bodice is heavily embellished with intricate silver beading and embroidery in a botanical pattern that extends down past the waistline. The skirt is made of lightweight tulle in a nude or champagne tone and falls in a full, flowing silhouette to the ground with a medium train.

4403.description: This grey A-line gown features an illusion high neckline and long sheer sleeves heavily encrusted with silver embroidery, beading, sequins, and crystal appliques over the bodice and upper sleeves. The voluminous skirt is made from a lustrous, smooth satin fabric that falls in soft pleats to the floor without a train.

4404.description: This gown features a-line silhouette in a champagne or nude tone with a minimal volume skirt that falls straight to the floor. The bodice and long sleeves are constructed from sheer illusion mesh heavily covered in dense, organic silver or gold embroidery and beading in a vine-like pattern. The neckline is a subtle illusion style with a sheer yoke above a sweetheart-shaped bodice lining. The skirt is made of a smooth, opaque chiffon fabric without any embellishment, creating a distinct contrast with the ornate upper portion.

4405.description: This is a full-length a-line gown featuring an illusion scoop neckline and long sheer sleeves. The sheer bodice and sleeves are heavily embellished with intricate silver beadwork and vine-like embroidery that extends down into a pointed applique motif over the waist. The skirt is made of a smooth, solid-colored chiffon fabric that falls in soft gathers to the floor with moderate volume and no train.

4406.description: This a-line gown features an illusion neckline with long sleeves and a gathered chiffon skirt falling in soft folds to the floor. The bodice is constructed from sheer nude illusion mesh densely covered in intricate gold embroidery, beading, and floral appliqués that extend down over the natural waistline. The back detail and train length are not visible in this view.

4407.description: This ivory gown features a fitted sheath silhouette with a sheer lace illusion bodice and high neckline. Long lace sleeves provide full arm coverage, while a sweetheart sweetheart-lined underbodice creates opaque coverage across the chest. The skirt is crafted from soft chiffon fabric, falling straight with distinct lateral gathering and draping gathered along the left side. The dress concludes with a short sweep train trailing on the ground.

4408.description: This ivory wedding gown features an illusion high-neck bodice with intricate lace long sleeves and a sweetheart underlayer. The skirt is crafted from lightweight chiffon with gentle asymmetrical draping gathered at the waist, falling gracefully into a floor-length silhouette with a short train.

4409.description: This ivory a-line gown features an illusion high neckline overlaying a sweetheart bodice, paired with sheer long lace sleeves. The bodice transitions into a draped chiffon skirt with gathered pleating radiating from the side waist. The skirt falls straight to the floor with minimal volume and no visible train.

4411.description: This ivory gown features a strapless sweetheart neckline with delicate bead detailing along the edge. The structured bodice displays heavy diagonal draping that converges into a pointed peplum waistline accented by beading. A smooth, flowing A-line skirt falls straight to the floor with a minimal train. The fabric has a subtle sheen throughout.

4412.description: This navy blue gown features a fitted bodice with a satin finish and a V-shaped lower waistline. The sheer illusion yoke creates a scoop neckline and long sheer sleeves, heavily adorned with intricate linear beading and embroidery arranged in leaf-like patterns cascading down the sleeves and the full tulle skirt. The skirt falls in soft medium volume to the floor with no visible train.

4413.description: This gown features a heavy concentration of intricate silver and multi-toned beading, embroidery, and sequins across the fitted long-sleeve bodice, radiating outward in geometric patterns from a central knot detail at the front waist. The bodice terminates in a pointed V-shaped basque waistline. The floor-length skirt is composed of soft, gathered opaque grey chiffon with a smooth drape and medium volume, falling straight to the floor without a train. The neckline is a modest rounded scoop, and the sleeves are fitted long sleeves covered in dense linear beadwork.

4418.description: This ivory a-line ball-gown features an illusion scoop neckline with a sweetheart bodice visible underneath, and long fitted sleeves. The entire gown is densely covered with intricate silver beading, embroidery, and sequins arranged in linear and leaf-like patterns radiating from the waist and shoulders. The skirt falls in moderate volume into an elongated floor-sweeping train with matching embellished patterns.

4419.description: This ivory a-line wedding gown features an elaborate high neckline and long fitted sleeves with extensive crystal beading and vertical embroidery patterns. The bodice and full skirt are overlaid with shimmering lace appliqués and sequins that cascade down toward the medium train. The heavy beadwork follows geometric lines across the bodice and transitions into intricate floral motifs across the skirt.

4420.description: This is a full-coverage ball gown featuring an illusion high-neck top over a sweetheart bodice, paired with long fitted sleeves. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate lace appliques, beading, and shimmering sequins that catch the light. The voluminous skirt flares dramatically from the waist into a sweeping long train.

4421.description: This ivory a-line wedding gown features an illusion high neckline and long sheer sleeves heavily detailed with intricate embroidery, beadwork, and lace applique. The bodice incorporates a plunging sweetheart illusion panel overlaid with elaborate botanical patterned embroidery that cascades down through the waistline into the voluminous skirt. The heavy lace and sequin detailing covers the entirety of the A-line silhouette, extending outward into a dramatic, circular cathedral-length train with a scalloped lace hem.

4422.description: This ivory ball gown features an illusion v-neckline with long sheer sleeves entirely covered in dense lace embroidery and subtle beading. The bodice incorporates intricate sequin and lace detailing with a defined waistline that flows into a voluminous full skirt covered in matching botanical lace appliques. A sweeping long train extends behind the gown, heavily embellished with matching lace motifs.

4423.description: This is a full-length, high-neck a-line gown featuring long illusion sleeves and an intricate overlay of dense white floral lace and subtle beadwork throughout the bodice and skirt. The bodice has an illusion high neckline that transitions into fitted sheer lace sleeves. The skirt falls in a classic a-line silhouette with moderate volume, covered in matching lace patterns and extending into a long lace-trimmed train on the floor.

4426.description: This fitted mermaid gown features a high illusion neckline and long sleeves heavily laden with intricate beading and linear embroidery. The sheer bodice is structured with exposed boning and dense crystal embellishments that transition into vertical beaded lines extending down the skirt. A large, dimensional floral ruffle accent sits on the left shoulder. The gown finishes in a wide, voluminous train with a ruffled hem and scattered sequin details.

4427.description: This is a full-length mermaid gown featuring a high illusion neckline and long sheer sleeves. The garment is entirely covered in dense lace embroidery accented with sequins and subtle beading, creating a sparkling pattern over an inner lining. It fits closely through the bodice and hips before flaring outward dramatically at the knees into a wide chapel-length train.

4430.description: This trumpet gown features an illusion scoop neckline and long sleeves, fully covered in dense beading, embroidery, and sequins. The bodice includes a structured peplum waist detail with intricate geometric beadwork. The skirt hugs the hips and falls straight with vertical beaded lines before flaring slightly into a short train at the hem.

4431.description: This ivory a-line gown features dense beadwork and embroidery arranged in intricate geometric and floral patterns over a lace base. The bodice has an illusion high-neck overlay with a sweetheart neckline underneath, paired with long fitted sleeves. A dropped waist transitions into a voluminous skirt with a short train, heavily embellished with vertical crystal lines and lace motifs.

4432.description: This is an a-line gown featuring an illusion high-neckline and long sleeves, constructed from an ivory lace and tulle overlay on a champagne lining. The bodice and sleeves are heavily embellished with intricate beading, embroidery, and sequins forming symmetrical floral and geometric patterns, continuing densely onto the flared skirt. The skirt falls with medium volume into a short train.

4433.description: This long-sleeved A-line gown features an illusion neckline and a heavily beaded, embroidered bodice with a peplum waist detail. The upper torso and long sleeves are densely encrusted with intricate silver beading, sequins, and crystal work that forms geometric and floral patterns over a champagne-toned underlayer. The floor-length skirt is composed of layered floral lace applique and shimmering fabric, falling into a short train.

4434.description: This fitted trumpet gown features a high scoop neckline and long sheer sleeves, crafted from a champagne-toned fabric fully covered in dense geometric beading and sequins forming intricate patterns. The silhouette hugs the body down to the knees before flaring out slightly into a short puddle train at the hem. The heavy embellishment is arranged symmetrically down the entire length of the gown, creating a rich sparkling texture.

4435.description: This fitted sheath gown features a nude and champagne undertone covered entirely in dense silver beading and embroidery. The neckline is an illusion scoop style with detailed swirling beadwork across the sheer upper bodice and long sleeves. Beaded vertical lines and intricate scroll patterns cascade down the torso and skirt, ending in a short beaded train.

4436.description: This champagne-colored gown features an a-line silhouette with long sleeves and a modest scoop neckline. The entire surface is densely covered in intricate beadwork and embroidery, with geometric patterns concentrated at the bodice and waistline, transitioning into vertical beaded stripes down the full skirt. The fabric is sheer mesh layered over a nude lining, falling with medium volume to the floor with no visible train.

4437.description: This fitted sheath gown is rendered in a nude and champagne tone featuring an illusion scoop neckline and long sheer sleeves. The entire surface is heavily embellished with intricate vertical lines of dense beading, sequins, and embroidery running from the shoulders to the floor-length hem. The bodice features a concentrated pattern of beaded appliqués creating a focal medallion effect. The silhouette is straight and fitted closely to the body with minimal skirt volume and no visible train.

4438.description: This is a floor-length a-line gown featuring an illusion scoop neckline and sheer long sleeves. The dress is constructed from a nude-toned sheer tulle layer over a matching sweetheart lining, heavily covered in vertical linear beadwork and shimmering sequins radiating from the waist and shoulders. The embellishments include clear beads and scattered darker reddish-brown stones along the linear patterns. The skirt falls with medium volume into a short train.

4439.description: This fitted sheath gown features a sheer illusion overlay densely covered in intricate vertical patterns of silver beads and reddish-brown crystals. It has a high scoop neckline and long, fitted sleeves completely embellished with the same beadwork. The silhouette follows the lines of the body closely, cascading down into a minimal short train at the floor.

4440.description: This champagne-colored a-line gown features long sheer sleeves and a modest scoop neckline. The entire dress is densely covered in intricate silver and clear beading and embroidery, forming sunburst patterns on the bodice, a defined heavily beaded waistband, and elaborate swirling motifs cascading down the voluminous tulle skirt. The skirt falls to the floor with a subtle sweep and no extended train.

4441.description: This champagne and nude mermaid gown features a sheer illusion high neckline with a heavily beaded collar and long sleeves covered in intricate silver beadwork and sequins. The fitted bodice and skirt are densely embellished with intricate linear and symmetrical crystal bead patterns. Voluminous ruffled fabric cascades down the lower skirt, creating a dramatic flounced hemline that extends into a long, beaded train. A dimensional floral applique sits on the left shoulder.

4442.description: This fitted sheath gown features a sheer illusion neckline with long sleeves and a sweetheart inner bodice structure. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate silver beadwork and geometric embroidery over a champagne nude lining. The skirt falls straight to the floor with minimal volume and terminates in a short train.

4443.description: This green fitted sheath gown features long sleeves and a high illusion neckline with a plunging sheer cutout detail at the bodice. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate beaded and sequined embroidery arranged in linear and feathered patterns. The skirt falls straight with minimal volume, maintaining a sleek silhouette down to the floor without a train.

4444.description: This green fitted sheath gown features heavy, dense beadwork and sequins arranged in intricate, chevron-like patterns across the entire fabric. It has a high square neckline and long fitted sleeves. The garment falls closely to the body before pooling slightly at the floor into a short train.

4445.description: This is a fitted long-sleeve gown featuring a scoop neckline with an illusion detail. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate beadwork, sequins, and embroidery forming a linear, geometric pattern. The silhouette hugs the body closely through the hips before flaring slightly into a short train at the hem.

4447.description: This fitted trumpet gown features a square neckline and long sleeves, fully covered in intricate silver beadwork, sequins, and embroidery forming geometric and radiating patterns over a champagne base. The dense embellishment continues down the length of the skirt, flaring slightly at the hem into a medium train with heavy decorative borders.

4448.description: This champagne and nude gown features a fitted, straight silhouette covered entirely in dense, intricate beading and embroidery arranged in ornate geometric and swirling patterns. It has a high illusion neckline with long sleeves and a sweetheart bodice base visible beneath the sheer beaded yoke. The heavy embellishment extends uniformly from the collar down to the floor-length hem, which falls straight with no train.

4449.description: This gown features a fitted bodice with intricate heavy beading and embroidery extending down to a dropped waistline. The sheer illusion neckline and long sleeves are covered in dense beadwork. A smooth, satin-like skirt falls into soft folds, creating an a-line silhouette that pools into a short train at the back.

4450.description: This is a floor-length gown featuring a nude and champagne color palette. The bodice has a fitted peplum silhouette with an illusion scoop neckline and long sheer sleeves, heavily covered in dense beadwork and embroidery in geometric diamond patterns. The skirt is made of lightweight, flowing chiffon with minimal embellishment and falls loosely to the ground with a short train.

4465.description: This champagne and nude colored gown features an a-line silhouette with a high neckline and long sleeves. The bodice is densely embroidered and embellished with beaded details and white floral applique. The skirt consists of layered tulle panels with vertical lines of beading cascading down to the floor-length hem.

4466.description: This fitted sheath gown features a nude illusion base heavily encrusted with intricate silver and blue crystal beading and sequin embroidery arranged in geometric and floral patterns. It has a scoop neckline with an illusion sheer upper bodice and long sheer sleeves. The heavily embellished beadwork continues down the length of the gown to a short sweep train.

4467.description: This is a fully-beaded and embroidered a-line gown featuring long sleeves and a scoop neckline. The dense beadwork creates intricate curved patterns across the bodice, shoulders, and sleeves, transitioning into ornate scrolling vine motifs over the layered skirt. The gown falls to the floor with moderate volume and includes a short train at the back.

4468.description: This is a floor-length a-line gown in a rich champagne-gold color featuring a full coverage design with long sleeves and an illusion round neckline. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate beadwork, sequins, and metallic embroidery arranged in geometric and floral patterns over a patterned lace underlayer. The structured bodice transitions into a softly flared skirt with moderate volume that pools evenly at the floor without a train.

4469.description: This is a floor-length a-line gown in a light grey or silver hue featuring an illusion high neckline overlaying a sweetheart bodice. Long sheer sleeves and the entire bodice are densely embellished with intricate beadwork and sequins in swirling patterns. The skirt flows out with vertical lines of beading and sequins cascading down towards the hem, ending in a short train.

4470.description: This ivory a-line gown features an illusion scoop neckline with long sleeves, densely covered in intricate beadwork, embroidery, and sequins. The bodice exhibits heavy linear and geometric crystal embellishments over a sheer panel, transitioning into a heavily textured skirt composed of lace applique and scatterings of sequins. The skirt falls with medium volume down to a short train. The back and entire construction are fully embellished with matching lace and beading.

4471.description: This champagne and silver gown features an illusion v-neckline and long sleeves with subtle volume at the shoulders. The fitted bodice is heavily embellished with dense beading, sequins, and embroidery in a complex swirling pattern, featuring a peplum-like overlay at the hips. The skirt transitions to a lace and sequin-patterned a-line silhouette with moderate volume, falling to a short train on the floor.

4472.description: This silver a-line gown features an illusion high neckline overlaying a sweetheart bodice shape with long beaded sleeves. The entire dress is heavily embellished with intricate silver beading, sequins, and embroidery arranged in vertical linear patterns down the skirt and dense concentric floral motifs across the bodice. The skirt falls with medium volume into a short train.

4473.description: This floor-length sheath gown features long sleeves and a high neckline, completely covered in dense silver and crystal beadwork and sequins arranged in ornate geometric and radiating patterns over a champagne-colored illusion base fabric. The silhouette follows the lines of the body closely with a fitted waist and a straight skirt that falls to a short train. The intricate embroidery creates a highly textured and reflective surface across the entire garment from collar to hem.

4474.description: This champagne-toned trumpet gown features a high scoop illusion neckline and long sleeves, fully covered in intricate swirling beadwork and sequin embroidery. The embellishments form dense geometric and art-deco patterns along the bodice and down the length of the fitted skirt. The skirt flares out slightly at the knees into a long embellished train that sweeps the floor behind.

4475.description: This fitted mermaid gown is heavily embellished from neckline to hem with dense silver beading, embroidery, and sequins creating radiating geometric starburst patterns across the bodice and waist. It features an illusion scoop neckline and sheer long sleeves with scattered vertical beadwork. The garment falls closely along the figure before flaring slightly at the knees into a medium sweep train featuring decorative embellishment patterns along the hemline.

4476.description: This fitted sheath gown features an illusion neckline with a sweetheart underlayer and long sheer sleeves. The entire dress is heavily embellished with intricate silver beading, embroidery, sequins, and lace patterns arranged in elaborate geometrical and floral motifs across the bodice and skirt. The fabric is light and falls in a straight line with minimal volume, finishing in a short train at the floor.

4477.description: This is a heavily embellished mermaid gown featuring a fitted silhouette that flares out at the knees into a long train. The sheer illusion neckline and long sleeves are densely covered with intricate beading, sequins, and metallic embroidery forming symmetrical patterns. The fabric is a light-colored tulle base completely overlaid with shimmering decorative elements extending down the length of the skirt and train.

4478.description: This is a heavily embellished silver and grey sheath gown featuring an illusion neckline and long sheer sleeves. The bodice showcases intricate beaded scrollwork and linear patterns over a sweetheart lining. The skirt falls straight with dense vertical sequin and bead embellishments extending into a short train.

4479.description: This champagne and nude colored sheath gown features a high illusion scoop neckline and long sheer sleeves. The garment is heavily encrusted with dense linear patterns of beading and sequins radiating from the center front and waist, creating a dramatic cascading effect. The silhouette falls straight to the floor with minimal volume and terminates in a short train.

4480.description: This is a full-length fitted sheath gown featuring an illusion high neckline and long sheer sleeves densely covered in intricate beaded and sequined patterns. The beadwork flows vertically down the bodice and skirt in ornate geometric and swirl motifs. A gathered draped fabric accent is attached over one shoulder. The gown falls straight to a floor-length hem with minimal volume and no visible train.

4481.description: This is a straight-fitting long-sleeved gown featuring an illusion scoop neckline. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate silver and grey beading arranged in geometric patterns across the bodice and falling in vertical beaded strands down the skirt. The sheer mesh overlay provides coverage over the chest and arms while supporting the heavy beaded embellishments.

4482.description: This grey gown features a fitted sheath silhouette with long sleeves and a high illusion scoop neckline. The entire garment is heavily embellished with intricate silver beading, sequins, and embroidery arranged in cascading vertical patterns down the skirt and dense clusters across the bodice and shoulders. The fabric falls straight to the floor with minimal volume and no visible train.

4483.description: This black sheath gown features a floor-length straight silhouette with minimal volume and no train. It has a round illusion scoop neckline and long sheer sleeves. The garment is densely covered in intricate silver beadwork and sequined embroidery arranged in vertical, swirling patterns spanning from the shoulders down to the hem.

4484.description: This black evening gown features an intricate illusion high neckline and long sleeves completely covered in dense silver beading, sequins, and embroidery. The upper bodice incorporates ornate art-deco inspired geometric patterns with heavy beadwork. The skirt falls straight with vertical rows of beaded fringe and crystals descending to the floor, creating a subtle linear shimmer. The silhouette is sleek and fitted with no visible train.

4485.description: This is a full-length, burgundy sheath gown featuring a scoop neckline and long sheer sleeves. The entire garment is densely covered in vertical linear beadwork and intricate crystal embellishments across the bodice. An asymmetrical draped fabric panel extends from the right shoulder down the upper arm. The lightweight outer layer falls in a straight, column-like silhouette with no visible train.

4486.description: This fitted trumpet gown features sheer long sleeves and an illusion scoop neckline over a sweetheart bodice structure. The entire garment is densely encrusted with intricate beading, sequins, and embroidery forming geometric and vertical patterns down to a short train. The bodice has exposed boning and heavy crystal ornamentation.

4487.description: This fitted mermaid gown features an illusion neckline with a sweetheart bodice underneath and long sleeves, fully covered in intricate beadwork, embroidery, and sequins. The heavily embellished fabric follows the curves of the body down to the knees before flaring out into a medium-length train with detailed hem edging. The design creates a glittering, textured appearance over a nude and champagne colored underlayer.

4488.description: This grey gown features a fitted bodice with a high neckline and long sleeves, fully covered in intricate silver beading and embroidery in dense patterns. The skirt falls in an a-line silhouette, heavily embellished with ornate silver scrollwork and beadwork descending towards the hem. A draped fabric panel originates from the right shoulder and flows down the back to form a short train.

4489.description: This is a heavily embellished fitted gown featuring a square neckline and long sleeves. The dress is densely covered with intricate beading, sequins, and embroidered applique patterns over a nude and champagne colored sheer base. The silhouette fits closely through the bodice, waist, and hips before flaring out at the bottom into a long, detailed train.

4492.description: This is a fitted sheath gown in a champagne gold tone featuring heavy, dense embellishment of beads, sequins, and embroidered lace work covering the entire surface. The neckline is an illusion scoop style over a sweetheart underlayer, complemented by long sleeves with gathered detailing at the shoulders. The heavy beading creates intricate patterns down the bodice and skirt, which falls straight to the floor with minimal volume and no visible train.

4493.description: This is a fitted mermaid style gown featuring a dark burgundy fabric densely covered in silver beading, embroidery, and sequins in intricate vertical foliate patterns. The dress has long sleeves and a structured square neckline. The heavy embellishment runs continuously from the shoulders down to the floor-length hemline.

4494.description: This dark fitted gown features an illusion scoop neckline with long sleeves and heavy dense silver beading, embroidery, and sequin patterns covering the entire garment. The bodice incorporates a structured peplum-like draped layer at the waist. The skirt falls straight to the floor in a slim sheath silhouette without a visible train.

4495.description: This fitted mermaid gown is fully covered in heavy silver and dark grey beadwork, sequins, and embroidery forming a dense geometric lattice pattern over a sheer fabric base. The dress features a high scoop neckline and long, fitted sheer sleeves. A structured peplum overlay with matching embellishment accents the waist. The skirt flows closely to the body and ends in a short puddle train.

4496.description: This is a form-fitting mermaid gown featuring a navy blue fabric foundation overlaid with sheer mesh. The entire garment is densely covered in intricate, highly ornate silver and crystal beadwork, embroidery, and sequin appliques forming baroque damask patterns. It has a high illusion neckline and long sheer sleeves with matching embellishments throughout. The skirt hugs the hips and thighs before flaring out slightly at the hem into a medium sweep train edged with embroidery.

4497.description: This fitted mermaid gown features a dark navy base heavily overlaid with dense silver embroidery, beading, and sequin work. The illusion neckline and long sleeves showcase intricate swirling patterns that cascade down the torso and flare into a dramatic, patterned train. The beadwork is densely concentrated along the bodice and hemline, creating a high-contrast and opulent visual effect.

4498.description: This is a fitted long-sleeved sheath gown in a deep navy color, completely covered in dense sequin and bead embellishments forming an intricate pattern. The garment features a rounded scoop neckline and full-length straight sleeves. The silhouette follows a straight, narrow line down to the floor with minimal volume and no visible train.

4499.description: This fitted trumpet gown is densely covered in shimmering sequins and embroidery arranged in an abstract, flowing pattern of dark and metallic tones. It features a high scoop neckline, long fitted sleeves, and a structured peplum detail at the waist. The skirt skims the hips and flares gently at the hem into a short sweep train.

4500.description: This is a full-length, navy-colored sheath gown completely covered in dense silver and navy sequins forming an intricate swirling pattern. The garment features long sleeves, a rounded scoop neckline, and a slim column silhouette that falls straight to the floor without a train. The dense sequin embellishment provides continuous heavy sparkle across the entire fabric surface.

4501.description: This is a fitted sheath gown in navy blue, densely covered in sparkling silver sequins and beading arranged in a flowing, wavy pattern. The dress features a one-shoulder neckline with a thin strap detail across the right shoulder and a long sleeve on the left arm. The silhouette follows the lines of the body closely down to the floor-length hem with no train.

4503.description: This is a full-length, navy blue gown featuring an a-line silhouette and long, sheer sleeves. The bodice and sleeves are heavily embellished with dense beading and sequins in vertical patterns, sitting over an illusion neckline. The skirt is made of a smooth, flowing chiffon-like fabric that falls straight to the floor with medium volume.

4504.description: This is a navy blue floor-length dress with an a-line silhouette. The bodice and long sleeves are heavily embellished with sequins and beading over a sheer illusion fabric featuring a boat neckline. The skirt is made of a smooth, flowing chiffon fabric with a clean and minimal finish, falling in soft folds to the floor with no train.

4505.description: This is a full-length navy blue gown featuring a beaded and sequined bodice with long sleeves and a scoop neckline. The embellished section covers the upper torso in a curved, chevron-like waistline pattern with dense beadwork and sequins forming radiating lines. The lower skirt is crafted from a smooth, flowing fabric with vertical soft pleats creating an a-line silhouette with moderate volume and no train.

4506.description: This black gown features a fitted bodice covered in dense, intricate silver and black beading arranged in geometric and radiating patterns over an illusion fabric. The long sleeves are similarly embellished with linear beadwork. The skirt portion consists of a smooth, draped black fabric that falls straight down in a minimal silhouette with no visible train.

4508.description: This is a full-length olive green gown with a high illusion neckline and long bishop sleeves featuring cuffed wrists with beadwork. The fitted bodice is heavily embellished with silver embroidery, beading, and lace applique that extends downward in an inverted point onto the waist. The skirt falls in smooth, gathered folds from the waist to the floor with a minimal train. The overall construction consists of a sheer embellished upper portion and flowing opaque pleated fabric for the skirt and sleeves.

4510.description: This is a two-piece looking gown featuring a heavily embellished, fitted bodice with dense silver beading and embroidery over a sweetheart neckline and illusion mesh high-neck overlay. The long sleeves are also densely beaded with gathered shoulders. The skirt is floor-length, made of a smooth, fluid chiffon fabric that falls in soft vertical pleats with minimal volume and no visible train.

4511.description: This ivory gown features a fitted trumpet silhouette covered entirely in dense beaded embroidery and sequins. The sheer illusion bodice has a scoop neckline and long sleeves with subtle puff shoulders. A pronounced gathered draping detail originates at the right hip, adding texture before the skirt flows down into a short train.

4512.description: This ivory trumpet gown features an illusion scoop neckline and sheer long sleeves constructed from patterned lace. The bodice highlights an exposed boned corset design with a sweetheart sweetheart-shaped underlay. The skirt is fitted through the hips and thighs before flaring out gently at the hem with lace appliques throughout. A short lace-trimmed train completes the design.

4513.description: This is a fitted sheath gown featuring an illusion high neckline overlaying a sweetheart bodice. The bodice and front hip feature diagonal ruching and draping gathered at the right side. The garment is crafted from a patterned lace fabric with long sheer lace sleeves. The skirt falls straight to a subtle sweep train.

4514.description: An ivory a-line gown featuring an illusion high-neckline and sheer long lace sleeves. The bodice showcases visible boning under a structured, draped off-the-shoulder fabric overlay across the chest. The skirt falls in a soft A-line silhouette with an all-over lace overlay and terminates in a short train.

4527.description: This grey gown features a fitted sheath silhouette with a sheer illusion scoop neckline and long sheer sleeves. The entire garment is heavily embellished with intricate silver beading and sequins in vertical linear patterns and elaborate swirling motifs at the skirt hem. The skirt falls straight to the floor with a subtle short train, maintaining a sleek and structured profile.

4531.description: This lilac-hued gown features a fitted, straight silhouette with full-length sheer sleeves and a modest scoop neckline. The entire garment is densely encrusted with intricate silver beading, sequins, and crystal embroidery arranged in elaborate swirling motifs and vertical linear patterns across the bodice, waist, and skirt. The skirt falls straight down with minimal volume, finishing with a floor-length hem without a train.

4534.description: This fitted mermaid gown features an illusion high-neckline with a sweetheart inner bodice and sheer long sleeves. The dress is densely covered in intricate silver and champagne beading, sequins, and lace appliques over a structured corset bodice with visible boning lines. The skirt hugs the hips before flaring out into a voluminous skirt with a heavy beaded hemline and a long matching train.

4552.description: This light blue gown features a smooth satin bodice with a scoop neckline and long sleeves. One sleeve and the asymmetrical peplum waist detail are heavily adorned with intricate silver beading, embroidery, and floral appliques. The lower skirt is fitted, featuring a straight silhouette densely covered in sparkling beadwork from hip to hemline.

4553.description: This champagne-colored gown features a sheer illusion square neckline and sheer long bishop sleeves with banded cuffs. The structured bodice is densely covered in heavy silver beading and embroidery with an ornate scalloped waistline. The skirt is made of lightweight chiffon falling in soft vertical pleats into an a-line silhouette with a sweep-free floor-length hem.

4554.description: This champagne-colored gown features an a-line silhouette with an illusion high neckline and long sleeves. The bodice is heavily embellished with intricate beaded swags and patterns across the chest, sleeves, and back. The lower skirt is crafted from a smooth, flowing chiffon fabric that falls in soft folds to a short train.

4557.description: This light pink chiffon gown features a high neckline and long sheer sleeves with gathered cuffs. The fitted bodice is heavily embellished with intricate beaded lace applique over the bust and waist, complemented by horizontal draping across the midsection. The skirt falls in soft, flowing pleats from the waist into an a-line silhouette with a sweep-length hem. The back is covered with sheer fabric matching the sleeves and neckline.

4562.description: This gown features a fitted bodice with a high illusion neckline and long sleeves completely covered in dense bead and pearl swags creating intricate patterns. The skirt is crafted from a smooth, lustrous satin fabric in a champagne tone, falling gracefully into a clean A-line silhouette with a short train. The bodice has structured shoulders and a high collar fully encrusted with beads. The contrast between the heavily embellished bodice and the minimalist satin skirt defines the overall aesthetic.

4564.description: This is a burgundy gown featuring long sleeves and a scoop neckline. The bodice and sleeves are heavily embellished with intricate sequin and metallic embroidery in a dense, floral-inspired pattern. The skirt is made of a flowing, translucent chiffon fabric that falls in soft vertical folds to the floor with no visible train.

4567.description: This black gown features a fitted silhouette with a floor-length skirt and no train. The upper bodice and long sleeves are heavily embellished with intricate silver beading in a scattered diagonal pattern. The skirt is made of a smooth fabric with soft draping gathered at the hip. The neckline is a square cut.

4569.description: This floor-length gown features a fitted illusion bodice densely decorated with silver beading, embroidery, and appliques over a nude lining, high neckline, and a basque waistline. The long sleeves are sheer and billowy, cuffed at the wrists. The skirt is made of lightweight white chiffon with vertical soft pleats, falling into a gentle A-line silhouette with a short train.

4570.description: This A-line gown features a sheer illusion high-neck bodice with dense floral lace applique and long sleeves. The skirt is made of lightweight, finely pleated chiffon that falls softly to the floor with a short train. The neckline and sleeves show extensive lace detailing while the waist transitions cleanly into the flowing, pleated skirt.

4571.description: This purple floor-length gown features a sheer illusion neckline with long chiffon sleeves gathered at the wrists. The bodice includes diagonal ruching and is adorned with intricate dark beading across the right shoulder and collarbone area, extending down as an appliqué onto the waistline. The skirt falls in straight, flowing layers of chiffon to the floor with minimal volume and no train.

4573.description: This ivory a-line gown features a high neckline and sheer long bishop sleeves with fitted cuffs. The bodice showcases dense, multicolored beaded and embroidered floral patterns forming a distinct panel over the chest and waist. The lightweight skirt falls in soft vertical folds to the floor with a short sweep train.

4575.description: This burgundy gown features a fitted trumpet silhouette crafted entirely from patterned lace. The sheer illusion yoke creates a scoop neckline with long sheer lace sleeves and a sweetheart bodice lining underneath. Soft draping emanates from a central waist knot, cascading down the front of the skirt. The gown flows into a floor-sweeping hemline without a train.

4576.description: This black gown features a fitted sheath silhouette and long sheer lace sleeves with a scoop illusion neckline. The bodice incorporates a structured corset design with heavy beading, embroidery, and dense appliqué work extending down to a peplum waist. The lower skirt is fashioned from patterned lace falling straight to the floor with no train.

4583.description: This is a full-length, long-sleeved a-line gown in a dark olive green or gold-toned mesh fabric, featuring a modest scoop neckline. The entire surface of the garment is heavily encrusted with vertical linear patterns of dense beading, sequins, and metallic embroidery that radiate outwards from the waistline in sunburst and striped motifs. The gown falls smoothly with moderate volume to the floor into a straight hemline without a noticeable train. Long, sheer mesh sleeves are densely covered in matching vertical beadwork down the arms.

4585.description: This fitted mermaid gown features an intricate, dense network of beading, sequins, and embroidery arranged in sweeping geometric diagonal patterns across the entire garment. It has long sheer sleeves and an illusion high neckline leading into a fitted bodice. The skirt hugs the hips before flaring outward slightly at the knee into a medium sweep train.
